ap_supply_lt_abs1.name: LTO Sanity Syrup
ap_supply_lt_abs1.desc: Use this to recover Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
ap_supply_lt_abs1.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.

ap_supply_lt_abs2.name: LTO Sanity Syrup
ap_supply_lt_abs2.desc: Use this to recover Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
ap_supply_lt_abs2.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.

ap_supply_lt_l.name: Emergency Sanity Concentrate
ap_supply_lt_l.desc: Use this to recover 100 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
ap_supply_lt_l.decoDesc: A large dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. Its effects are immediate. A list of side-effects, including severe insomnia, have been provided in the user's manual. Good luck!

ap_supply_lt_n.name: Emergency Sanity Booster
ap_supply_lt_n.desc: Use this to recover 40 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
ap_supply_lt_n.decoDesc: A moderate dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. The developer seemed to have acquired a secret formula from some strange documents that multiplied the amount of sugar within this specific preparation.

ap_supply_lt_s.name: Emergency Sanity Sample
ap_supply_lt_s.desc: Use this to recover 10 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
ap_supply_lt_s.decoDesc: A small dose of Sanity syrup sample contained within an emergency-use package. Use this item on time and avoid unnecessary stockpiling to avoid expiration.

ap_supply_lt_weekly.name: LTO Sanity Syrup
ap_supply_lt_weekly.desc: Use this to recover Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
ap_supply_lt_weekly.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.

business_card_topic_bp_1_0.name: New Horizons
business_card_topic_bp_1_0.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_0.decoDesc: Go forth. A new, boundless world awaits.

business_card_topic_bp_1_1.name: Lingshui Vantage
business_card_topic_bp_1_1.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_1.decoDesc: Wu, the pacifying force of martial might. Ling, the riparian ridge denying the Blight.

business_card_topic_bp_1_2.name: Shanshui Painting
business_card_topic_bp_1_2.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_2.decoDesc: See the realm as the pure and the tainted. Know thy inks and master the blank spaces. With strokes of the brush is this realm painted.

business_card_topic_bp_1_3.name: Relic of Viridian Mont
business_card_topic_bp_1_3.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_3.decoDesc: The relic of Viridian Mont is one set aside for posterity.

business_card_topic_bp_1_4.name: Fount of Suffering
business_card_topic_bp_1_4.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_4.decoDesc: We can finally face the fount where pain surges forth, and heal the scars in our hearts.

business_card_topic_bp_1_5.name: Dreamlit Night
business_card_topic_bp_1_5.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_5.decoDesc: The dream, though slightly warped, can still illuminate the night of Gloomwald.

business_card_topic_bp_1_6.name: Aspiration for the Clouds
business_card_topic_bp_1_6.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_bp_1_6.decoDesc: A mountainous vantage stroked with autumn fur. A magnificent view found nowhere else but here.

business_card_topic_chr_0009_azrila.name: The Bastion Never Breached
business_card_topic_chr_0009_azrila.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: Red hot steel and solid blood were the brick and mortar of the northern bastions. The North is not her nightmare. It is merely her next destination.

business_card_topic_chr_0013_aglina.name: Let's Flip the World
business_card_topic_chr_0013_aglina.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: Turn your vision upside down and you'll see different views, experience different moods, and become a different you. Oh my, the world has become completely new.

business_card_topic_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Heart of Youth
business_card_topic_chr_0015_lifeng.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: Like a block of natural jade, he will endure the chiseling and retain his purity of heart.

business_card_topic_chr_0016_laevat.name: An Invite to the Melting Fire
business_card_topic_chr_0016_laevat.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: Accompany her through long nights without memories. Fight with her and burn the dark, nightmarish enemies. Stand with her as she lights fires to illuminate future journeys.

business_card_topic_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Win-Win!
business_card_topic_chr_0017_yvonne.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: Bright-colored coatings, an upbeat soundtrack, and a satisfied smile of victory... She has recorded every joyous moment and now she's sharing them with you.

business_card_topic_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Aspiration
business_card_topic_chr_0025_ardelia.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: Flowers blooming on cold, hard rocks ... barren lands teeming with life and warmth ... and idyllic songs humming by our ears... Professor, this isn't just a dream, right?

business_card_topic_chr_0026_lastrite.name: First Rime to Bloom
business_card_topic_chr_0026_lastrite.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0026_lastrite.decoDesc: She has many unanswered questions, and many difficulties not yet overcome. Nevertheless, she will complete all of your assignments and bring back the smiles on everyone's faces.

business_card_topic_chr_0027_tangtang.name: Supreme Chief's Orders are Supreme
business_card_topic_chr_0027_tangtang.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0027_tangtang.decoDesc: "Darkmask! Stay close to your Supreme Chief! A day will come when I take you to the world's edge!"

business_card_topic_chr_0028_wulfa.name: A World at the Tip of the Pen
business_card_topic_chr_0028_wulfa.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0028_wulfa.decoDesc: The canvas recorded the legends and stories. Plus the castle from last night's dream and the little wolf pup who chased away the disaster.

business_card_topic_chr_0029_pograni.name: Checkmate
business_card_topic_chr_0029_pograni.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0029_pograni.decoDesc: The smoke of ruin still lingered. Numerous pieces, living and dead, fell off the ponderous corpse. His blade served as the support of his body, his steel oath, and his vigil — And then he made his move. Checkmate.

business_card_topic_chr_0030_zhuangfy.name: Forged and Finalized
business_card_topic_chr_0030_zhuangfy.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0030_zhuangfy.decoDesc: This time round, she intends to win.

business_card_topic_chr_0031_mifu.name: Toast to Joy
business_card_topic_chr_0031_mifu.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0031_mifu.decoDesc: The night is short, so let us toast and drink to joy.

business_card_topic_chr_0032_lizhiyan.name: Blade Personified
business_card_topic_chr_0032_lizhiyan.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0032_lizhiyan.decoDesc: Transform the body into a blade, and condense thought into the arcane.

business_card_topic_chr_0033_camille.name: Shadowbreak
business_card_topic_chr_0033_camille.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0033_camille.decoDesc: He freed himself from the dark shadow that clung to him, like a thorny vine that burst from the earth.

business_card_topic_chr_0034_typhoea.name: Deep in the Icefield She Glances
business_card_topic_chr_0034_typhoea.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0034_typhoea.decoDesc: From afar she turns around to gaze at you, her eyes are like the icefields of Samivegr, deep yet serene.

business_card_topic_chr_0035_liino.name: Heart-Whipping Practice
business_card_topic_chr_0035_liino.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0035_liino.decoDesc: "Hush now. Now's the time to give everyone a moment for beautiful dreams."

business_card_topic_chr_0036_jsspsi.name: Untainted
business_card_topic_chr_0036_jsspsi.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_chr_0036_jsspsi.decoDesc: Through the mortal realm she roamed, yet the mortal dust tainted her not.

business_card_topic_normal_1.name: Theme: Default
business_card_topic_normal_1.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.

business_card_topic_normal_2.name: Initial Link
business_card_topic_normal_2.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_normal_2.decoDesc: A syringe, a flower, and an echo of gratitude. You extend your hand and relink the lands.
obtainWays: Valley IV: Regional Development Level Rewards

business_card_topic_normal_3.name: Protocol Procession
business_card_topic_normal_3.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_normal_3.decoDesc: The Protocol has been activated. The process of life is moving forward. May you join us in our march forward.

business_card_topic_normal_4.name: Arriving at Wuling
business_card_topic_normal_4.desc: A theme for the Profile screen. Profile themes are shown at various places.
business_card_topic_normal_4.decoDesc: Only those who arrive at Wuling know how beautiful the lands and waters can be.

common_2x3_l.name: Jigsaw Piece TEST ONLY
common_2x3_l.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_003_chips_1.name: Valuable Chip
item_003_chips_1.decoDesc: A chip storing all sorts of facility data. Though the chip won't sell for much, it plays crucial roles in certain work processes.

item_003_chips_2.name: Valuable Chip
item_003_chips_2.decoDesc: A chip storing all sorts of facility data. Though the chip won't sell for much, it plays crucial roles in certain work processes.

item_003_chips_3.name: Letter from Witte
item_003_chips_3.decoDesc:
Letter from Witte: 
You've been careless. Don't leave important chips lying around like that. Anyways, I took it back to the dorms. You'll find it there.

item_Ingredient_flour_1.name: Flour
item_Ingredient_flour_1.desc: A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_Ingredient_flour_1.decoDesc: Flour is acquired by processing Reed Rye. It is as fine as snow and yields quite a chewy dough.

item_Ingredient_oil_1.name: Seed Oil
item_Ingredient_oil_1.desc: A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_Ingredient_oil_1.decoDesc: Seed Oil is acquired by processing Oilseed Bloom. Essential in all sorts of skilleting, stir frying, and deep frying.

item_Ingredient_paprika_1.name: Ground Pepper
item_Ingredient_paprika_1.desc: A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_Ingredient_paprika_1.decoDesc: Ground Pepper is acquired by processing Tartpeppers. A whiff of Ground Pepper, even from a distance, can make one sneeze.

item_Ingredient_spices_1.name: Spice Mix 130
item_Ingredient_spices_1.desc: Purchasable from Pantry Keep "Job Rusher". Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_Ingredient_spices_1.decoDesc: A mix of various finely-ground spices. Rumors say that Spice Mix 1300 is in development.

item_Ingredient_starch_1.name: Starch
item_Ingredient_starch_1.desc: A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_Ingredient_starch_1.decoDesc: Starch is acquired by processing Pingtubers. It tastes pretty good, even when eaten raw.

item_Ingredient_sugar_1.name: Sugar
item_Ingredient_sugar_1.desc: A product of AIC Factory processing. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_Ingredient_sugar_1.decoDesc: Sugar is acquired by processing Crunchcane. Just a little can add quite a bit of sweetness.

item_activity_contract_gold_0.name: Vitrified Coin
item_activity_contract_gold_0.desc: A special item acquired by completing contract missions. It is exchangeable for rewards at the [Secret Sanctuary] of the [Contingency Contract] event. The item will be removed once the [Secret Sanctuary] is closed.
item_activity_contract_gold_0.decoDesc: Spin it on your fingertip. The shimmering radiance reflecting off its surface is proof that the ancient contract lives on.

item_activity_copper_poly.name: Proto Xiran-Cuprium
item_activity_copper_poly.desc: A metal ingot made by transmuting Proto Xiran-Cuprium Gas during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly.decoDesc: An experimental type of Xiran-Cuprium that is lighter compared to the standard type of the same material. However, it is also more brittle.

item_activity_copper_poly_cmpt.name: Proto Xiran-Cuprium Part
item_activity_copper_poly_cmpt.desc: A part made by processing Proto Xiran-Cuprium during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly_cmpt.decoDesc: An experimental Xiran-Cuprium Part that is more resistant to material wear and fatigue compared to the standard part.

item_activity_copper_poly_gas.name: Proto Xiran-Cuprium Gas
item_activity_copper_poly_gas.desc: A novel gas created by reacting Cuprium Gas with Xiragen during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly_gas.decoDesc: An experimental type of Xiran-Cuprium Gas that is easier to transport and store compared to the standard type of the same gas.

item_activity_copper_poly_tool.name: Proto Xiran-Cuprium Frame
item_activity_copper_poly_tool.desc: A reinforced support frame made by processing Proto Xiran-Cuprium Parts and Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_poly_tool.decoDesc: A chassis frame absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung! And it's EXTRA-STRONG!

item_activity_copper_xiranite_tool.name: Proto Cuprium Frame
item_activity_copper_xiranite_tool.desc: A support frame made by processing Cuprium Parts and Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_copper_xiranite_tool.decoDesc: A chassis frame absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung!

item_activity_formula_xiranite_enr_hulu.name: Xiranite Jade Gourd Design Draft
item_activity_formula_xiranite_enr_hulu.desc: An item for producing Xiranite Jade Gourds. These can be traded at outposts to earn large sums of stock bills and <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.
item_activity_formula_xiranite_enr_hulu.decoDesc: Sketches that draft the design of the Xiranite Jade Gourd. Notes written down at the corner of a sketch read: "If I retire, maybe I could look for a job at jade processing..."

item_activity_formula_xiranite_enr_lung.name: Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung Designs
item_activity_formula_xiranite_enr_lung.desc: An item for producing Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lungs. They can be traded at outposts to earn plenty of stock bills and <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.
item_activity_formula_xiranite_enr_lung.decoDesc: Design drawings for the production of Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lungs.

item_activity_formula_xiranite_hulu.name: Xiranite Gourd Design Draft
item_activity_formula_xiranite_hulu.desc: An item for producing Xiranite Gourds. These can be traded at outposts to earn stock bills and <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.
item_activity_formula_xiranite_hulu.decoDesc: Sketches that draft the design of the Xiranite Gourd. Plenty of notes have been written at the corners and margins. The designer is obviously pleased with the idea of making a gourd-like device.

item_activity_formula_xiranite_lung.name: Xiranite Chubby Lung Designs
item_activity_formula_xiranite_lung.desc: An item for producing Xiranite Chubby Lungs. These can be traded at outposts to earn stock bills and <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.
item_activity_formula_xiranite_lung.decoDesc: Design drawings for the production of Xiranite Chubby Lungs.

item_activity_relief_coupon.name: Fruits of Altruism Certs
item_activity_relief_coupon.desc: Special currency that can be acquired by trading with outposts during a special period. They can be spent at the [Event Center] - [AIC Support: Palm-Top Savior] - [Goods Exchange] for valuable goods and items.
item_activity_relief_coupon.decoDesc: They symbolize the fruits of cooperation and mutual trust. Every cert is an accolade for the AIC Factory.

item_activity_relief_coupon_1.name: Fruits of Altruism Certs
item_activity_relief_coupon_1.desc: Special currency that can be acquired by trading with outposts during a special period. They can be spent at the [Event Center] - [AIC Support: Chubby Lung Attacks] - [Goods Exchange] for valuable goods and items.
item_activity_relief_coupon_1.decoDesc: They symbolize the fruits of cooperation and mutual trust. Every cert is an accolade for the AIC Factory.

item_activity_sample_xiranite_enr_hulu.name: Xiranite Jade Gourd Sample
item_activity_sample_xiranite_enr_hulu.desc: A sample of a protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.
item_activity_sample_xiranite_enr_hulu.decoDesc:
A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. This particular version has a larger Xiranite capacity than the standard variant. If the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.
"A beautiful gourd that can bail me out."

item_activity_sample_xiranite_enr_lung.name: Sample: Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung
item_activity_sample_xiranite_enr_lung.desc: A sample of an enhanced Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.

item_activity_sample_xiranite_hulu.name: Xiranite Gourd Sample
item_activity_sample_xiranite_hulu.desc: A sample of a protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.
item_activity_sample_xiranite_hulu.decoDesc:
A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. Nevertheless, if the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.
"A round-bellied gourd with a pouty snout."

item_activity_sample_xiranite_lung.name: Sample: Xiranite Chubby Lung
item_activity_sample_xiranite_lung.desc: A sample of a Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.

item_activity_xiranite_bottle.name: Experimental Xiranite Bottle
item_activity_xiranite_bottle.desc: A container made by processing Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_bottle.decoDesc: A gourd-shaped Xiranite bottle. Many Wulingers dreamed of traveling the world armed with a sword and a gourd.

item_activity_xiranite_box.name: Proto Chubby Lung Shell
item_activity_xiranite_box.desc: A shell component made by processing Proto Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_box.decoDesc: A piece of outer casing absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung!

item_activity_xiranite_cmpt.name: Experimental Xiranite Part
item_activity_xiranite_cmpt.desc: A part made by processing Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_cmpt.decoDesc: This experimental Xiranite part has a rather limited range of applications.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_bottle.name: Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle
item_activity_xiranite_enr_bottle.desc: A large-capacity container made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_bottle.decoDesc: A larger, thicker, and heavier gourd-shaped Xiranite bottle. In fact, it is so thick and heavy that people think it could be used as a component for an exotic weapon.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_box.name: Proto Chubby Lung Heavy Shell
item_activity_xiranite_enr_box.desc: A thick shell component made by processing Proto Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_box.decoDesc: A piece of outer casing absolutely ESSENTIAL for the birth of the MAGNIFICENT Chubby Lung! And it's EXTRA-THICK!

item_activity_xiranite_enr_cmpt.name: Experimental Heavy Xiranite Part
item_activity_xiranite_enr_cmpt.desc: A part made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_cmpt.decoDesc: This experimental Heavy Xiranite part has a rather limited range of applications.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_hulu.name: Xiranite Jade Gourd
item_activity_xiranite_enr_hulu.desc: A large-capacity protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_hulu.decoDesc:
A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. This particular version has a larger Xiranite capacity than the standard variant. If the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.
"A beautiful gourd that can bail me out."

item_activity_xiranite_enr_lung.name: Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung
item_activity_xiranite_enr_lung.desc: An improved Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_nugget.name: Proto Heavy Xiranite
item_activity_xiranite_enr_nugget.desc: A piece of crystalline Heavy Xiranite made during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_nugget.decoDesc: A piece of Heavy Xiranite with a rather unique crystalline structure. This seems to be the product of a special experiment and exhibits very unusual levels of activity.

item_activity_xiranite_enr_tool.name: Experimental Xiran-Hue Atomizer
item_activity_xiranite_enr_tool.desc: A component made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_enr_tool.decoDesc: A special Xiranite atomizer that can effectively accelerate Xiranite dispersion. Design inspirations are derived from the famous poetry anthology titled Clouds and Sunsets.

item_activity_xiranite_hulu.name: Xiranite Gourd
item_activity_xiranite_hulu.desc: A protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.
item_activity_xiranite_hulu.decoDesc:
A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. Nevertheless, if the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles.
"A round-bellied gourd with a pouty snout."

item_activity_xiranite_lung.name: Xiranite Chubby Lung
item_activity_xiranite_lung.desc: A Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period. It can be traded at outposts for stock bills as well as <@tips.key>Fruits of Altruism Certs</>.

item_activity_xiranite_nugget.name: Proto Xiranite
item_activity_xiranite_nugget.desc: A piece of crystalline Xiranite made during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_activity_xiranite_nugget.decoDesc: A piece of Xiranite with a rather unique crystalline structure. This seems to be the product of a special experiment and exhibits very unusual levels of activity.

item_add_endurance.name: Stamina Delimiter
item_add_endurance.desc:
Once acquired, stamina limit for dodge/dash actions is permanently increased.
(Can be increased up to 5 times)
item_add_endurance.decoDesc: The symbol of endurance. If necessary, this conceptual entity can become a brick. If things get even more desperate, life itself becomes a concept as well. The completion of our Tower is at hand.

item_adventureexp.name: Operational EXP
item_adventureexp.decoDesc: A form of experience you earn as you explore Talos-II. Like always, these lands await your discovery, Endministrator.

item_agfly_1_agmelee_1_moss_2_1.name: Cosmo-Melto Jelly
item_agfly_1_agmelee_1_moss_2_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_agfly_1_agmelee_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: A jelly that people can easily prepare, even in the wildlands. Citromes can be dissolved in a mixture of two different types of aggagrits to create a strange jelly-like material.

item_agmelee_1_moss_1_lbmob_1_1.name: Meaty Buckflower Stew
item_agmelee_1_moss_1_lbmob_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.

item_ap.name: Sanity
item_ap.desc: A mental concept essential for sustaining one's ego and supporting the planning and execution of various operations.

item_ap_feed_in.name: Sanity Extractor
item_ap_feed_in.desc: Sanity can be manually infused in this to acquire Sanity Essences. Also, when automatic usage of limited-time Sanity meds exceed the Sanity limit, the exceeding amount will be auto-infused into this to acquire Sanity Essences.
item_ap_feed_in.decoDesc:
A special auto-extractor.
"Your keen senses shall be fused with your desires to explore this world, and create medicinal sanity supplements that you can hold in reserve."

item_ap_supply_activity_wuling_racing.name: "Rolling Chubby Lung" Energy Drink
item_ap_supply_activity_wuling_racing.decoDesc: A special sporting event-exclusive version of Lungclaw Ultra-E. Chug this down to purge mental fatigue. Lungclaw keeps you pumped. Lungclaw, the essential supplement that lets you beat mountains and ravines!

item_ap_supply_lt.name: LTO Sanity Syrup
item_ap_supply_lt.desc: Use this to recover Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
item_ap_supply_lt.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.

item_ap_supply_lt_l.name: Emergency Sanity Concentrate
item_ap_supply_lt_l.desc: Use this to recover 100 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
item_ap_supply_lt_l.decoDesc: A large dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. Its effects are immediate. A list of side-effects, including severe insomnia, have been provided in the user's manual. Good luck!

item_ap_supply_lt_n.name: Emergency Sanity Booster
item_ap_supply_lt_n.desc: Use this to recover 40 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
item_ap_supply_lt_n.decoDesc: A moderate dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. The developer seemed to have acquired a secret formula from some strange documents that multiplied the amount of sugar within this specific preparation.

item_ap_supply_lt_s.name: Emergency Sanity Sample
item_ap_supply_lt_s.desc: Use this to recover 10 Sanity. This item also has an expiration date. When expired, it will be auto-converted to Sanity or Sanity Essences until the relevant limits.
item_ap_supply_lt_s.decoDesc: A small dose of Sanity syrup sample contained within an emergency-use package. Use this item on time and avoid unnecessary stockpiling to avoid expiration.

item_ap_supply_nlt.name: Sanity Syrup
item_ap_supply_nlt.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you're seeing double when reading these instructions.

item_ap_supply_springfes_1.decoDesc: A dessert prepared by the Dijiang canteen to celebrate Spring Festival. It is said that they have created different varieties, skillfully adjusting the ratio of fillings according to the tastes and wishes of various operators.

item_ap_take_out.name: Sanity Essence
item_ap_take_out.decoDesc: A very special Sanity potion. There is no need to panic if you experience throat swelling, throat pain, or abdominal discomfort after use. Just drink some warm water to alleviate the said symptoms.

item_book_002_01.name: Real Estate Ad
item_book_002_01.decoDesc:
Enjoy the Koncerdel view! Experience what it truly means to live the life! 
Edge of the new frontier! An investment that will rake in millions! 
100-200 square meters of picturesque scenery with interiors designed by master Hongshan artisans. 
300 mm of reinforced defensive steel (RDS) for a peace of mind against Aggeloi or Ætherside threats. 
1615 New Year Sale. Available while this special discount lasts! Make this dream home yours for a minimum down payment of 10,000! That's JUST 10K!

item_byproduct_bean_1.name: Ballpea Pod
item_byproduct_bean_1.desc: A byproduct of Ballpea cultivation. Can be processed by the AIC Factory to make beast feed.
item_byproduct_bean_1.decoDesc: Seed pod of the ballpea plant. Breaks with a crunch when pressed hard. Some Tianshi would use the pods as stress relief fidget toys.

item_byproduct_bean_moss_1.name: Ballpea Pod Powder
item_byproduct_bean_moss_1.desc: Powderized form of Ballpea Pod. Can be used to prepare other materials. Typical product: Double-Yummy Feed.
item_byproduct_bean_moss_1.decoDesc: Powderized form of Ballpea Pod. It has a mild sweet flavor of freshly cut grass. They say it has a calming effect when fed to beasts.

item_byproduct_potato_1.name: Pingtuber Leaf
item_byproduct_potato_1.desc: A byproduct of Pingtuber cultivation. Can be processed by the AIC Factory to make beast feed.
item_byproduct_potato_1.decoDesc: The leaf of the Pingtuber plant is too fibrous for human consumption.

item_byproduct_potato_moss_1.name: Pingtuber Leaf Powder
item_byproduct_potato_moss_1.desc: Powderized form of Pingtuber Leaf. Can be used to prepare other materials. Typical product: Yummy Feed.
item_byproduct_potato_moss_1.decoDesc: Powderized form of Pingtuber Leaf is an excellent material for making beast feed.

item_c16m2_newspaper.name: Soaked News Cutting
item_c16m2_newspaper.desc: A news cutting that has been utterly soaked through. The water has made the words hardly legible.
item_c16m2_newspaper.decoDesc: A soaked newspaper cutting. The events it describes seem to have occurred on distant Terra. Is it related to Laevatain's memories?

item_c16m2_notebook.name: Page of Notes
item_c16m2_notebook.desc: A page of notes that Laevatain left behind.
item_c16m2_notebook.decoDesc: Laevatain left this page of notes. It has a list of various locations, events, items, and sceneries, most of which have been crossed out.

item_carbon_enr.name: Stabilized Carbon
item_carbon_enr.desc: An advanced material prepared by refining Dense Carbon Powder. Can be used to make other materials.
item_carbon_enr.decoDesc: Multiple processing steps have achieved a delicate balance for this brick of elemental carbon.

item_carbon_enr_powder.name: Dense Carbon Powder
item_carbon_enr_powder.desc: Acquired by grinding Carbon Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_carbon_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to create this uniquely fine powdered preparation of Carbon.

item_carbon_mtl.name: Carbon
item_carbon_mtl.desc: Carbon captured from refinery incineration of plant matter. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_carbon_mtl.decoDesc: During the war, Endfield Industries managed to optimize their waste emission carbon capture technology.

item_carbon_powder.name: Carbon Powder
item_carbon_powder.desc: Powdered form of Carbon. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_carbon_powder.decoDesc: Carbon can be shredded to yield a powdered product.

item_case_bp_random_1.name: Exchange Crate-o-Surprise [S]
item_case_bp_random_1.desc: Open this to get a random reward. You might even get Oroberyls.
item_case_bp_random_1.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. Since the crates are manually packed at the end of a shift, their contents are less than uniform.

item_case_bp_random_2.name: Exchange Crate-o-Surprise [M]
item_case_bp_random_2.desc: Open this to get a random reward. You might even get Oroberyls.
item_case_bp_random_2.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. This crate-o-surprise seems to have way too many leftovers.

item_case_bp_random_3.name: Exchange Crate-o-Surprise [L]
item_case_bp_random_3.desc: Open this to get a random reward. You might even get Oroberyls.
item_case_bp_random_3.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. "Whose Crate-o-Surprise is Truly Loaded" used to be quite an official game event in the Dijiang canteen.

item_case_bp_random_new_2.name: Cycling Crate-o-Surprise [M]
item_case_bp_random_new_2.desc: Open this to get a random reward that includes Oroberyls and Sanity Usage Permits.
item_case_bp_random_new_2.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. This crate-o-surprise seems to have way too many leftovers.

item_case_bp_selfselect_break.name: Multi-Purpose Breakthrough Selection Crate
item_case_bp_selfselect_break.desc: Opening this lets you choose to receive either operator promotion or weapon tuning materials.
item_case_bp_selfselect_break.decoDesc: A supply crate containing promotion or tuning materials. The first step of personal breakthrough is to hit one's true limit. This alone is a long and arduous process.

item_case_bp_selfselect_exp.name: Multi-Purpose EXP Selection Crate
item_case_bp_selfselect_exp.desc: Opening this lets you choose to receive either operator or weapon EXP materials.
item_case_bp_selfselect_exp.decoDesc: We learn combat techniques by using combat records and other forms of cognitive carriers. Learning must also be revolutionized to prepare us for battlefields of ever-increasing brutality.

item_case_bp_selfselect_skill.name: Skill Up Selection Crate
item_case_bp_selfselect_skill.desc: Opening this lets you choose to receive various operator skill upgrade materials.
item_case_bp_selfselect_skill.decoDesc: Super recommended by Mr. Krad with Instructor Lil' Dodge as a satisfied user. This selection crate has every supporting kit and item for personal training.

item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_1.name: Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅰ
item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_1.desc: Opening this lets you acquire an advanced progression material of your choice.
item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_1.decoDesc: A crate that contains all sorts of high-quality, general-purpose materials. Operator combat performance is not limited by race nor combat experience. Sometimes, they just need a bit of inspiration.

item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_2.name: Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅱ
item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_2.desc: Opening this lets you acquire an advanced progression material of your choice.
item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_2.decoDesc: A crate that contains all sorts of high-quality, general-purpose materials. Operator combat performance is not limited by race nor combat experience. Sometimes, they just need a bit of inspiration.

item_case_char_selfselect_gahca_1_2_2.name: Shimmering Moment Designation Permit
item_case_char_selfselect_gahca_1_2_2.desc: Use this to designate and acquire one of the following 6★ operators: Laevatain / Gilberta / Ardelia / Pogranichnik.
item_case_char_selfselect_gahca_1_2_2.decoDesc: A rather comprehensive designation permit. Finalizing every operator's itinerary is no simple feat. Designating an operational plan for them is just as difficult.

item_case_char_selfselect_standard.name: Designation Selection Permit
item_case_char_selfselect_standard.desc: Use this to designate and acquire one of the following 6★ operators: Ardelia / Pogranichnik / Last Rite / Ember / Lifeng.
item_case_char_selfselect_standard.decoDesc: A thick and heavy designation permit. Various operators have signed their names on it to provide you with their support.

item_case_gem_random_1.name: Essence Supply EX
item_case_gem_random_1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of useful essences gathered from various regions. Your weapon can be the latest experimental prototype, but this crate will have a fitting essence for it.

item_case_token_selfselect_gahca_1_2_2.name: Shimmering Moment Token Supply

item_case_token_selfselect_gahca_1_2_2.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with several tokens. This crate contains more than just tokens, but also the operators' trust and hopes in the future of Endfield.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_1.name: Targeted Weapon Supply
item_case_wpn_selfselect_1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of weapons gathered from various regions. Certain prankers have a habit of placing excessively dangerous weapons in this crate to give their friends a "surprise".

item_cbp_exp.name: Pass EXP
item_cbp_exp.desc: Use this to level up the Protocol Pass.
item_cbp_exp.decoDesc: Every item on the Protocol Pass is gathered from official operator interviews conducted by the Arsenal Engineers. These items include support projects that everyone hopes to see.

item_cbp_voucher_originium.name: Pass Application: Originium
item_cbp_voucher_originium.desc: Use this to activate the Protocol Pass tier: Originium Supply.
item_cbp_voucher_originium.decoDesc: Some Endfield operators enjoy referring to the Protocol Pass as their "wishlist". According to rumors, those who make a wish and place some Origeometry by their pillows during the eve of their birthdays will receive a satisfying reward from the kind little robots of the Arsenal.

item_cbp_voucher_pay.name: Pass Application: Customized
item_cbp_voucher_pay.desc: Use this to activate the Protocol Pass tier: Protocol Customized.
item_cbp_voucher_pay.decoDesc: "Good. Just sign your name here and you'll get your very own customized Protocol Pass... Oh? Efficiency? Don't worry. We'll airdrop the supplies to your place if necessary."

item_char_ap_supply_aglina.name: Chestnut Honey
item_char_ap_supply_aglina.decoDesc: Sweet and refreshing. Gilberta thinks you might have a liking for honey of chestnut flowers, so she bought some from a chestnut orchard during her messenger work.

item_char_ap_supply_camille.name: Devil's Licorice Drops
item_char_ap_supply_camille.decoDesc: Devil's Licorice Drops from Camille. Most people describe the experience of eating these strange snacks as "hosting a boxing match in the mouth", but Camille seems to enjoy it a lot.

item_char_ap_supply_jsspsi.name: Pine Soot Ink Stick
item_char_ap_supply_jsspsi.decoDesc: An ink stick created with a mix of various herbs. It exudes a mild, elegant herbal fragrance on par with the finest incense. The aroma alone is quite invigorating to the mind. You can also nibble on a tiny piece to purge mental ailments and unclean spirits.

item_char_ap_supply_laevat.name: Seasalt Ice Cream
item_char_ap_supply_laevat.decoDesc: Ice cream with a dash of seasalt to bring out its sweetness. This is one of Laevatain's most preferred flavors, of which there are quite a few.

item_char_ap_supply_liino.name: Handmade Star Candy
item_char_ap_supply_liino.decoDesc: Star candy that Liino made herself. They look small and cute, and taste just as good as the expensive stuff sold at La Fantoma candy shops.

item_char_ap_supply_lizhiyan.name: Osmanthus Rice Cake
item_char_ap_supply_lizhiyan.decoDesc: Osmanthus Rice Cake from Arcane. Sweet but not cloyingly so. This dessert brings back tastes from her childhood of memories. With you, she's willing to share moments where she relaxed and enjoyed the company of friends.

item_char_ap_supply_mifu.name: Lungclaw Ultra-E
item_char_ap_supply_mifu.decoDesc: Mi Fu's go-to functional drink. It can quickly get someone back to being "fully pumped" without excessive agitation or stimulation. Mi Fu hopes you can remain energized while you perform your exhausting tasks.

item_char_ap_supply_minghe.name: Nuli Cake
item_char_ap_supply_minghe.decoDesc: A box of small cakes that resemble Argent Flow's close companion. Every piece shows a different temperament. Some look happy, while others look haughty. The box is quite an attractive display of fine baking techniques and clever designs galloping side by side.

item_char_ap_supply_tangtang.name: Dried Fin
item_char_ap_supply_tangtang.decoDesc: Meticulously sun dried and processed with many grueling steps that take nearly two months. The snack on its own gives off the savory sweet taste of fins when chewed. Things that start off bitter and hard often reach a happy conclusion. This is the insight that Tangtang wants to share with you.

item_char_ap_supply_typhoea.name: Samivegric Salted Fin
item_char_ap_supply_typhoea.decoDesc: Specialty salted fin from Samivegr. These salted fins taste quite unique but if properly prepared and cooked, they offer an unparalleled taste of savory flavors.

item_char_ap_supply_wulfa.name: Apple Slices
item_char_ap_supply_wulfa.decoDesc: Rossi personally sliced these apples herself to delicious bite-sizes. It does not matter if the apples were hanging from a wild tree or being sold at a market stall. She can always identify the sweetest one.

item_char_ap_supply_yvonne.name: Strawberry Crepe
item_char_ap_supply_yvonne.decoDesc: A crepe with a generous load of stuffing. Yvonne also gave it some fondant accessories in the likeness of Frost-e-Bytee and Tink-a-Bella.

item_char_ap_supply_zhuangfy.name: Wholly-Braised Sprout [can]
item_char_ap_supply_zhuangfy.decoDesc: Zhuang Fangyi's favorite braised sprouts, made from an entire bamboo sprout. Extremely therapeutic for those exhausted by the stress of heavy overtime.

item_char_break_stage_1_2.name: Protodisk
item_char_break_stage_1_2.desc: A material that promotes operators to E1 or E2.
item_char_break_stage_1_2.decoDesc: A special disk manufactured using Techno-Protocol and standard data etching processes. Often used with other devices to effectively alleviate physical fatigue of operators during training.

item_char_break_stage_3_4.name: Protoset
item_char_break_stage_3_4.desc: A material that promotes operators to E3 or E4.
item_char_break_stage_3_4.decoDesc: A special disk manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced data etching processes. Often used with other devices to effectively alleviate physical fatigue of operators during training.

item_char_equip_supply_jsspsi.name: Arsenal Defense Crate α: Omnipresence
item_char_equip_supply_jsspsi.desc: Contains a set of gear with maxed artificing that fits a specified operator. Defense Crates are automatically opened upon acquisition. The gear within will be stored in the Valuables Stash.
item_char_equip_supply_jsspsi.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers have painstakingly prepared this α-type defensive gear bundle with pieces of equipment that fit Operator Si.

item_char_equip_supply_liino.name: Arsenal Defense Crate α: Dawnstar
item_char_equip_supply_liino.desc: Open this for a set of gear with maxed artificing that fits a specified operator.
item_char_equip_supply_liino.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers have painstakingly prepared this α-type defensive gear bundle with pieces of equipment that fit Operator Liino.

item_char_equip_supply_lizhiyan_1.name: Arsenal Defense Crate α: Rift Vigile
item_char_equip_supply_lizhiyan_1.desc: Open this for a set of gear with maxed artificing that fits a specified operator.
item_char_equip_supply_lizhiyan_1.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers have painstakingly prepared this α-type defensive gear bundle with pieces of equipment that fit Operator Arcane.

item_char_equip_supply_lizhiyan_2.name: Arsenal Defense Crate β: Rift Vigile
item_char_equip_supply_lizhiyan_2.desc: Open this for a set of gear with maxed artificing that fits a specified operator.
item_char_equip_supply_lizhiyan_2.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers have painstakingly prepared this β-type defensive gear bundle with pieces of equipment that fit Operator Arcane.

item_char_equip_supply_typhoea.name: Arsenal Defense Crate α: Winter Hunt
item_char_equip_supply_typhoea.desc: Contains a set of gear with maxed artificing that fits a specified operator. Defense Crates are automatically opened upon acquisition. The gear within will be stored in the Valuables Stash.
item_char_equip_supply_typhoea.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers have painstakingly prepared this α-type defensive gear bundle with pieces of equipment that fit Operator Typhoeus.

item_char_skill_crown.name: Mark of Perseverance
item_char_skill_crown.desc: A rare material that upgrades operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_crown.decoDesc: The perseverance of life and continuation of civilization have left their marks upon this place.

item_char_skill_level_10_12.name: Proto-Extract
item_char_skill_level_10_12.desc: A material that upgrades operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_level_10_12.decoDesc: A stable material extracted from Blighted environments using specialized Techno-Protocol. It can improve bodily tolerance for more powerful enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_level_1_6.name: Protoprism
item_char_skill_level_1_6.desc: A material that upgrades operator skills.
item_char_skill_level_1_6.decoDesc: A special crystal prism manufactured using Techno-Protocol and standard crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_level_7_12.name: Protohedron
item_char_skill_level_7_12.desc: A material that upgrades operator skills.
item_char_skill_level_7_12.decoDesc: A special crystal polyhedron manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_specialize_1.name: Metadiastima Photoemission Tube
item_char_skill_specialize_1.desc: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_specialize_1.decoDesc: A synthetic item for detecting and verifying various field forces and actions at a distance. The tube usually comprises a time crystal sealed in a static vessel, and uses observable regression properties of the photons to achieve its purpose. Though typically stable, users should avoid breaking the vessel and stay out of areas between a pair of linked tubes.
obtainWays: Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)

item_char_skill_specialize_2.name: D96 Steel Sample 4
item_char_skill_specialize_2.desc: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_specialize_2.decoDesc: A novel and artificial alloy of D32 steel and D64 steel that cannot exist naturally. D96 steel has inherited the excellent strength and Arts conduction properties of its constituents. It also features better performance in areas with unstable Originium activities. The material is still being experimented upon, with Sample 4 offering the best cost performance index.
obtainWays: Protocol Space: Hazardous Material Collection Site
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)

item_char_skill_specialize_3.name: Tachyon Screening Lattice
item_char_skill_specialize_3.desc: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_specialize_3.decoDesc: An ion trap that might be leveraging its innate Æther properties. The lattice ignores temporal factors and is capable of detecting and screening naturally occurring tachyon beams in realspace. Since the people of Talos-II are still incapable of activating and firing tachyons, the lattice is thus essential for any experiments involving random outcome solidification.
obtainWays: Protocol Space: Hazardous Material Management Room
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)

item_char_skill_specialize_4.name: Quadrant Fitting Fluid
item_char_skill_specialize_4.desc: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_specialize_4.decoDesc: A hypothetical condensed matter in fluid state. Though it could be synthesized and the optical properties of the resulting materials could be observed, the actual structure and state of the fluid have yet to be successfully measured. The fluid effectively suppresses Originium sublimation in all Depths that could be artificially created, making it an extraordinarily effective filler.
obtainWays: Crisis Calamity: Ruan Yi - Deep Dive Mode
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)

item_char_skill_specialize_5.name: Triphasic Nanoflake
item_char_skill_specialize_5.desc: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_specialize_5.decoDesc: A device that is extremely sensitive to ambient Originium. It can boost Originium sensitivity of all weapons and devices within a significantly large area. The Triphasic Nanoflake is a key component for containing and storing the Arts, and offers better performance in non-realspace environments compared to the older Bipolar Nanoflakes.
obtainWays: Protocol Space: Hazardous Material Containment Vault
Crisis Calamity: Nefarith - Deep Dive Mode
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)

item_char_skill_specialize_6.name: Warp Plasma-Coated Slide
item_char_skill_specialize_6.desc: A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.
item_char_skill_specialize_6.decoDesc: A plasma distilled and homogenized from a mysterious crystalline material discovered on Talos-II within the recent decade. The material's lattice comprises 5-15% of spacetime bubble analogues and the plasma itself exhibits properties that the academic community has termed existential superposition of macroscopic characteristics. A complex series of artificial selection was used to create this plasma. Currently, the primary use of this material is producing control samples for Depth continuity tests.
obtainWays: Protocol Space: Hazardous Material Dissolving Pool
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills
Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)

item_charpotentialup_chr_0002_endminm.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc: A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0003_endminf.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc: A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0004_pelica.name: Perlica's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: An Originium fragment secreted away. It once belonged to the one she most admires. The fragment bore the hopes of that special someone, and ignited her passion for Protocol-Originium Technology.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0005_chen.name: Chen Qianyu's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: A branch carefully cleaned to remove barbs and bark. She once swung it as a sword when she was but a girl who dreamed of being a hero.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Wulfgard's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0006_wolfgd.decoDesc: An old firearm with obvious signs of modification. He knows where every part is, the conditions in which they work, and how they could be removed so he could use them individually.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0007_ikut.name: Arclight's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: A fowlbeast woodcarving made by the children whom the Songseeker once helped. The Songseekers carry the "hanna" with them and always extend a helping hand towards those who wish to survive. They are like fowlbeasts. Since the winds never cease, the seekers will never quit.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0009_azrila.name: Ember's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: A standard Oathkeeper dagger bearing the marks of many battles. With ice, snow, and mighty peaks as witnesses, the crusade shall continue, and the embers shall be re-ignited.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0011_seraph.name: Xaihi's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: A prayer of a Cabal of Tranquility cleric that Xaihi uses as a bookmark. This bookmark accompanied her as she read through the seemingly endless collection of the Cabal.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0012_avywen.name: Avywenna's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc: A traveler's diary with numerous souvenirs and memorabilia that Avywenna collected from various locations of Talos-II. These include a pinch of dirt from the Old Northern Frontiers, and a group photo with the Endmin glued upon the final page.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0013_aglina.name: Gilberta's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: An intricate scented sachet giving off the refreshing scents of sour citromes and the cloying sweetness of floral petals. Gilberta made this by mixing all sorts of ingredients together. A whiff of the sachet's fragrance reminds people of her smile.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0014_aurora.name: Snowshine's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: An intricate talisman engraved with these words: "May you be forever one step ahead of the storm" — Her wish is to protect precious lives who found themselves hopelessly lost in the snow, help them survive the disaster, escape the dangers, and lead them onto the safe road to home and loved ones.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Lifeng's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: A very old and dog-eared Martial Codex. The book is filled with scribbles that convey a young man's feelings, his hard work and dedication, as well as his hopes and dreams.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0016_laevat.name: Laevatain's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: A piece of paper filled with notes about the places she visited, the people she met, and the things that mattered to her. Freshly made memories are gradually filling up the gaps in her past.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Yvonne's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: A ticket to La Fantoma. You've been invited to enjoy sandy beaches and ocean winds... But that can wait till she completes her research paper about the Ætherside.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0018_dapan.name: Da Pan's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc: A special menu with all sorts of fowls, fins, and everything in between. Da Pan always traveled the lands of Talos-II with his iron wok, and it has been used to prepare delicious food of every cuisine.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0019_karin.name: Akekuri's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0019_karin.decoDesc: A set of Higashinese snacks. Rather than enjoying private moments for nostalgia's sake, she prefers sharing the snacks in other occasions. Examples include visitors of her place, colleagues during work breaks, or teammates at operational deployment briefings.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0020_meurs.name: Catcher's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0020_meurs.decoDesc: A handwritten menu. It is extremely exhaustive, and includes every Z7 teammates' gastronomic preferences, the flavors they like, and things they would not touch with a ten-foot pole.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0021_whiten.name: Estella's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0021_whiten.decoDesc: A psychedelic vinyl that inflicts dizziness and nausea. Estella says the sounds help her sleep. Is that ... actually possible?

item_charpotentialup_chr_0022_bounda.name: Fluorite's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0022_bounda.decoDesc: A small gadget shaped like a bomb. Activate the mechanisms in the right sequence to open the casing and access the candies within. Very nice, if only she would hand out these pleasant "surprises" more often.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0023_antal.name: Antal's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0023_antal.decoDesc: A stash of meticulously kept letters, all written by Antal's grandmother who lives in New Wrankwood far, far away. The letters contain the most mundane greetings, the simplest messages of care, and the warmest lines of longing between members of a loving family.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0024_deepfin.name: Alesh's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0024_deepfin.decoDesc: A very life-like lure. This is Alesh's new trick, one that exudes a lethal-dose of attraction to vicious predatory fins. Nobody knows which of them would bite next.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Ardelia's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: A rock sample mined from the depths of Talos-II. It is a record of this land's geological evolution, a collection of scars from wounds suffered in eons past, and a silent testament of this planet's history.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0026_lastrite.name: Last Rite's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0026_lastrite.decoDesc: A little flower frozen by frigid air. This species is often seen in the town cemetery where Last Rite came from. But since she was the one who gifted this, there shouldn't be other hidden meanings to it.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0027_tangtang.name: Tangtang's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0027_tangtang.decoDesc: An intricate little basket, woven with the sturdiest bamboo of Jingyu Valley. A small handcrafted fin is added to it for decoration. By the way, keep those Tangtang Certs you received from her neatly stacked and safely tucked away. It's an official order from the Chief!

item_charpotentialup_chr_0028_wulfa.name: Rossi's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0028_wulfa.decoDesc: A small, intricate carving knife. Rossi often uses it to sculpt all sorts of legends and heroes. Nobody gets to dictate the future of another. She must decide what to be on her own. That is the key.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0029_pograni.name: Pogranichnik's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0029_pograni.decoDesc: An extremely tattered war banner that once stood amidst the howling cold and fluttered above the fields of snow. In battlefields populated by the living and the dead, this banner had never fallen, no matter how strong the enemy may be.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0030_zhuangfy.name: Zhuang Fangyi's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0030_zhuangfy.decoDesc: A box of special Wuling 10th Anniversary Chubby Lung stickers. The rich blossoms of spring serve as the creative inspirations. Every flower that blooms in Wuling only does so thanks to her devotion and toils.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0031_mifu.name: Mi Fu's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0031_mifu.decoDesc: A kohl gourd bearing obvious signs of use. One can smell the mild fragrance of a good brew after popping open the gourd. A change of role also mandated certain changes in habit. She was unwilling to part with this entirely, so she entrusted this to a good friend for proper safekeeping.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0032_lizhiyan.name: Arcane's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0032_lizhiyan.decoDesc: A red hair tie that has been crudely woven. It is obvious that Arcane has tried it many times, though she always promises that the next attempt will be better.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0033_camille.name: Camille's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0033_camille.decoDesc: A single piece of a jigsaw puzzle sparkling with deep crimson. Camille did not tell you anything about the original puzzle. Perhaps this item is something like a "skeleton key".

item_charpotentialup_chr_0034_typhoea.name: Typhoeus's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0034_typhoea.decoDesc: A branch taken from Myrkwood. A young fowlbeast chick once nestled upon it. She nurtured it till its feathers were grown and returned it to the wilderness. In exchange, Myrkwood allowed her to take the branch, plant it here, and let it take root and sprout.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0035_liino.name: Liino's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0035_liino.decoDesc: An intricately designed ticket to Liino's concert, printed with the idol's exclusive logo. No date has been specified, though. The dawnstar has only given out this special privilege once. It is proof of her trust, and a wish that she has never given words to.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0036_jsspsi.name: Si's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0036_jsspsi.decoDesc: An accounting book that does not look very thick. They say this is the "top secret ledger" of Yuanyuan Innkeeper after all those years in business. However, when you flipped it open for a read, you find instead a casually written set of records and notes about things, sayings, and people that Si cares most about. After all, the principles of running Yuanyuan Manor rest in the name of the inn itself.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0038_purrche.name: Purrchena's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0038_purrche.decoDesc: A cake-shaped medal inscribed with Purrchena's name. It seems to be giving off the sweet smell of a freshly baked cake. But what is this medal for? Excellent grades? For being a Brand Ambassador? Or is it a gift from a patient whom Purrchena once helped? Its purpose may be a mystery, but Purrchena would hold it close, even while asleep. There is no doubt that it is a keepsake of a beautiful experience.

item_charpotentialup_chr_9000_endmin.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_9000_endmin.decoDesc: A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.

item_collection_ether.name: Aurylene of Valley IV
item_collection_ether.desc: A mysterious material you found during exploration. Submit enough of them at any TP Point to get rewards.
item_collection_ether.decoDesc: An Aurylene that can be found in Valley IV. This tiny fragment used to be part of something greater.

item_collection_ether_wuling.name: Aurylene of Wuling
item_collection_ether_wuling.desc: A mysterious material you found during exploration. Submit enough of them at any TP Point to get rewards.
item_collection_ether_wuling.decoDesc: An Aurylene that can be found in Wuling. This tiny fragment used to be part of something greater.

item_collection_frag.name: Æther Manifest Shard
item_collection_frag.decoDesc: A fragment of an object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.

item_collection_instance.name: Æther Manifest
item_collection_instance.decoDesc: An object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.

item_collection_trstar.name: Talosite
item_collection_trstar.desc: A mysterious material you can find and collect during exploration. Submit enough of them at the Talosite Exchange for rewards.
item_collection_trstar.decoDesc: A special energy crystal that can be found at various places of Talos-II. They are highly sought after for scientific research.

item_copper_bottle.name: Cuprium Bottle
item_copper_bottle.desc: A metallic bottle made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for filling fluids.
item_copper_bottle.decoDesc: Cuprium bottles are pretty rare in the market because Cuprium is a more expensive metal than Ferrium.

item_copper_cmpt.name: Cuprium Part
item_copper_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.
item_copper_cmpt.decoDesc: A Cuprium Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_enr.name: Hetonite
item_copper_enr.desc: Hetonite is acquired via replacement-precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_copper_enr.decoDesc: A novel material that sparkles and gleams. The Tianshi have great hopes for this metal and thus named it Hetonite (literal meaning: bright red cuprium). Perhaps they caught a glimpse of hope for humanity within the flaming, crimson hues.

item_copper_enr2.name: Pyrrolite
item_copper_enr2.desc: A solid piece of metal acquired by transmuting Pyrrolite Gas at the Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_copper_enr2.decoDesc: Like Hetonite, this metal has been highlighted for its industrial and manufacturing potential. The Tianshi called it Pyrrolite based on the word "pyrrhos" with the hope that the metal could generate intense heat and give birth to humanity's passion for building a new future.

item_copper_enr2_cmpt.name: Pyrrolite Part
item_copper_enr2_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Pyrrolite. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.
item_copper_enr2_cmpt.decoDesc: A Pyrrolite Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_enr_bottle.name: Hetonite Bottle
item_copper_enr_bottle.desc: A metallic bottle made by moulding Hetonite. Can be used to produce other items.
item_copper_enr_bottle.decoDesc: A metallic bottle that is hardly available on the market. Hetonite has a hue so alluring that even a common Hetonite bottle is considered a collector item for many people.

item_copper_enr_cmpt.name: Hetonite Part
item_copper_enr_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Hetonite. Can be used to produce other items or construct other facilities.
item_copper_enr_cmpt.decoDesc: A Hetonite Part with a wide range of uses.

item_copper_jar.name: Cuprium Canister
item_copper_jar.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_copper_jar.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_copper_nugget.name: Cuprium
item_copper_nugget.desc: A metallic ingot made by refining Cuprium Ore. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_copper_nugget.decoDesc: Smelted Cuprium is no longer soft nor prone to oxidation.

item_copper_ore.name: Cuprium Ore
item_copper_ore.desc: A reddish metal that can be processed with the AIC Factory.
item_copper_ore.decoDesc: A natural mineral complex unique to the Wuling region. Metals acquired by refining this ore form the basis for local industry and production.

item_copper_powder.name: Cuprium Powder
item_copper_powder.desc: Shredded and powdered Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items.
item_copper_powder.decoDesc: Products made using shredded Cuprium yield a more homogenized texture.

item_corp1_animal_1.name: Valley Pie
item_corp1_animal_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_corp1_animal_1.decoDesc: A meat pie. Everyone in Valley IV grew up eating the famous Valley pie. Steaming pies, the stove, and a loving family always bring people hope.

item_corp2_animal_1.name: Meat Stir-Fry
item_corp2_animal_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_corp2_animal_1.decoDesc: Cubes of meat stir-fried over hot fire. A hungry diner can easily go through three bowls of rice with a serving of meat stir-fry. There's a good reason why this is the *most* popular dish in the frontier.

item_corp3_animal_1.name: Ginseng Meat Stew
item_corp3_animal_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_corp3_animal_1.decoDesc: An herbal meal prepared by stewing redjade ginseng roots, meat fillet, and other ingredients. A common winter dish of the Wuling region. When the snow starts falling, a bowl of this hearty stew would offer the warmth you need.

item_corp3_grass1_1.name: Fortifying Infusion
item_corp3_grass1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_corp3_grass1_1.decoDesc: An herbal infusion prepared by decocting redjade ginseng and jincao herbs. Typically consumed to revitalize the body. Many grievously wounded warriors used this decoction to treat various chronic conditions.

item_corp4_animal_1.name: Wuling Fried Rice
item_corp4_animal_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_corp4_animal_1.decoDesc: A mysterious Ursine chef came up with this recipe as he traveled across the lands. It became famous throughout the frontier for its delicious blend of sweetness and heat.

item_corp4_grass2_1.name: Garden Fried Rice
item_corp4_grass2_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_corp4_grass2_1.decoDesc: Fried rice made with less oil and salt to bring out the wholesome flavors of garden greens and vegetables.

item_corp4_spc.name: Rhodes Island Special Ration
item_corp4_spc.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.
item_corp4_spc.decoDesc: A mixed ration of Rhodes Island during the Age of Terra. The one who prepared it is absolutely certain of its authenticity. The production line was salvaged from the ruins of the Aggeloi War, and the replacement ingredients were foraged from various parts of Talos-II. Our memories have never been broken.

item_corp_bean_1.name: Ballpea
item_corp_bean_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_corp_bean_1.decoDesc: A special legume unique to Talos-II. They are called "ballpeas" as the beans are near-perfect spheres. In fact, some board games often use hard ballpeas as their pieces.

item_corp_bean_seed_1.name: Ballpea Seeds
item_corp_bean_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from a Ballpea plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Ballpeas.
item_corp_bean_seed_1.decoDesc: Ballpea seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_cabbage_1.name: Cabbage
item_corp_cabbage_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_corp_cabbage_1.decoDesc: Common leafy vegetables. These variants have good resistance against the cold after many years of intensive selection.

item_corp_cabbage_2.name: Cabbage [A]
item_corp_cabbage_2.desc: This crop is harvested from a Cabbage Plot grown in a crop-refining Xiranite environment. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay. Refined crops are highly prized and rare as they cannot provide seeds that could sustain their quality.
item_corp_cabbage_2.decoDesc: A cabbage of near-perfect quality. The Tianshi of Wuling have great faith in the agricultural applications of Xiranite. This is one of their results.

item_corp_cabbage_seed_1.name: Cabbage Seeds
item_corp_cabbage_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from a cabbage plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Cabbages.
item_corp_cabbage_seed_1.decoDesc: Cabbage seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_cabbage_seed_2.name: Cabbage Seeds [A]
item_corp_cabbage_seed_2.desc: Seeds picked from a Cabbage [A] plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Cabbage [A].
item_corp_cabbage_seed_2.decoDesc: Cabbage [A] seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_canolaflower_1.name: Oilseed Bloom

item_corp_canolaflower_1.decoDesc: A plant with small yet lovely flowers. "A springtime sea of dusky light" is a line of poetry that describes an oilseed field in bloom. The seeds of the plant are often used for oil extraction.

item_corp_canolaflower_seed_1.name: Oilseeds

item_corp_canolaflower_seed_1.decoDesc: Oilseeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_mushroom_1.decoDesc: A special type of fungus colloquially known as the "cap of many faces". People who tasted water-boiled relishrooms have described its flavors in all sorts of very different ways.

item_corp_mushroom_2.name: Relishroom [A]
item_corp_mushroom_2.desc: This crop is harvested from a Relishroom Plot grown in a crop-refining Xiranite environment. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay. Refined crops are highly prized and rare as they cannot provide seeds that could sustain their quality.
item_corp_mushroom_2.decoDesc: Relishroom of near-perfect quality. The Tianshi of Wuling have great faith in the agricultural applications of Xiranite. This is one of their results.

item_corp_mushroom_seed_1.name: Relishroom Spores

item_corp_mushroom_seed_1.decoDesc: Relishroom spores carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_mushroom_seed_2.name: Relishroom Spores [A]
item_corp_mushroom_seed_2.desc: Spores picked from a Relishroom [A]. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Relishrooms [A].
item_corp_mushroom_seed_2.decoDesc: Relishroom [A] spores carefully selected for their vitality.

item_corp_potato_1.name: Pingtuber
item_corp_potato_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_corp_potato_1.decoDesc: A special hybrid crop raised in Talos-II. The tubers can be slightly poisonous without proper preparation.

item_corp_potato_seed_1.name: Pingtuber Cutting
item_corp_potato_seed_1.desc: A cutting of a Pingtuber plant. Cultivate it with crafted farm plots to harvest Pingtubers.
item_corp_potato_seed_1.decoDesc: A Pingtuber cutting carefully selected for its generous size and vitality.

item_corp_strawberry_1.name: Sourberry

item_corp_strawberry_1.decoDesc: A special berry unique to Talos-II. Strictly speaking, sourberries are closely related to strawberries. It is a little sour, but very refreshing as well.

item_corp_strawberry_2.name: Sourberry [A]

item_corp_strawberry_2.decoDesc: Sourberry of near-perfect quality. The Tianshi of Wuling have great faith in the agricultural applications of Xiranite. This is one of their results.

item_corp_strawberry_seed_1.name: Sourberry Seeds
item_corp_strawberry_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from a Sourberry plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Sourberries.
item_corp_strawberry_seed_1.decoDesc: Sourberry seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.
