item_corp_strawberry_seed_2.desc: Seeds picked from a Sourberry [A] plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Sourberries [A].
item_corp_strawberry_seed_2.decoDesc: Sourberry [A] seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_sugarcane_1.name: Crunchcane
item_corp_sugarcane_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_corp_sugarcane_1.decoDesc: A sugarcane cultivar with extremely high sugar content and an apple-like texture. Very popular amongst children.

item_corp_sugarcane_seed_1.name: Crunchcane Cutting
item_corp_sugarcane_seed_1.desc: A cutting of a Crunchcane plant. Cultivate it with crafted farm plots to harvest Crunchcanes.
item_corp_sugarcane_seed_1.decoDesc: A Crunchcane cutting carefully selected for its generous size and vitality.

item_corp_tomato_1.name: Matoberry
item_corp_tomato_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_corp_tomato_1.decoDesc: A new tomato cultivar developed by the UWST Fokka Hydroponic Complex. Matoberries have a well-balanced sweetness and tanginess, making them perfect for soups, stews, and sauces.

item_corp_tomato_seed_1.name: Matoberry Seeds
item_corp_tomato_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from Matoberries. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Matoberries.
item_corp_tomato_seed_1.decoDesc: Matoberry seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_corp_whitegourd_1.name: Whitemelon
item_corp_whitegourd_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_corp_whitegourd_1.decoDesc: A special wintermelon cultivar developed by the Tianshi. The whitemelon has snowy white flesh, lower water content, and richer aroma compared to the usual wintermelon.

item_corp_whitegourd_seed_1.name: Whitemelon Seeds
item_corp_whitegourd_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from a Whitemelon plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Whitemelons.
item_corp_whitegourd_seed_1.decoDesc: Whitemelon seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_crystal_enr.name: Packed Origocrust
item_crystal_enr.desc: A high quality material prepared by refining Dense Origocrust Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_crystal_enr.decoDesc: The Packed Origocrust is a result of multiple processing steps and looks just like a piece of precious "gemstone".

item_crystal_enr_powder.name: Dense Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_enr_powder.desc: Acquired by grinding Origocrust Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_crystal_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to prepare this dense powdered form of Origocrust with particles almost invisible to the unaided eye.

item_crystal_powder.name: Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_powder.desc: Powdered form of Origocrust. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_crystal_powder.decoDesc: Origocrust can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_crystal_shell.name: Origocrust
item_crystal_shell.desc: Crystalline crust acquired by delamination of Originium. Can be used to produce other items.
item_crystal_shell.decoDesc: The thickness of the crystalline crust encasing an Originium formation (referred to as Origocrust) is often used to determine the age of the Originium vein.

item_daily_activation.name: Daily Activity
item_daily_activation.desc: Earn enough of this to receive daily rewards.

item_databasefor006_1.name: Researcher's Notes (1)
item_databasefor006_1.decoDesc:
Originium Gorge Particulate Originium density last year: 0.0321 
Originium Gorge Particulate Originium density this year: 0.0322 
Further testing shows that Originium formations near the gorge are still growing at an anomalous rate.

item_databasefor006_2.name: Researcher's Notes (2)
item_databasefor006_2.decoDesc:
This is really odd. Originium formations are usually stable and would neither metastasize nor grow. But the Originium near the Originium Gorge exhibited signs of slow and steady growth despite normal ambient conditions. 
I don't know what's affecting it. 
We've established a surveillance camp and triangulated the source via our nearby mining sites. All readings point to something within the Originium Gorge. But the Originium formations inside the place are just too thick. It was impossible for us to head in for detailed surveillance. 
Perhaps we can use our prospecting machines. Upgrading them might give us a solution.

item_databasefor006_3.name: Researcher's Notes (3)
item_databasefor006_3.decoDesc: The Blight just ruptured. I don't care about the machines, but I must get the research data out of this place.

item_device_balloon_recycle_1.name: Aero-Salvager Ⅰ
item_device_balloon_recycle_1.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to lift and salvage small items.
item_device_balloon_recycle_1.decoDesc: A T1 toolkit for optimizing aero-salvaging systems.

item_device_balloon_recycle_2.name: Aero-Salvager Ⅱ
item_device_balloon_recycle_2.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to lift and salvage small to medium-sized items.
item_device_balloon_recycle_2.decoDesc: A T2 toolkit for optimizing aero-salvaging systems.

item_device_balloon_recycle_3.name: Aero-Salvager Ⅲ
item_device_balloon_recycle_3.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to lift and salvage small, medium, and large-sized items.
item_device_balloon_recycle_3.decoDesc: A T3 toolkit for optimizing aero-salvaging systems.

item_device_buff_ink_1.name: 4FT Qi Cultivation Scroll
item_device_buff_ink_1.desc: Place this in the personal device slot of the Backpack to grant 5 SP/s regeneration after entering battle in the region of Wuling. Duration: 5s.
item_device_buff_ink_1.decoDesc: An old painting by Si. It measures four feet in length, and depicts a bright, beautiful landscape that invigorates one's spirit.

item_device_buff_ink_2.name: 5FT Qi Cultivation Scroll
item_device_buff_ink_2.desc: Place this in the personal device slot of the Backpack to grant 7 SP/s regeneration after entering battle in the region of Wuling. Duration: 5s.
item_device_buff_ink_2.decoDesc: An old painting by Si. It measures five feet in length, and depicts a bright, beautiful landscape that invigorates one's spirit.

item_device_buff_ink_3.name: 6FT Qi Cultivation Scroll
item_device_buff_ink_3.desc: Place this in the personal device slot of the Backpack to grant 10 SP/s regeneration after entering battle in the region of Wuling. Duration: 5s.
item_device_buff_ink_3.decoDesc: An old painting by Si. It measures six feet in length, and depicts a bright, beautiful landscape that invigorates one's spirit.

item_device_buff_snow_1.name: Speed Booster [S]
item_device_buff_snow_1.desc: Place this device in the Backpack's personal device slot to give Stamina Regeneration <@ba.vup>+10%</>. This only works in Wuling.
item_device_buff_snow_1.decoDesc: An intricate prototype Arts Unit developed by Samivegr. It stimulates the user's muscles to improve their athletic mobility.

item_device_buff_snow_2.name: Speed Booster [M]
item_device_buff_snow_2.desc: Place this device in the Backpack's personal device slot to give Stamina Regeneration <@ba.vup>+15%</>. This only works in Wuling.
item_device_buff_snow_2.decoDesc: A suitably-sized prototype Arts Unit developed by Samivegr. It stimulates the user's muscles to improve their athletic mobility.

item_device_buff_snow_3.name: Speed Booster [L]
item_device_buff_snow_3.desc: Place this device in the Backpack's personal device slot to give Stamina Regeneration <@ba.vup>+20%</>. This only works in Wuling.
item_device_buff_snow_3.decoDesc: A pretty heavy prototype Arts Unit developed by Samivegr. It stimulates the user's muscles to improve their athletic mobility.

item_device_xiranite_nexus_1.name: Xiranite Nexus
item_device_xiranite_nexus_1.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to gain protection against the Blight Miasma of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.
item_device_xiranite_nexus_1.decoDesc: A device for countering the effects of Blight and the Very Large Rift. Years of scientific research and development in Wuling finally bore fruit.

item_device_xiranite_nexus_2.name: Xiranite Nexus XC-Ⅰ
item_device_xiranite_nexus_2.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to gain protection against the Blight Miasma of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. The device now has 450 Blight Miasma Tolerance.
item_device_xiranite_nexus_2.decoDesc: A device for countering the effects of the Blight and the Very Large Rift. Years of scientific research and development in Wuling finally bore fruit. The XC (expanded capacity) upgrade to the original internal storage unit allows it to carry more Xiranite.

item_device_xiranite_nexus_3.name: Xiranite Nexus XC-Ⅱ
item_device_xiranite_nexus_3.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to gain protection against the Blight Miasma of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. The device now has 600 Blight Miasma Tolerance.
item_device_xiranite_nexus_3.decoDesc: A device for countering the effects of the Blight and the Very Large Rift. Years of scientific research and development in Wuling finally bore fruit. The second XC (expanded capacity) upgrade made adjustments to the internal circuitry and cooling unit to improve operational efficiency.

item_device_xiranite_radar_1.name: Blight Miasma Scanner Plugin
item_device_xiranite_radar_1.desc: Place it in the personal device slot of the Backpack to expand Xiranite Nexus scanning range and speed up scanning actions.
item_device_xiranite_radar_1.decoDesc: A special plugin for the Xiranite Nexus. Human senses may deceive, but cold, hard data is always honest.

item_diamond.name: Oroberyl
item_diamond.desc: An artificial material often used for recruiting operators.
item_diamond.decoDesc: A special product of cut Origeometry. These stones are extremely popular due to their beauty and wide range of uses.

item_dog_1_slimeml_1_1.name: Stew Meeting
item_dog_1_slimeml_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.
item_dog_1_slimeml_1_1.decoDesc: A basin full of "criminally generous riches". It is obvious that this is prepared with more than one type of meat. Help yourself to a bowl or two. Such normal-looking food is a rarity, considering it was made in a hostile environment.

item_dog_hsmob_corp_1.name: Tian's Braised Meat Noodles
item_dog_hsmob_corp_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the HP of every operator in the team.
item_dog_hsmob_corp_1.decoDesc: Braised meat noodles prepared with traditional methods, innovative elements, and fresh local produce of Wuling. A bowl of nostalgic flavors achieved via easy-to-learn steps. A brand new take on a well-loved dish from the past!

item_domain_jinlong_coupon.name: Wuling Stock Bill
item_domain_jinlong_coupon.desc: Stock bills issued in Wuling and only usable in the said region. They have all sorts of uses.
item_domain_jinlong_coupon.decoDesc: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all Accordatories shall, while ensuring the unimpeded circulation of Talosian Credit Notes in the civilian economy, maintain commodity stockpiles to cover the issuance of such stock bills, thereby facilitating orderly and effective joint stockpile redistribution under exceptional circumstances.

item_domain_jinlong_exp.name: Wuling Regional Development Metric
item_domain_jinlong_exp.desc: Construction and development work in Wuling will raise this development metric. This can raise the Regional Development Level to provide a generous reward.
item_domain_jinlong_exp.decoDesc: The mark of regional development in Wuling. The proof of the hard work and sacrifices made by every contributor.

item_domain_tundra_coupon.name: Valley Stock Bill
item_domain_tundra_coupon.desc: Stock bills issued in Valley IV and only usable in the said region. They have all sorts of uses.
item_domain_tundra_coupon.decoDesc: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all signatories shall, in addition to simultaneously guaranteeing that Talosian Credit Notes provide a currency circulation sufficient for the civil economy, guarantee a commodity stockpile sufficient for the agreed-upon supply of such types of allocation orders so as to achieve an orderly and effective joint allocation during extraordinary circumstances.
obtainWays: Reward: Valley IV Pack and Deliver

item_domain_tundra_exp.name: Valley Regional Development Metric
item_domain_tundra_exp.desc: Construction and development work in Valley IV will raise this development metric. This can raise the Regional Development Level to provide a generous reward.
item_domain_tundra_exp.decoDesc: The mark of regional development in Valley IV. The proof of the hard work and sacrifices made by every contributor.
obtainWays: Reward: Valley IV Pack and Deliver

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_1.name: Wuling Frozen Pears [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_1.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_1.decoDesc:
Rumors say that Wuling City grade schoolers can tell actual frozen fruits from those processed and made with Originium Arts. 
Do not lie to the children.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_10.name: Swordmancer Forge [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_10.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_10.decoDesc: A forge specifically designed by the Bureau of Swordmancers for cold steel weapons. It is easily portable and offers extremely intense heat. An effective solution for any logistics team trying to offer weapon repairs and maintenance in the field.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_11.name: Xiranite Bridge [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_11.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_11.decoDesc: A "floating bridge" made using Xiranite. Simply set the abutments at both ends, let the Xiranite extend forth to make the bridge, and traverse the chasm without fear.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_12.name: Marker Stone Lock [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_12.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_12.decoDesc: A civilian version of defense systems employed at the Main Pillar. Marker Stone devices can link to local facility security systems to create the perfect barrier.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_13.name: Chubby Lung Blimp [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_13.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_13.decoDesc: A large meteorological Chubby Lung blimp. O Chubby Lung, how majestic thou art! All shall look upon thee and be awed by the wuv-wuv-wuv!

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_14.name: Tianshi Pillar Cores [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_14.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_14.decoDesc: Since Xiranite yields are no longer a concern, selling and marketing these miniaturized Tianshi Pillars became possible. The scientists' efforts are finally paying off. Comes in either Standard or Type-C models.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_2.name: Eureka Anti-smog Tincture [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_2.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_2.decoDesc: This Eureka Teashop product has been hampered by poor sales. Most consumers criticized it for its strangely sour and bitter taste. But one day came when people started believing it has the abilities to alleviate the discomfort caused by being too close to the Blight.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_3.name: Nymphsprout [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_3.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_3.decoDesc: "A hibernating nymph in winter, a budding sprout by summer." — Sishi Zhulinchong Kaolue (literally translated as: A Study of Grovenymphs in Different Seasons)

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_4.name: Wuxia Movies [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_4.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_4.decoDesc: Video tapes of top rated movies in Wuling. This anthology of six Wuxia thrillers (with a narrative structure inspired by that used in The Six Cases) illustrates the founding and history of Wuling. In fact, this anthology is publicly acclaimed as the easiest way to learn about Wuling City. Though one can readily find this anthology in many households, recent sales have spiked for reasons unknown.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_5.name: Chubby Lung Tianshi [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_5.desc: A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_5.decoDesc: A cute and lovely keychain fob featuring Chubby Lung — Honorary Tianshi, mascot of Wuling City, and ultimate winner of the Band Mascot Championships. Altogether, 36 varieties have been officially released thus far. Completing the Chubby Lung collection is a quest undertaken by Wulingers of every age.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_6.name: Xiran-Hue Fireworks [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_6.desc: A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_6.decoDesc: These fireworks explode into blossoms of brilliant Xiranite jade. Unfortunately, the manufacturer has not added any actual Xiranite to cut costs.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_7.name: Xiranite Filter Cores [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_7.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_7.decoDesc: A classical example of successfully adapting Wuling Xiranite technology for civilian water purification. These water filter cores are one of the reasons why Wuling is a household name in Talos-II.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_8.name: Qingbo Rafts [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_8.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_8.decoDesc: A family version of the Wuling Outskirts bamboo raft. Since this is an export version, it comes with a Xiranite hybrid drive technology. Many residents in coastal cities purchased the raft to take part in the Siesta Surfing Festival.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_9.name: Aerial Receptionists [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_9.desc: A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_9.decoDesc: A suite of advertising drones. A Wuling proprietor received customer complaints when he added the drones to the waiting staff and made them play ads non-stop.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_1.name: Ankhorilling Kitchenware [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_1.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_1.decoDesc: This set of kitchen utensils is only related to Ankhors because they were made using raw materials derived from Ankhors. During the First Aggeloi War, people who lack metal would kill Aggeloi that spawned in metal-rich environments, then use their remains to make kitchenware. Ankhorilling pots and pans feature smooth, non-stick surfaces, zero pits, and great thermal conductance. These excellent properties ensure that Ankhor-based kitchenware crafting gets passed on till this very day.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_10.name: Originium Saplings [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_10.desc: A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to massive price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_10.decoDesc: An Originium formation that looks like a young sapling. After the destruction of the Great Originium Oak, the UWST began farming these saplings on a large scale. Each of them has a chance of growing into a new Oak. Though hardly any saplings showed any sign of growth, they remain highly sought after by Originium scientists from across the world.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_11.name: Vigilant Pickaxes [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_11.desc: A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to massive price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_11.decoDesc: Pickaxes commonly used by miners working in Valley IV. They are fitted with special alarms that give off sharp warning sounds if the pickaxe sustains damage due to undetectable Blight in rock formations.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_12.name: Hard Noggin Helmets [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_12.desc: A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to massive price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_12.decoDesc: "Hard Noggin. Guaranteed to keep your head in one piece."

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_2.name: Musbeast Scrimshaw Dangles [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_2.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_2.decoDesc: An ornamental dangle made using musbeast bones carved into various shapes. During early development of Valley IV, Sarkaz workers were employed to support various projects. Before concluding their contracts, the Sarkaz would present fellow Valley IV crew mates with musbeast scrimshaw dangles carved into the shapes of various machines. Witchcraft within the dangles also lets them float temporarily above Originium batteries. The dangles gradually became a common piece of decor in major cities and frontier areas of the Civilization Band.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_3.name: Witchcraft Mining Drill [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_3.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_3.decoDesc: A rather primitive machine jointly developed by the UWST and Seš'qa. These drills are often made using Origocrust imbued with witchcraft and commonly installed on the transport belts of various Originium factories. They can penetrate Origocrusts effectively without damaging the mineral kernel.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_4.name: Aggeloi War Tins [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_4.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_4.decoDesc: These tinned provisions date all the way back to the end of the First Aggeloi War, which means they have been around for more than a century. Please do not open or consume its contents. They are meant to provide spiritual encouragement far more satisfying than a filled belly.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_5.name: Valley Hydroculture Fillets [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_5.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_5.decoDesc:
Scientifically inspired by the myosin hydrocultures of Originium agricultural research. These fillets are grown in the meat-packing plants in the regions around Valley IV. 
Please overlook the fact that the flavor, texture, and gastronomic trauma of hydroculture fillets are akin to those inflicted by soggy bread. These fillets are at least capable of peristaltic locomotion that lets them slowly squirm across a table.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_6.name: Unity Syrup [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_6.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_6.decoDesc: A stash of orally administered syrups for Oripathy prophylaxis. In Talos-II, a daily regimen of the prophylactic syrup can effectively reduce the risks of contracting Oripathy.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_7.name: Seš'qamam Knucklebones [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_7.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_7.decoDesc: A toy made in Seš'qa. The player starts by calling out the result of a throw. If they miss, the witchcraft of the knucklebones will cause a flower to sprout on the head of the player. The flower lasts for 30 minutes.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_8.name: Astarron Crystals [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_8.desc: A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_8.decoDesc: Blocks of crystals found within the remains of the giant Aggelos that once attacked Valley IV. Most were moved to various institutions for research and testing. However, given the beauteous appearances and ample supply of the crystals, many were fashioned into brooches, necklaces, and other jewelry by the workers.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_9.name: Scrap Toy Blocks [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_9.desc: A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to massive price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_9.decoDesc: A set of building blocks made using scrap stone, metal, and wood. Many workers spent their break time (when they're not dismantling the Aggeloi or recycling various resources) building various things with all sorts of easy-to-find scraps. Someone eventually took this concept and created a franchise of toys out of it.

item_drop_agdisk_1.name: Conductive Effigy Stone
item_drop_agdisk_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Effigies. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_agdisk_1.decoDesc: Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered around an Effigy's halo. The stones exhibit excellent thermal conductance. Heat sinks made out of them are quite popular on the market.

item_drop_agfly_1.name: Hollow Aggagrit
item_drop_agfly_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Falsewings. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_agfly_1.decoDesc: Aggagrit that can be occasionally harvested from Aggeloid "elytrons". Its flavor differs from other types of Aggagrit and many find it incredibly difficult to describe. Most would eventually arrive at this conclusion: "Maybe this is the taste of the sky."

item_drop_agmelee_1.name: Hard Aggagrit
item_drop_agmelee_1.desc: Gatherable from Rams or Heavy Rams. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_agmelee_1.decoDesc: Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered from the Aggeloi's "ramming horns". They can be used as a food marinade to give it special flavors.

item_drop_agrange_1.name: Energized Aggagrit
item_drop_agrange_1.desc: Gatherable from Stings or Heavy Stings. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_agrange_1.decoDesc: Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered from the Aggeloi's "energy-focusing tail stingers". They can be used as a food marinate to give it special flavors.

item_drop_agshield_1.name: Natural Chrysopolis Ingot
item_drop_agshield_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Walking Chrysopolises. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_agshield_1.decoDesc: A unique alloy that can be acquired by cutting out Aggeloid "shield armor". The Tianshi have realized that the metal is extremely dense and has Hetonite-like properties.

item_drop_babyents_1.name: Tender Moss
item_drop_babyents_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Woodcraft Wanderer. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_babyents_1.decoDesc: A young, tender moss plant. It can grow and cover witchcraft creations to grant them camouflaging effects. Please do not eat the moss raw.

item_drop_dog_1.name: Fillet
item_drop_dog_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Wild Tuskbeasts or Bonekrusher Ripptusks. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_dog_1.decoDesc: A piece of fillet. It seems pretty fresh.

item_drop_enemycommon_1.name: Decryption Crystal
item_drop_enemycommon_1.desc: A special crystal for recording all sorts of combat data usually dropped by defeated enemies (higher level enemies will drop more). These crystals can be used for gear assembly.
item_drop_enemycommon_1.decoDesc: The HQ provides gear design drawings while decryption crystals offer the necessary environmental readings. Combine these 2 to properly assemble a proper piece of Endfield gear.

item_drop_erhound_1.name: Pungent Jerky
item_drop_erhound_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Hazefyre Tuskbeasts and Hazefyre Claws. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_erhound_1.decoDesc: Dried, marinated jerky that looks obviously abnormal due to prolonged exposure to hazefyre. Eating this is NOT advised. However, you may consider using it as backup firewood.

item_drop_ethillu_1.name: Echoing Dust
item_drop_ethillu_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Æthillu. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_ethillu_1.decoDesc: It walked here, each footstep stirring up whirls of dust that became both its echoes and proof that it once existed upon this world.

item_drop_firebat_1.name: Chromatic Lipids
item_drop_firebat_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Arsonists. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_firebat_1.decoDesc: A special backup fuel usually equipped and used by Bonekrusher Arsonists. It seems to be beast fat mixed with a certain dye. During periods of slim production and/or raiding, Landbreakers would occasionally acquire lipids from "local sources".

item_drop_hsbear_1.name: Howlerbeast Braid
item_drop_hsbear_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Skydrummers. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_hsbear_1.decoDesc: Braids collected from the nape of the howlerbeast. When howling, the howlerbeast would quickly inhale vast volumes of air. These braids would help to keep out the dust and protect the vocal organs in the neck.

item_drop_hscrane_1.name: Grovenymph Pupa
item_drop_hscrane_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Cloud Stalkers or Nimbus Razors. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_hscrane_1.decoDesc: Grovenymph pupae are high in protein. Although this one has escaped the fate of becoming a nymphsprout, it is a quality food ingredient and might end up as something else.

item_drop_hsfly_1.name: Waterlamp Glowbulb
item_drop_hsfly_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Waterlamps. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_hsfly_1.decoDesc: The glowing organ of the waterlamp. The fluids within it can be used as an edible dye. Essential for the final garnish for the famous Wuling dessert resembling the Tianshi Pillar.

item_drop_hshog_1.name: Quillbeast Liver
item_drop_hshog_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Quillbeasts. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_hshog_1.decoDesc: A tender piece of liver. Almost every tissue of the quillbeast is mildly toxic. Its liver is the only exception.

item_drop_hsmino_1.name: Qingbo Bamboo Chimes
item_drop_hsmino_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Hill Smashers. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_hsmino_1.decoDesc: A set of "chimes" made with bamboo. Some Stockaders would handcraft these "chimes" to pay respects to those who have passed away. Hence, these chimes serve as vessels of their yearning, and "sing the songs" of flowing water.

item_drop_hsmob_1.name: Young Bamboo Sprout
item_drop_hsmob_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Road Plunderers or Grove Archers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_hsmob_1.decoDesc: Freshly harvested young bamboo sprouts from Qingbo Stockade. Tender, refreshing, and delicious. This quality food ingredient is famed throughout Talos-II.

item_drop_hstiger_1.name: Rakerbeast Longfur
item_drop_hstiger_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Spotted Rakerbeast. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_hstiger_1.decoDesc: Fine, fluffy fur collected from near the frontal paws of the rakerbeast. A rakerbeast would spend a lot of time grooming the "iridescent" part of its fur. You can even see threads of residual blood of unfortunate prey within the gaps.

item_drop_hvybow_1.name: Haze-Soaked Ballista
item_drop_hvybow_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Ballistas. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_hvybow_1.decoDesc: A super heavy crossbow "soaked" in hazefyre for many years. Given safety considerations, using this as a weapon is NOT advised. However, wildly unconventional weapons designed by Landbreakers are highly sought after by various collectors.

item_drop_inkbiter_1.name: Ink Droplet
item_drop_inkbiter_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Fortune's Stashes and Scrolls of Tactics. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_inkbiter_1.decoDesc: A part of the Ink Spirits, a droplet of ink influenced by Feranmut powers. Perhaps the ink used in its creation is of extremely high quality, as it emanates a fine, flowery aroma.

item_drop_inkkirin_1.name: Calamity's Raindew
item_drop_inkkirin_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Simmer's Purges. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_inkkirin_1.decoDesc: "Raindew" may drop from ink clouds unleashed by Simmer's Purge. The fluids carry live arcs of electricity and should be carefully carried in an insulated container.

item_drop_inklion_1.name: Edified Jade Orb
item_drop_inklion_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Maned Measures. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_inklion_1.decoDesc: An extremely extravagant jade orb once carried atop the back of a Maned Measure. People have reported hearing sounds that resemble the recitation of poetry and codices when they get close to such objects.

item_drop_jzmonk_1.name: Century Rind
item_drop_jzmonk_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Rockhowlers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_jzmonk_1.decoDesc: A rockhowler found this citrus rind from some forgotten ruins. It seems more than a century old. Its medicinal powers must be great indeed.

item_drop_jzogre_1.name: Caudal Goldscales
item_drop_jzogre_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Armored Manglerbeasts. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_jzogre_1.decoDesc: Hidden scales from the tip of an armored manglerbeast's tail. Such scales are highly sought after for their hue that resembles that of amalgam gold. The polished scales can also be made into picks for musical instruments.

item_drop_klbuds_1.name: Shadow Dew
item_drop_klbuds_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated YSTF Vanguard Blightshades and YSTF Elite Blightshades. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_klbuds_1.decoDesc: This strangely colored fluid is produced when water vapor condenses under the influence of Blightshades. When Blightshades stop moving and stand still, water vapor often condenses along the edges of their weapons.

item_drop_klcaps_1.name: Glaive Fragment
item_drop_klcaps_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated YSTF Glaiver Blightshades and YSTF Captain Blightshades. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_klcaps_1.decoDesc: This fragment of a polearm looks utterly broken and seems to be on the verge of total disintegration. A special container must be used to retain its current shape. Nevertheless, it offers an important sample for the study of Blightshades.

item_drop_klcreatures_1.name: Blightshade Bezoar
item_drop_klcreatures_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Tuskbeast Blightshades, Quillbeast Blightshades, and Rakerbeast Blightshades. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_klcreatures_1.decoDesc: Such material is usually found after a defeated beast-form Blightshade dissipates. It shares similar properties to Aggagrit. There is no telling if these lingering shades retain their beastly instincts. The stone-like material might be "food" that they were holding in their mouths or gullets.

item_drop_lbmob_1.name: Powdered Grass Seed
item_drop_lbmob_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Raiders, Bonekrusher Ballistas, or Bonekrusher Infiltrators. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_lbmob_1.decoDesc: A can of dried powder with bits of seed chaffs and coats. The powder is slightly toxic and the Landbreakers seem to consume it like an "instant energy drink mix". However, there is no discounting the possibility that the powder might be used as seasoning.

item_drop_lbroshan_1.name: Siegeknuckles Gauntlets
item_drop_lbroshan_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_lbroshan_1.decoDesc: A pair of experimental gauntlets equipped by Bonekrusher Siegeknuckles, crafted from miniature siege weapons. The Landbreakers obviously care little about user experience. These gauntlets would dig deep into their wearers' flesh and give them an incredible amount of pain.

item_drop_lbshamman_1.name: Cartilage Bit
item_drop_lbshamman_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Pyromancers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_lbshamman_1.decoDesc: Crushed beast cartilage. Bonekrusher Pyromancers would usually use this as "fuel" for their denstacks. However, hazefyre is not produced by burning cartilage. Rather, the pyromancers burn the beasts' remains as a means of convincing themselves of their victory at hand.

item_drop_lbshield_1.name: Bitter Flour
item_drop_lbshield_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Vanguards. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_lbshield_1.decoDesc: Extremely poor quality flour of unknown ingredients. Overall color is a strange, grayish hue. The Landbreakers seem to have added some dried fungal powder to this mix as the sack of flour exudes a moldy smell.

item_drop_lbtough_1.name: Shattered Axe Blade
item_drop_lbtough_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Bonekrusher Executioners. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_lbtough_1.decoDesc: The dried bloodstains serve as a proof of its past. The terror and zealotry it once personified are now yours.

item_drop_mimicw_1.name: Nidwyrm Whiskers
item_drop_mimicw_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Tunneling Nidwyrms. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_mimicw_1.decoDesc: Nidwyrms have "whiskers" growing on their heads. These appendages appear like tree roots and serve as sensory organs. These whiskers are naturally shed when spring gives way to summer. Although they offer limited nutritional value, they have an incredible texture.

item_drop_sandb_1.name: Axehorn
item_drop_sandb_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Axe Armorbeasts. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_sandb_1.decoDesc: The massive horn of the Axe Armorbeast broken during intense battle. Warriors would only drop their weapons when slain. The same applies to Axe Armorbeasts.

item_drop_slimeml_1.name: Slug Meat
item_drop_slimeml_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Pincerbeasts, Acid Originium Slugs, and Firemist Originium Slugs. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_slimeml_1.decoDesc: This meat is rich in protein but must be meticulously prepared to remove all active Originium dust and particles from the tissues.

item_drop_slwood_1.name: Slug Sprig
item_drop_slwood_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Woodcraft Slug. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_slwood_1.decoDesc: A young, tender sprig and the most verdant part of many witchcraft creations. The sprig gives off an aroma. Though some may find it a little pungent, many master chefs have used them to come up with rather creative recipes.

item_drop_wgabyss_1.name: Instant Vintage
item_drop_wgabyss_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Tidalklasts. Can be used at a depot node for Pack and Deliver.
item_drop_wgabyss_1.decoDesc: A strange liquid capable of inducing temporary tipsiness to those who sniffed it more than once. The fluid won the accolade of "smelling like a fine, eighty-year-old vintage" when some busybody gifted it to a kohlic beverage specialist. However, everyone knows that Aggelos formation is a process far, far shorter than that.

item_drop_wgshoal_1.name: Black Treacle
item_drop_wgshoal_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Tidewalkers. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_wgshoal_1.decoDesc: A black liquid with an incredibly sweet and cloying taste. The primary contents identified through analyses are currently referred to as "artificial sweeteners".

item_drop_wgslime_1.name: Resilient Water
item_drop_wgslime_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Mudflows. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_wgslime_1.decoDesc: A strange form of water. Although wholly composed of dihydrogen monoxide, it felt strangely gel-like to the touch. Perhaps the process of Aggeloid formation has induced strange changes to the properties of this material.

item_drop_wgthorns_1.name: Natural Sparkling Water
item_drop_wgthorns_1.desc: Gatherable from defeated Hedrons or Prisms. Can be used to make fine food and medicine (Fine F&M).
item_drop_wgthorns_1.decoDesc: This natural sparkling water has a strange fizz. It is cool, refreshing, and reinvigorating when consumed.

item_e1m1_treasure.name: TEMP: Super Valuable Cargo
item_e1m1_treasure.decoDesc: TEMP: Super valuable cargo. Seems to contain some unknown medication emitting a green glow.

item_e2m2_ID.name: Park Access Card
item_e2m2_ID.desc: An access card for opening the gate of the Originium Science Park.
item_e2m2_ID.decoDesc: An access card from Aleeza Collins. It might be useful in the Originium Science Park.

item_e3m3_Key.name: Authorization Keycard
item_e3m3_Key.desc: Crowe needs this authorization keycard to activate the special signal emitter and send out the Utjug Order.
item_e3m3_Key.decoDesc: An authorization keycard paired with the special signal emitter for the Utjug Order. It has been stained with someone's blood.

item_e3m3_LT.name: Utjug Signal Emitter
item_e3m3_LT.desc: Crowe needs this special signal emitter to send out the Utjug Order.
item_e3m3_LT.decoDesc: An ordinary looking signal emitter, but it sports a bright red button that hints at great danger.

item_equip_enhance_wuling.name: Wuling Artificing Catalyst
item_equip_enhance_wuling.desc: A gear artificing material. Use it to perform artificing on a piece of Wuling gear.
item_equip_enhance_wuling.decoDesc: A metallurgical catalyst designed for the ambient conditions of Wuling. The catalyst's formula has been adjusted to fit humid environments of Wuling as they exert minute influences on the artificing process. This further proves that the Arsenal release products of the most reliable quality.

item_equip_script_1.name: Amethyst Component
item_equip_script_1.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_1.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. Amethyst is the main material used for producing this.

item_equip_script_2.name: Ferrium Component
item_equip_script_2.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_2.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with ferrium for better ejection than the common variant.

item_equip_script_3.name: Cryston Component
item_equip_script_3.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_3.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with cryston for easier use.

item_equip_script_4.name: Xiranite Component
item_equip_script_4.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Highly Transparent Xiranite Mould. The main materials for constructing this are Packed Origocrust and Xiranite. This mould offers better data transduction when compared to the standard variant.

item_equip_script_4_1.name: Cuprium Component
item_equip_script_4_1.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4_1.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Cuprium is the main material used for producing this.

item_equip_script_4_2.name: Hetonite Component
item_equip_script_4_2.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4_2.decoDesc: The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Hetonite is the main material used for producing this. It also features higher Xiranite capacity than its cuprium counterpart.

item_equip_script_4_3.name: Pyrrolite Component
item_equip_script_4_3.desc: A gear component made using various materials. Can be used for gear assembly.
item_equip_script_4_3.decoDesc: The full name of this component is a Multifaceted Core-Adaptive Single-Use Xiranite Mould. Pyrrolite is the main material used for producing this. It also features higher Xiranite capacity than its lower tier counterparts.

item_erhound_1_agmelee_1_moss_1_1.name: Hazefyre Blossom
item_erhound_1_agmelee_1_moss_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_erhound_1_agmelee_1_moss_1_1.decoDesc: Despite looking edible, we do not recommend eating this. This is a smoked "plant" prepared by using hazefyre-tainted jerky in place of sawdust and special aggagrit to replace sugar. Only the "bravest of the brave" would dare try it.

item_ethillu_1_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.name: Echoing Remedy
item_ethillu_1_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_ethillu_1_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.decoDesc: A mysterious remedy prepared using an improved formula based on ancient recipes. It can enhance the senses of its user.

item_expcard_stage1_high.name: Advanced Combat Record
item_expcard_stage1_high.desc: A material that provides a lot of EXP for leveling up Lv.1-60 operators.
item_expcard_stage1_high.decoDesc: A storage device with combat video recordings. New operators can use this to acquire combat knowledge. This is also furnished with simulations of historical battles so that viewers can better appreciate the brutal nature of actual wars fought upon Talos-II.

item_expcard_stage1_low.name: Elementary Combat Record
item_expcard_stage1_low.desc: A material that provides some EXP for leveling up Lv.1-60 operators.
item_expcard_stage1_low.decoDesc: A storage device with combat video recordings. New operators can use this to acquire combat knowledge.

item_expcard_stage1_mid.name: Intermediate Combat Record
item_expcard_stage1_mid.desc: A material that provides decent EXP for leveling up Lv.1-60 operators.
item_expcard_stage1_mid.decoDesc: A storage device with combat video recordings. New operators can use this to acquire combat knowledge. The end of each recording also features interviews conducted with operators who excelled in various training exercises.

item_expcard_stage2_high.name: Advanced Cognitive Carrier
item_expcard_stage2_high.desc: A material that provides a lot of EXP for leveling up Lv.61-90 operators.
item_expcard_stage2_high.decoDesc: A data storage unit developed by Endfield Industries. It is compatible with various data access devices. New operators can use it to effectively acquire combat knowledge. Thanks to support offered by the Cabal of Tranquility, this carrier features data compression technology and thus stores even more information.

item_expcard_stage2_low.name: Elementary Cognitive Carrier
item_expcard_stage2_low.desc: A material that provides some EXP for leveling up Lv.61-90 operators.
item_expcard_stage2_low.decoDesc: A data storage unit developed by Endfield Industries. It is compatible with various data access devices. New operators can use it to effectively acquire combat knowledge.

item_f1m4_book.name: Roman's Food Processing Notes
item_f1m4_book.desc: Roman used his life-long experience to record various techniques for processing edible plants local to Valley IV.
item_f1m4_book.decoDesc: A thick stack of notes. The handwriting is messy but the sketch was meticulously done. The author devoted quite a bit of effort to recall and jot down all sorts of details.

item_f1m4d1_book.name: Roman's Food Processing Notes
item_f1m4d1_book.desc: Roman used his life-long experience to record various techniques for processing edible plants local to Valley IV.
item_f1m4d1_book.decoDesc: A thick stack of notes. The handwriting is messy but the sketch was meticulously done. The author devoted quite a bit of effort to recall and jot down all sorts of details.

item_f1m7_Medi.name: Herbal Inhalation Agent
item_f1m7_Medi.desc: A medicinal preparation made using an unknown herb acquired from the Landbreakers.
item_f1m7_Medi.decoDesc: A medicinal preparation made using an unknown herb by Dusthair Jin. It is very invigorating and can alleviate Blight-induced hallucinations.

item_factech_conditioner_maxflow.name: Item Flow Adjuster
item_factech_conditioner_maxflow.desc: This template unlocks the Adjust Flow feature of Item Control Ports.

item_factech_jinlong_key.name: Wuling Expansion Core
item_factech_jinlong_key.desc: Unlocks the next phase of the Wuling AIC Plan.
item_factech_jinlong_key.decoDesc: A special device containing environmental data of the Wuling region. Connect this to the Automation-Core to expand its data processing capabilities.

item_factech_jinlong_point.name: Wuling AIC Index
item_factech_jinlong_point.desc: These index points are required to research various AIC technologies in the Wuling AIC Plan.
item_factech_jinlong_point.decoDesc: A small electrical device that records AIC Factory performance in the Wuling region. Connect it to the Automation-Core to adjust Techno-Protocol deployment balance.

item_factech_pipe_conditioner_maxflow.name: Pipeline Flow Adjuster
item_factech_pipe_conditioner_maxflow.desc: This template unlocks the Adjust Flow feature of Pipe Control Ports.

item_factech_rift_research.name: Anthology of Research on the Very Large Rift
item_factech_rift_research.desc: A data chip containing an anthology of research data on the Very Large Rift. This trove contains every single project that the Tianshi of Wuling have tirelessly worked on ever since the founding of the Wuling Science Station.

item_factech_tundra_bus_lv1.name: Depot Bus I
item_factech_tundra_bus_lv1.desc: Sets down a Depot Bus at the Core AIC Area of the Valley IV Protocol Automation-Core (PAC).

item_factech_tundra_bus_lv2.name: Depot Bus II
item_factech_tundra_bus_lv2.desc: Expands the Depot bus at the Core AIC Area of the Valley IV Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) to its maximum length.

item_factech_tundra_diffuser_connectable.name: Pylon Relaying
item_factech_tundra_diffuser_connectable.desc: Unlocks the power transmission feature of Electric Pylons.

item_factech_tundra_field_lv1.name: Expansion I
item_factech_tundra_field_lv1.desc: Further expands the Core AIC Area of the Valley IV Automation-Core.

item_factech_tundra_field_lv2.name: Expansion II
item_factech_tundra_field_lv2.desc: Maximizes the Core AIC Area of the Valley IV Automation-Core.

item_factech_tundra_key.name: Basic Expansion Core
item_factech_tundra_key.desc: Unlocks the next phase of the Basic AIC Plan.
item_factech_tundra_key.decoDesc: A special device containing environmental data of Valley IV. Connect this to the Automation-Core to expand its data processing capabilities.

item_factech_tundra_point.name: Basic AIC Index
item_factech_tundra_point.desc: These index points are required to research various AIC technologies in the Basic AIC Plan.
item_factech_tundra_point.decoDesc: A small electrical device that records AIC Factory performance in Valley IV. Connect it to the PAC to adjust Techno-Protocol deployment balance.

item_factech_tundra_pole_supply_1.name: Relay Redistribution
item_factech_tundra_pole_supply_1.desc: Unlocks the area power supply feature of Relay Towers.

item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_1.name: Forge Expansion I
item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_1.desc: Allows 1 more Forge of the Sky to be placed in Wuling.

item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_2.name: Forge Expansion II
item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_2.desc: Allows 2 more Forges of the Sky to be placed in Wuling.

item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_3.name: Forge Expansion III
item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_3.desc: Allows 4 more Forges of the Sky to be placed in Wuling.

item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_4.name: Forge Expansion IV
item_factech_wuling_oven_amount_4.desc: Allows 4 more Forges of the Sky to be placed in Wuling.

item_factech_wuling_xiranite_enr_formula.name: Heavy Xiranite
item_factech_wuling_xiranite_enr_formula.desc: Unlocks the Forge of the Sky production formula for Heavy Xiranite.

item_fbottle_ironenr_acid.decoDesc: A bottle made of Steel, the most common of its kind in the market.

item_fbottle_ironenr_xiranite_poly.decoDesc: A bottle made of Steel, the most common of its kind in the market.

item_fbottle_xiranenr_grass_2.name: Experimental Heavy Xiranite Bottle (Yazhen Solution)
item_fbottle_xiranenr_grass_2.desc: A large-capacity container made by processing Heavy Xiranite during a special period. It can be used to produce other materials.
item_fbottle_xiranenr_grass_2.decoDesc: A larger, thicker, and heavier gourd-shaped Xiranite bottle. In fact, it is so thick and heavy that people think it could be used as a component for an exotic weapon.

item_fertilize_2.name: Fertilizer Test 2
item_fertilize_2.decoDesc: BY TALOS! LORD FERTILIZZA HAS ARRIVED!

item_filter_core.name: Separator Core
item_filter_core.desc: A filter device. Can be used to purify gaseous materials.
item_filter_core.decoDesc: The engineers are currently trying to upgrade facility-grade filter modules. Once the Separator Cores can be recycled and reused, the cost in industrial materials will be greatly reduced.

item_firebat_1_agrange_1_1.name: Edible Denstack
item_firebat_1_agrange_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_firebat_1_agrange_1_1.decoDesc: A saucy condiment with plenty of aggagrit powder in it. Another ingredient in its preparation would be the chromatic lipids used by Bonekrusher Arsonists as fuel for their flamethrowers.

item_gachabyproducts_charticket.name: Bond Quota
item_gachabyproducts_charticket.desc: Exchangeable for goods at the Quota Exchange.
item_gachabyproducts_charticket.decoDesc: A certificate recognized in the exchanges of supply quotas. Endfield operators are guaranteed a wide range of amenities that cover daily expenses, traveling, and accommodations.

item_gachabyproducts_potentialticket.name: Endpoint Quota
item_gachabyproducts_potentialticket.desc: A rare quota resource. Exchangeable for goods at the Quota Exchange.
item_gachabyproducts_potentialticket.decoDesc: A certificate that symbolizes the breadth of expertise and knowledge of Endfield operators. Your Endfielders come from all corners of the world. They have etched their names, their stories, and their lives upon this place.

item_gachabyproducts_weapongold.name: Arsenal Ticket
item_gachabyproducts_weapongold.desc: A special Arsenal Issue currency. Can be used to purchase weapons.
item_gachabyproducts_weapongold.decoDesc: "It doesn't hurt to be armed to the teeth." — Shayen Krad

item_gachabyproducts_weaponticket.name: AIC Quota
item_gachabyproducts_weaponticket.desc: Exchangeable for goods at the Quota Exchange.
item_gachabyproducts_weaponticket.decoDesc: A certificate recognized in the exchanges of supply quotas. People say the AIC Factory doesn't produce goods. It "prints" them. That's how fast and powerful it is.

item_gambling_dungeon_exp.name: Arena Points
item_gambling_dungeon_exp.desc: Acquired by completing Arena Trials or Arena Tasks in Arena of Games event activities. They are exchangeable for rewards.
item_gambling_dungeon_exp.decoDesc: The Arena never rests. The game never ceases.

item_gas_acid.name: Acridgen
item_gas_acid.desc: The gaseous state of Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_acid.decoDesc: When transmuting Precipitation Acid, scientists accidentally discovered numerous properties atypical of other acidic materials. "Activity levels look a bit off, but don't worry... I don't think they'll turn back into the Aggeloi..."

item_gas_copper.name: Cuprium Gas
item_gas_copper.desc: The gaseous state of Cuprium. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_copper.decoDesc: PPE must be properly worn when operating the Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit. Do not be misled by the innocuous-looking red vapors. They can set a person's soul on fire.

item_gas_copper_enr.name: Hetonite Gas
item_gas_copper_enr.desc: The gaseous state of Hetonite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_copper_enr.decoDesc: When the metal was transmuted into vapors that bore a far more intense and brilliant hue of red, several lines of data danced upon the test monitoring the log. The Tianshi studied them and saw the theoretical potential for creating Pyrrolite.

item_gas_copper_enr2.name: Pyrrolite Gas
item_gas_copper_enr2.desc: The gaseous state of Pyrrolite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_copper_enr2.decoDesc: A number of scientists believe that Pyrrolite Gas can be weaponized. Gently unleash it and watch the enemy downwind disintegrate at a visible rate.

item_gas_inert.name: Inergen
item_gas_inert.desc: A stable gas. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.
item_gas_inert.decoDesc: A special gas that can be purified and extracted using AIC Factory facilities. They said it was first used in pneumatic valves and fittings during the original launching of Dijiang.

item_gas_water.name: Aquagen
item_gas_water.desc: The gaseous state of Clean Water. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_water.decoDesc: "Since the great tide burst and roared, clean rippling waters disappeared, only to be replenished by the cycle of rain and vapor."

item_gas_xiranite.name: Xiragen
item_gas_xiranite.desc: The gaseous state of Xiranite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_xiranite.decoDesc: "The soil nurtures numerous qi that connects every living being."

item_gas_xiranite_enr.name: Heavy Xiragen
item_gas_xiranite_enr.desc: The gaseous state of Heavy Xiranite. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_gas_xiranite_enr.decoDesc: To protect the innate "dynamic equilibrium" of Heavy Xiranite during the transmutation process, the engineers furnished the instruments with additional real-time monitoring and modulating modules.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_acid.name: Cuprium Canister (Acridgen)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_acid.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_acid.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper.name: Cuprium Canister (Cuprium Gas)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper_enr.name: Cuprium Canister (Hetonite Gas)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper_enr.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper_enr.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper_enr2.name: Cuprium Canister (Pyrrolite Gas)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper_enr2.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_copper_enr2.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_inert.name: Cuprium Canister (Inergen)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_inert.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_inert.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_water.name: Cuprium Canister (Aquagen)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_water.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_water.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_xiranite.name: Cuprium Canister (Xiragen)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_xiranite.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_xiranite.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gasjar_copper_gas_xiranite_enr.name: Cuprium Canister (Heavy Xiragen)
item_gasjar_copper_gas_xiranite_enr.desc: A pressurized canister made by moulding Cuprium. Can be used to produce other items. Often used for storing gases.
item_gasjar_copper_gas_xiranite_enr.decoDesc: An intricate metal container once highly sought after by metallurgy hobbyists.

item_gaspoint_acid.name: Acridgen Vent
item_gaspoint_acid.desc: A location for extracting Acridgen in the wilderness. Rig it with Gas Extractors to extract Acridgen.

item_gaspoint_inert.name: Inergen Vent
item_gaspoint_inert.desc: A location for extracting Inergen in the wilderness. Rig it with Gas Extractors to extract Inergen.
item_gaspoint_inert.decoDesc: Inergen may be inert and stable, but this is not an excuse for carelessness during gas extraction.

item_gaspoint_xiranite.name: Xiragen Reservoir
item_gaspoint_xiranite.desc: A reservoir of Xiragen in the wilderness. Rig it with Gas Extractors to extract Xiragen.
item_gaspoint_xiranite.decoDesc: A Xiranite connection port that may have been designed for certain Xiranite facilities. It contains a generous reserve of Xiragen.

item_gem_rarity_1.name: Turbid Essence
item_gem_rarity_1.desc: Infuse this into a weapon to improve its skill level.
item_gem_rarity_1.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as turbid.

item_gem_rarity_2.name: Stable Essence
item_gem_rarity_2.desc: Infuse this into a weapon to improve its skill level.
item_gem_rarity_2.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as stable.

item_gem_rarity_3.name: Clean Essence
item_gem_rarity_3.desc: Infuse this into a weapon to improve its skill level.
item_gem_rarity_3.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as clean.

item_gem_rarity_4.name: Pure Essence
item_gem_rarity_4.desc: Infuse this into a weapon to improve its skill level.
item_gem_rarity_4.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as pure.

item_gem_rarity_5.name: Flawless Essence
item_gem_rarity_5.desc: Infuse this into a weapon to improve its skill level.
item_gem_rarity_5.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_gem_stable_energy_point_tundra.name: Valley Engraving Permit
item_gem_stable_energy_point_tundra.desc: Use this at Severe Energy Alluvium sites of Valley IV. It can pre-engrave the stats of weapon essences acquired.
item_gem_stable_energy_point_tundra.decoDesc: A permit for expanded engraving produced in Valley IV. Engraving must be done in a strictly sealed environment to prevent uncontrollable corruption between different essences.

item_gem_stable_energy_point_wuling.name: Wuling Engraving Permit
item_gem_stable_energy_point_wuling.desc: Use this at Severe Energy Alluvium sites of Wuling. It can pre-engrave the stats of weapon essences acquired.
item_gem_stable_energy_point_wuling.decoDesc: A permit for expanded engraving produced in Wuling. Engraving must be done in a strictly sealed environment to prevent uncontrollable corruption between different essences.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_4.name: Valley Multi-Line Engraving Kit
item_gemcustomization_tundra_4.desc: Use this to acquire an essence with 3 customized stats.
item_gemcustomization_tundra_4.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essences.
Techno-Protocol has made overall improvements that have broadened its applications in precision machinery. This led to the successful development of the multi-line engraving kit.

item_gift_jinlong_1.name: Eureka Teabox
item_gift_jinlong_1.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Lifestyle] and/or [Culture] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_1.decoDesc: Special grade tea leaves offered by Eureka Teashop. The emerging brand is really proud of this product. Comes with a designer package that can be assembled into a mini-tea table.

item_gift_jinlong_10.name: Myrkwood Berry Preserve
item_gift_jinlong_10.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Lifestyle] and/or [Nature] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_10.decoDesc: Handmade preserve of berries gathered from Myrkwood. Such jams are usually produced by family-sized operations. Tangy, sweet, and deliciously satisfying to the Samifjod. It can keep them company for a year.

item_gift_jinlong_11.name: Miracle Cake
item_gift_jinlong_11.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Charity] and/or [Fine Arts] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_11.decoDesc: A finely textured oven-baked cake. It is made using a seemingly simple recipe and a choosy list of ingredients. The cake is often featured as merchandise for charity sales events organized by the TGCC.

item_gift_jinlong_12.name: Yuanyuan Manor Jigsaw
item_gift_jinlong_12.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Fashion] and/or [Mind Honing] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_12.decoDesc: "Welcome to the best inn in the entire world. The perfect destination for those who seek relaxation, stress relief, and beauteous nature to enjoy."

item_gift_jinlong_13.name: Wooden Sword
item_gift_jinlong_13.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Lifestyle] and/or [Nature] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_13.decoDesc: Many people of Hongshan often place swords fashioned out of scented wood at home. Though its ability to ward off evil is questionable, it remains a useful training tool.

item_gift_jinlong_2.name: Yinglung Dumbbells
item_gift_jinlong_2.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Sports] and/or [Nature] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_2.decoDesc: Civilian variant of Yinglung training dumbbells. Furnished with an on-board weight manipulator. Automatically adjusts the weight to fine tune your resistance training.

item_gift_jinlong_3.name: Woven Aggelos
item_gift_jinlong_3.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Creative] and/or [Mind Honing] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_3.decoDesc: Old people from Hongshan often craft various toys. Stories speak of a refugee crafter who made these grass-woven Aggeloi while fleeing the devastation of war. The toy successfully soothed the children's excessive fear for these unfeeling killing constructs.

item_gift_jinlong_4.name: Scrimshaw of the Pack
item_gift_jinlong_4.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Sports] and/or [Lifestyle] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_4.decoDesc: A scrimshaw carved from burdenbeast bone that resembles the craft of the Pack. The clan would present this gift to individuals who earned their respect, and members of the Pack have kept this tradition very much alive.

item_gift_jinlong_5.name: Chubby Lung: Fangxing Memorabilia
item_gift_jinlong_5.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Culture] and/or [Charity] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_5.decoDesc: A commemorative Chubby Lung key fob offered for sale to celebrate the completion of Fangxing Avenue. Intricately designed, the Xiranite particles flowing around it make the Chubby Lung rather lifelike.

item_gift_jinlong_6.name: Fin-n-Chips
item_gift_jinlong_6.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Lifestyle] and/or [Culture] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_6.decoDesc: "Organic spuds and freshly caught fins! Marinated in a secret blend, then fried to order — Proper goode olde Victorian grub is coming down to Fangxing Avenue of Wuling City! For the very first time! Gobsmacked, I say! About bloody time!"

item_gift_jinlong_7.name: Bizarro Cupcake
item_gift_jinlong_7.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Creative] and/or [Fashion] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_7.decoDesc: Cupcakes from Seš'qa are never labeled with their flavors. The intrepid snackers do not know if they are in for a delightful surprise or a debilitating gastronomic horror.

item_gift_jinlong_8.name: Fowlbeast Paper Kite
item_gift_jinlong_8.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Charity] and/or [Nature] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_8.decoDesc: Fowlbeast kites are extremely popular in Wuling City. These kites are usually designed by paper-cutting masters. Kite designers and artists do what they can to set aside revenue from kite sales for nursing homes and for the rehabilitation of individuals with disabilities.

item_gift_jinlong_9.name: Der Schwingende Gentleman Classical Album
item_gift_jinlong_9.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Fine Arts] and/or [Culture] to build trust with them.
item_gift_jinlong_9.decoDesc: An album of music composed by a renowned musician known as "Der Schwingende Gentleman". The album contains dozens of time-tested pieces of Leithanian classical music, making it a first-rate collectible for any serious musicophile.

item_gift_tundra_1.name: Aurylene Camera
item_gift_tundra_1.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Technology] and/or [Nature] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_1.decoDesc: "The Blight may melt the world, but your individuality remains as keen as before. Choose Nikolas 006C. Connect our vision to the future."

item_gift_tundra_2.name: Cosmic Gate Puzzle
item_gift_tundra_2.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Mind Honing] and/or [Culture] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_2.decoDesc: A toy designed according to key components of the Cosmic Gate. These puzzles come in all sorts of assembling difficulties. Legends say those who complete the most challenging puzzles may have a chance of repairing the Cosmic Gate itself.

item_gift_tundra_3.name: Surfing Festival Ticket
item_gift_tundra_3.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Sports] and/or [Fine Arts] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_3.decoDesc: An entry ticket to the La Fantoma Surfing Festival. Do not forget to bring your own surfing board when you head over to the competition.

item_gift_tundra_4.name: Breeze of Kjersch
item_gift_tundra_4.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Creative] and/or [Fashion] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_4.decoDesc: Intricately packaged perfume. The primary ingredients are extracts of plants growing on the snowcapped peaks of Kjersch. The fragrance is a reminder of refreshing mountain breeze.

item_gift_tundra_5.name: Tidestone Specimen
item_gift_tundra_5.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Nature] and/or [Culture] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_5.decoDesc: A beautiful crystalline stone found during humanity's earliest attempts to explore the seas of Talos-II. Some of them have entered the market and processed into various collector's items. The fact that such beautiful items exist in the depths of Talosian seas is extremely exciting.

item_gift_tundra_6.name: Simonch Shawl
item_gift_tundra_6.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Fine Arts] and/or [Lifestyle] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_6.decoDesc: A shawl woven from soft, fine fibers. The craftmakers of Simonch treat these shawls as a symbol of friendship. They would make wonderful gifts for your friends.

item_gift_tundra_7.name: Frontiers Watch
item_gift_tundra_7.desc: Give it to operators whose hobbies are [Technology] and/or [Charity] to build trust with them.
item_gift_tundra_7.decoDesc: A popular science periodical in the Civilization Band. Recent issues of the magazine are focusing on the pioneering technologies of Endfield Industries.

item_glass_bottle.name: Amethyst Bottle
item_glass_bottle.desc: A bottle made by processing Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_glass_bottle.decoDesc: Amethyst bottles are being phased out from markets in the Civilization Band due to issues of fragility, weight, and poor Blight resistance.

item_glass_cmpt.name: Amethyst Part
item_glass_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other items or facility construction.
item_glass_cmpt.decoDesc: An Amethyst part with a wide range of uses.

item_glass_enr_bottle.name: Cryston Bottle
item_glass_enr_bottle.desc: A metallic bottle made by processing Cryston Fibers. Can be used to produce other items.
item_glass_enr_bottle.decoDesc: Special chemical reagents can only be properly stored with Cryston Bottles. An example would be the notorious aqua mordax, otherwise known as the "corroding water" or localized ferric chloride solvent.

item_glass_enr_cmpt.name: Cryston Part
item_glass_enr_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Cryston Fibers. Can be used to produce other items or facility construction.
item_glass_enr_cmpt.decoDesc: A Cryston Part with a wide range of uses.

item_gm01m10_watch.name: Romano's Watch
item_gm01m10_watch.decoDesc: Rosa gave this watch to Romano. It keeps the time, but seems to have another feature.

item_gm01m16_3.name: Linnaeus's Medicine
item_gm01m16_3.desc: Medicine lost by UWST scientist Linnaeus.
item_gm01m16_3.decoDesc: A half-empty vial of a mysterious medicine with a strange aroma. The bottle has a warning label that reads DO NOT OVERDOSE. The first two words were torn and barely legible.

item_gold.name: T-Creds
item_gold.desc: TC for short. This currency is recognized and used in many places.
item_gold.decoDesc: A popular currency furnished with highly advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies. You know it's good money when you can purchase things with it.

item_hscrane_1_hsmob_1_grass_1_1.name: Master Pan's Egg Pudding
item_hscrane_1_hsmob_1_grass_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_hscrane_1_hsmob_1_grass_1_1.decoDesc: A vegetable egg pudding popular in a hot pot joint owned by an Ursus chef. It is an extremely delicious and beautiful looking dish... But the ingredients said nothing about eggs. How does anyone make this?

item_hsfly_1_slimeml_1_hsmob_1_1.name: Simmered Xiranite Ball
item_hsfly_1_slimeml_1_hsmob_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_hsfly_1_slimeml_1_hsmob_1_1.decoDesc: Meatballs dyed in a way to make them resemble Xiranite. Although the resemblance is close enough to make diners hesitate, the tenderness, fragrance, and flavors are guaranteed to conquer every foodie.

item_hshog_1_hsmob_1_slimeml_1_1.name: Wuling Flame-Boyance
item_hshog_1_hsmob_1_slimeml_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_hshog_1_hsmob_1_slimeml_1_1.decoDesc: A generous and colorful dish. No one cares how the ingredient is cut or stir-fried, or how strong the fire is. Every Wuling household has their own Flame-Boyance approach. Some families believe that the secret lies in soaking the sprouts in used water from washing Amber Rice.

item_hsmob_1_dog_1_1.name: Bamboo Sprouts and Meat
item_hsmob_1_dog_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_hsmob_1_dog_1_1.decoDesc: An everyday family dish prepared by stir-frying bamboo sprouts with meat strips. This is also the first dish that the children of Qingbo Stockade learn about ... or so they say.

item_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.name: Garden Stir-Fry
item_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.decoDesc: A dish prepared with a wok and intense fire. Stir-frying this only takes seconds. A blink or two longer and you'll get a disaster with abysmal texture.

item_hub_key.name: PAC Backup Parts
item_hub_key.decoDesc: A key item for unlocking the Protocol Automation-Core.

item_inkbiter_1_wgshoal_1_1.name: Herbal Tisane
item_inkbiter_1_wgshoal_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.
item_inkbiter_1_wgshoal_1_1.decoDesc: A refreshing drink with a flowery aroma that dispels the heat. Adding a quality glob of fine ink gives the drink fortifying properties that soothe the body and mind.

item_inkkirin_1_hscrane_1_1.name: Numbing Crispy Pupae
item_inkkirin_1_hscrane_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
