item_inkkirin_1_hscrane_1_1.decoDesc: A serving of delicious deep-fried pupae. Do not consume too many of them at one go. "Wait. I can't feel my tongue anymore... Did you season it with nine-tiered peppercorn...? What's this? A static build-up discharger? Why?"

item_inn_drink_1.name: Bowl of Tea
item_inn_drink_1.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_1.decoDesc: A good kettle of quality crushed tea. Emerald crushing brewed in cascading water. The aroma can be picked up for miles.

item_inn_drink_10.name: Bottled Duskberry Juice
item_inn_drink_10.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_10.decoDesc: The highest quality berries are often known as "Evening Dusk in Circulation". Nevertheless, everyone who tasted this duskberry juice agrees on this fact: "It's just liquid state sourberry."

item_inn_drink_2.name: Bottled Milk
item_inn_drink_2.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_2.decoDesc: There is empirical evidence that children who drink milk often tend to be taller.

item_inn_drink_3.name: Corn Juice
item_inn_drink_3.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_3.decoDesc: "I'm not trying to be picky, but your corn juice is just like corn porridge. Can you explain what 'juice' means to you?"

item_inn_drink_4.name: Bottled Canejuice
item_inn_drink_4.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_4.decoDesc: People might complain how sweet it is, or how it gives you ulcers if you drink too much. But in the end, this is still the most popular thing on the menu.

item_inn_drink_5.name: Pear Blossom Tea
item_inn_drink_5.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_5.decoDesc: A pinch of pear blossom, a token of yearning and nostalgia.

item_inn_drink_6.name: Seeker's Kohl
item_inn_drink_6.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_6.decoDesc: A famous distilled liquor falsely attributed to the Songseekers of the Hannabit Circuit. The kohl greets one's throat like oil poured over a red-hot pan, giving one a historical lesson on the brutality of the Aggeloi War.

item_inn_drink_7.name: Bottled Milk [A]
item_inn_drink_7.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_7.decoDesc: There is empirical evidence that children can still reach impressive heights without drinking this religiously. But this can be forgiven since this particular drink tastes great.

item_inn_drink_8.name: Vintage Grapedew
item_inn_drink_8.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_8.decoDesc: Will this drop of aromatic grapedew remind you of the unforgiving weather, the carnage, and poetry of home?

item_inn_drink_9.name: Pre-Tide Lungjing
item_inn_drink_9.desc: A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.
item_inn_drink_9.decoDesc: Brewed from leaves plucked from shrubs growing in the peripheral regions of Wuling before High Blight Tide. The tea is remarkably expensive due to its limited production.

item_inn_drink_water.name: Potable Water
item_inn_drink_water.desc: A very basic drink that can be served in Innkeeping.

item_inn_gold.name: Spirit Money
item_inn_gold.desc: Can be used for Innkeeping and purchasing Inn Renovations.
item_inn_gold.decoDesc: The spirit of daily life lingers in every bustle and taste.

item_iron_bottle.name: Ferrium Bottle
item_iron_bottle.desc: A metallic bottle made by processing Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_bottle.decoDesc: A metallic bottle rarely seen in the market. Although Ferrium metal offers better resistance against oxidation, people still prefer the Steel variant.

item_iron_cmpt.name: Ferrium Part
item_iron_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items or facility construction.
item_iron_cmpt.decoDesc: A Ferrium Part with a wide range of uses.

item_iron_enr.name: Steel
item_iron_enr.desc: A high quality material prepared by refining Dense Ferrium Powder. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_enr.decoDesc: Steel manufactured by Endfield Industries has been subject to multiple processing steps. It has been included in the list of Grade 2 Reference Materials in the Talos-II Blight Resistance Standards of Industrial Metals.

item_iron_enr_bottle.name: Steel Bottle
item_iron_enr_bottle.desc: A metallic bottle made by moulding Steel. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_enr_bottle.decoDesc: A bottle made of Steel, the most common of its kind in the market.

item_iron_enr_cmpt.name: Steel Part
item_iron_enr_cmpt.desc: A device part made by processing Steel. Can be used to produce other items or facility construction.
item_iron_enr_cmpt.decoDesc: A Steel Part with a wide range of uses.

item_iron_enr_powder.name: Dense Ferrium Powder
item_iron_enr_powder.desc: Acquired by grinding Ferrium Powder. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this preparation of dense Ferrium powder. It is extremely popular amongst traditional artists.

item_iron_nugget.name: Ferrium
item_iron_nugget.desc: A metallic ingot made by refining Ferrium Ore. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_iron_nugget.decoDesc: A metal of Talos-II that is remarkably similar to Oriron. No one could explain the similarity.

item_iron_ore.name: Ferrium Ore
item_iron_ore.desc: A natural-occurring metal complex with blue coloration. It can be processed with the AIC.
item_iron_ore.decoDesc: Many theories have been proposed about the origins of Ferrium. Before the age of industrial metallurgy, Ferrium was the most common metal that people used.

item_iron_powder.name: Ferrium Powder
item_iron_powder.desc: Shredded and powdered Ferrium. Can be used to produce other items.
item_iron_powder.decoDesc: Ferrium can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_jzmonk_1_hsmob_1_1.name: Rind-Flavored Sprouts
item_jzmonk_1_hsmob_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_jzmonk_1_hsmob_1_1.decoDesc: A delicious cold dish. Crunchy with a refreshing aroma. According to some veteran chef from Hongshan, the older the rind, the better the taste.

item_klbuds_1_hsfly_1_1.name: Ruin-Purger Remedy
item_klbuds_1_hsfly_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_klbuds_1_hsfly_1_1.decoDesc: A mysterious remedy prepared using an improved formula based on ancient recipes. It is an effective dressing for wounds and for washing away pathogenic materials.

item_klcreatures_1_wgthorns_1_1.name: Stonehold Remedy
item_klcreatures_1_wgthorns_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_klcreatures_1_wgthorns_1_1.decoDesc: A mysterious remedy prepared using an improved formula based on ancient recipes. It can enhance energy conducting efficiency of the user's skeletal frame.

item_lbmob_1_dog_1_moss_1_1.name: Seš'qa Style Fillet
item_lbmob_1_dog_1_moss_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_lbmob_1_dog_1_moss_1_1.decoDesc: A wholly black fillet with bits of bone inside it. Seš'qamam cuisine? Probably not. This feels more like a Landbreakers' fantasy about Seš'qamam food.

item_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.name: Cartilage Tack
item_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.decoDesc: Savory cookies with bits of cartilaginous material inside it. Look cute but have an extremely dry and gagging taste. This recipe was rumored to be a Landbreaker creation. It would seem that these raiders are actually capable of focusing on the details. A rare occasion indeed.

item_lbmob_1_moss_2_bottled_1.name: Secret Stimulating Tisane
item_lbmob_1_moss_2_bottled_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_lbmob_1_moss_2_bottled_1.decoDesc: A stimulating tisane prepared using Karja's secret formula. Don't drink it in daytime, though.

item_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.name: Instant Bone Soup
item_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.decoDesc: A soup mix of aggagrit seasoning and special bone meal. Just add hot water. Despite its savory and wholesome flavors, tasters can't help but weirdly fantasize if the soup mix is just as good "without the bone meal".

item_lbshield_1_slimeml_1_dog_1_1.name: Old Man John's Burger
item_lbshield_1_slimeml_1_dog_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_lbshield_1_slimeml_1_dog_1_1.decoDesc: Getting an authentic Mama John's burger is not easy for explorations operating in the field. But if you try hard enough, you can make something that is at least eighty-percent similar to the Mama's famous sandwiches.

item_liquid_acid.name: Precipitation Acid
item_liquid_acid.desc: Precipitation Acid is capable of dissolving various chemically resistant materials. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.
item_liquid_acid.decoDesc: Aggeloid remains would turn into a corrosive fluid when subject to abnormal levels of heat and pressure. In the process of Aggeloid formation, Ankhors would simply (and violently) "mash" the constituent inorganic materials of an Aggelos together to precipitate various reactions otherwise impossible in the real world. When Aggeloid remains are broken down, these unusual inorganic materials would undergo further changes. This is how the Precipitation Acid is made.
obtainWays: Extraction: Acid Resistant Pumps Mk II

item_liquid_copper.name: Cuprium Solution
item_liquid_copper.desc: A solution of materials dissolved in Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_liquid_copper.decoDesc: "It reminds me of the well we drilled in the northern permafrost, brother. I think it was the very first well dug by humanity on Talos-II. The water wasn't potable, but at least it looked pretty."

item_liquid_copper_enr.name: Hetonite Solution
item_liquid_copper_enr.desc: A solution acquired by refining the Cuprium Solution. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_liquid_copper_enr.decoDesc: The Ankhors would attract metallic ions from the depths of the Hongshan Crater Lake to assemble the Aggeloi. These beings would then be subject to various steps of "forging" to achieve better performances. The Tianshi of Wuling have now mastered this process to achieve large-scale metal precipitation.

item_liquid_plant_grass_1.name: Jincao Solution
item_liquid_plant_grass_1.desc: A solution of Jincao. It can be processed and used for producing medicine.
item_liquid_plant_grass_1.decoDesc: A solution prepared to maximize the effects of jincao extract.

item_liquid_plant_grass_2.name: Yazhen Solution
item_liquid_plant_grass_2.desc: A solution of Yazhen. It can be processed and used for producing medicine.
item_liquid_plant_grass_2.decoDesc: A solution prepared to maximize the effects of yazhen extract.

item_liquid_sewage.name: Sewage
item_liquid_sewage.desc: Sewage is basically water with all sorts of suspended and/or dissolved materials. It must be processed at a Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.
item_liquid_sewage.decoDesc: Sewage and polluted bodies of water found in the wildlands often contain a plethora of contaminants. Advanced technology is required to clean them properly.

item_liquid_water.name: Clean Water
item_liquid_water.desc: Pure and clean water. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.
item_liquid_water.decoDesc: It has always been the source of life.

item_liquid_xiranite.name: Liquid Xiranite
item_liquid_xiranite.desc: Xiranite dissolved in Clean Water. Can be used to produce other materials. Often filled in containers and loaded on jet drones for Liquid Xiranite spraying and elimination of Active Blight in Wuling.
item_liquid_xiranite.decoDesc: When people first hear about aqueous Xiranite solutions, most would regard its production as a simple process. However, a user without proper equipment nor techniques would only arrive at a useless product — one that is hardly any different than sand mixed in water.

item_liquid_xiranite_enr.name: Liquid Heavy Xiranite
item_liquid_xiranite_enr.desc: Heavy Xiranite dissolved in Precipitation Acid. Can be used to produce other materials. Often filled in containers and loaded on jet drones for Liquid Heavy Xiranite spraying and elimination of Active Blight in Wuling.
item_liquid_xiranite_enr.decoDesc: In addition to countering the Blight, another key focus of Xiranite tech research is the identification of potential Xiranite compounds with other materials.

item_liquid_xiranite_lowpoly.name: Inert Xircon Effluent
item_liquid_xiranite_lowpoly.desc: A solution acquired by chemically reacting Liquid Xiranite with Sewage. It must be processed at the Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.
item_liquid_xiranite_lowpoly.decoDesc: A type of Xircon Effluent from various applications that completely exhausted the energy of its Originium constituents. Only a minute fraction of Feranmut power has entered an active state. Such effluents can largely be regarded as chemically inert.

item_liquid_xiranite_poly.name: Xircon Effluent
item_liquid_xiranite_poly.desc: A solution acquired by chemically reacting Liquid Xiranite with Sewage. It can be used to produce other materials, or processed at the Water Treatment Unit to render it harmless.
item_liquid_xiranite_poly.decoDesc: Xircon Effluent is a form of partially inactivated Liquid Xiranite, but a fraction of its constituents remains in a hyperactive state. Energy of the Originium constituents within Liquid Xiranite gradually dissipates during various applications. This "desiccation" process would occasionally trigger the activation of Feranmut power within the Xiranite.

item_liquidpoint_acid.name: Precipitation Acid Storage
item_liquidpoint_acid.desc: A reservoir of Precipitation Acid in the wilderness.

item_liquidpoint_plant_grass_1.name: Jincao Solution Storage
item_liquidpoint_plant_grass_1.desc: A reservoir of Jincao Solution in the wilderness.

item_liquidpoint_plant_grass_2.name: Yazhen Solution Storage
item_liquidpoint_plant_grass_2.desc: A reservoir of Yazhen Solution in the wilderness.

item_liquidpoint_sewage.name: Sewage Storage
item_liquidpoint_sewage.desc: A reservoir of Sewage in the wilderness.

item_liquidpoint_water.name: Clean Water Storage
item_liquidpoint_water.desc: A reservoir of Clean Water in the wilderness.

item_liquidpoint_xiranite.name: Liquid Xiranite Storage
item_liquidpoint_xiranite.desc: A reservoir of Liquid Xiranite in the wilderness.

item_liquidpoint_xiranite_enr.name: Liquid Heavy Xiranite Storage
item_liquidpoint_xiranite_enr.desc: A reservoir of Liquid Heavy Xiranite in the wilderness.

item_log_belt_01.name: Transport Belt
item_log_belt_01.desc: A logistics unit for transporting solid goods and materials.
item_log_belt_01.decoDesc: A basic conveyor belt for transporting things. Belts are the blood vessels of the AIC Factory.

item_log_conditioner.name: Item Control Port
item_log_conditioner.desc: An adjustable belt logistics unit that controls the type and quantity of items passed through the belt. Unlock the AIC Plan technology [Flow Rate Adjustment] to also adjust the maximum flow rate of materials passing through the belt.

item_log_connector.name: Belt Bridge
item_log_connector.desc: A logistics unit that lets 2 transport belts intersect without obstructing each other.
item_log_connector.decoDesc: A logistics unit that AIC Factory managers can use to create an organized transport system and avoid the "spaghetti".

item_log_converger.name: Converger
item_log_converger.desc: A logistics unit that merges up to 3 transport belts into 1 single belt.
item_log_converger.decoDesc: A transport system adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.

item_log_pipe_01.name: Pipe
item_log_pipe_01.desc: A logistics unit for transporting fluids or gases.
item_log_pipe_01.decoDesc: A survey revealed that nearly 30% of residents in the Civilization Band believe that a dark and massive underground kingdom exists within the sprawling urban pipeline network.

item_log_pipe_conditioner.name: Pipe Control Port
item_log_pipe_conditioner.desc: An adjustable pipeline logistics unit that controls the type and quantity of items passed through the pipeline. Unlock the AIC Plan technology [Flow Rate Adjustment] to also adjust the maximum flow rate of materials passing through the pipeline.

item_log_pipe_connector.name: Pipe Bridge
item_log_pipe_connector.desc: A logistics unit that lets 2 pipelines intersect without obstructing each other.
item_log_pipe_connector.decoDesc: This logistics unit is furnished with special fluid control valves developed by Endfield Industries. However, its unique industrial designs have greatly limited its success in the market.

item_log_pipe_converger.name: Pipe Converger
item_log_pipe_converger.desc: A logistics unit that merges up to 3 pipelines into 1 single pipeline.
item_log_pipe_converger.decoDesc: A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.

item_log_pipe_splitter.name: Pipe Splitter
item_log_pipe_splitter.desc: A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 pipeline into multiple pipelines (up to 3).
item_log_pipe_splitter.decoDesc: A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.

item_log_splitter.name: Splitter
item_log_splitter.desc: A logistics unit that evenly divides product flow from 1 transport belt into multiple belts (up to 3).
item_log_splitter.decoDesc: A transport belt adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.

item_m1m8_grassSample_1.name: Fluffed Jincao Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_1.decoDesc: A thriving Fluffed Jincao plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_m1m8_grassSample_2.name: Thorny Yazhen Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_2.decoDesc: A thriving Thorny Yazhen plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_m1m8_grassSample_3.name: Firebuckle Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_3.decoDesc: A thriving Firebuckle plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_m1m8_grassSample_4.name: Umbraline Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_4.decoDesc: A thriving Umbraline plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.name: Sod-Turning Meat Soup
item_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: A meat soup with a fruity flavor. What did people eat when construction began in Valley IV? There are plenty of stories around, but many veterans claimed they had a fruity meat stew when they turned the sod.

item_minepoint_copper_ore.name: Cuprium Mining Spot
item_minepoint_copper_ore.desc: A location for mining Cuprium Ore in the wilderness.

item_minepoint_iron_ore.name: Ferrium Mining Spot
item_minepoint_iron_ore.desc: A location for mining Ferrium Ore in the wilderness.

item_minepoint_originium_ore.name: Originium Mining Spot
item_minepoint_originium_ore.desc: A location for mining Originium Ore in the wilderness.

item_minepoint_quartz_sand.name: Amethyst Mining Spot
item_minepoint_quartz_sand.desc: A location for mining Amethyst Ore in the wilderness.

item_mission_a1m15_medal.name: Steeplechaser's Medal
item_mission_a1m15_medal.desc: A medal awarded to runners who demonstrated athletic excellence in a sports event.
item_mission_a1m15_medal.decoDesc: A sparkling gold medal awarded to runners who demonstrated athletic excellence in a sports event. It is inscribed with the signatures of the entire event committee, Yvonne (in beautiful cursive), and Tangtang (is that a doodle?).

item_mission_c13_pack1.name: Food Package
item_mission_c13_pack1.desc: A package of condiments for the canteen workers.
item_mission_c13_pack1.decoDesc: Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.

item_mission_c13_pack2.name: Precision Parts Package
item_mission_c13_pack2.desc: A package of precision parts for Andre.
item_mission_c13_pack2.decoDesc: Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.

item_mission_c13_pack3.name: Medical Package
item_mission_c13_pack3.desc: A package of medical supplies for the medical staff.
item_mission_c13_pack3.decoDesc: Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.

item_mission_c16_data1.name: Roman's Dashcam Record
item_mission_c16_data1.desc: This device has detailed recordings of a recent accident. Use it to acquire data on Laevatain's Originium responses.
item_mission_c16_data1.decoDesc: Dashcam record of Roman's recent delivery to the Originium Science Park. It includes extensive records of the Landbreaker attack.

item_mission_c16_data2.name: IR: Quarry Collapse
item_mission_c16_data2.desc: A detailed investigation report of the quarry collapse. It provides data on Laevatain's Originium responses.
item_mission_c16_data2.decoDesc: A detailed investigation report of the Quarry Collapse. Includes testimonies from those who experienced the collapse as well as post-incident analysis.

item_mission_c16_data3.name: IR: Scorch Marks Near the Blightcliff OP
item_mission_c16_data3.desc: An investigation report on scorch marks found near the Blightcliff Observation Post. It provides data on Laevatain's Originium responses.
item_mission_c16_data3.decoDesc: A report that Salman submitted after investigating the scorch marks near the Blightcliff Observation Post. Includes relevant records, processes of inspection, and data analysis.

item_mission_c27m2_tangtangquans.name: A Basket of Tangtang Certs
item_mission_c27m2_tangtangquans.desc: A huge basket full of Tangtang Certs, a symbol trust from the Supreme Chief of Qingbo Stockade.
item_mission_c27m2_tangtangquans.decoDesc: The basket has an unbelievable load of Tangtang Certs. The Supreme Chief's trust in you is appreciating like stonks.

item_mission_c28m1_sword.name: Holy Sword of the Kingdom
item_mission_c28m1_sword.desc: The symbol of power in the Kingdom of Brickyland.
item_mission_c28m1_sword.decoDesc: The symbol of power in the Kingdom of Brickyland.

item_mission_c28m2_1.name: "Holy Sword of the Kingdom"
item_mission_c28m2_1.desc: A treasure of the "Kingdom of Brickyland". It is a symbol of "Ducal" power.
item_mission_c28m2_1.decoDesc:
Made from a thick and sturdy piece of cardboard. The hilt is wrapped by tributary "ribbons" offered to the kingdom by merchants from afar. 
The inheritors find themselves enthralled by its magnificence and believe the weapon capable of piercing the sun. 
However, nobody noticed the terrifying fangs in the reflection of its body. 
Take it, before it becomes a symbol of true power.

item_mission_c28m2_2.name: "Strong Shield of the Kingdom"
item_mission_c28m2_2.desc: A treasure of the "Kingdom of Brickyland". It is a symbol of "Ducal" power.
item_mission_c28m2_2.decoDesc:
A sturdy shield granted to the "Duke of Clockwork from the Kingdom of Brickyland". 
Furnished with a multitude of stars to dispel the darkness.
When the Long Night arrives, the last warrior shall guard the gates with a torch raised high.

item_mission_c34m2_dreamcatcher.name: Dreamcatcher
item_mission_c34m2_dreamcatcher.desc: A ritual item. Place it in a shrine to release the nightmares it managed to catch.
item_mission_c34m2_dreamcatcher.decoDesc: A special Samifjod dreamcatcher woven with special Arts. Hang it from the eaves to catch any horrid nightmares trying to enter the house.

item_mission_c34m2d5_manuscript.name: Snowpriestess's Notes
item_mission_c34m2d5_manuscript.desc: Notes left behind by a Sami Snowpriestess. Her writings can only be deciphered using a code book within the cabin.
item_mission_c34m2d5_manuscript.decoDesc: Handwritten notes left behind by the old Snowpriestess. They are filled with ancient, esoteric, and barely legible runes. Even the Snowpriestess herself relied on a code book to decipher them.

item_mission_c34m3_andrewhair.name: Andre's Brow Feathers
item_mission_c34m3_andrewhair.desc: Plucked from a Liberi named Andre. Pack them up in a ball of snow to create the eye of an array for entering Andre's dream.
item_mission_c34m3_andrewhair.decoDesc: A handful of feathers plucked from Andre's brows. They are a real mess, just like the wild and crazy ideas stored within his mind.

item_mission_c34m3_andrewsnowball.name: Feathers Packed in a Snowball
item_mission_c34m3_andrewsnowball.desc: The eye of an array for entering Andre's dream.
item_mission_c34m3_andrewsnowball.decoDesc: A ball of snow packed with all sorts of feathers. The Liberi's face is covered in all sorts of feathers. It is quite difficult to tell which of them are actually brow feathers.

item_mission_e0m0_hubkey.name: "Starting Point"
item_mission_e0m0_hubkey.desc: Starfire streaks over seas ever placid, birthsongs shatter a night everlasting. Thus life refuses the silence never-ending.

item_mission_e1m4_fixtool.name: Bridge Elevator Control Panel Parts
item_mission_e1m4_fixtool.desc: Parts for repairing the control panel of a bridge elevator.
item_mission_e1m4_fixtool.decoDesc: A component of the control panel for raising and lowering the bridge. The Bonekrushers ripped it out and hid it. It seems essential for getting the control panel to work.

item_mission_e2m3_key.name: Backup ID Pass
item_mission_e2m3_key.desc: An ID card to open the gate of the Originium Science Park.
item_mission_e2m3_key.decoDesc: A backup ID pass. Use it to activate the control panel and open the gate of the Originium Science Park.

item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.name: Tata's Log I
item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.desc: Memories made with the TA-TA Prototype.
item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.decoDesc: An image record of the Blight Core taken by Tata at the entrance of the Research Center building.

item_mission_e4m1_tatapicb.name: Tata's Log II
item_mission_e4m1_tatapicb.desc: Memories made with the TA-TA Prototype.
item_mission_e4m1_tatapicb.decoDesc: An image record taken with Tata's perspective. CONTENT: Endfield Crisis Team resting next to the signal tower at the Origin Lodespring.

item_mission_e5m3_tangtangquan.name: "Tangtang Cert"
item_mission_e5m3_tangtangquan.desc: A token, given to you by Tangtang.
item_mission_e5m3_tangtangquan.decoDesc: A bamboo slip with a badly written "Tang" written on it. This is a token of appreciation from Tangtang. Now, if you could only find a place to spend it on...

item_mission_e7m4_wettangtangquan.name: Soggy "Tangtang Cert"
item_mission_e7m4_wettangtangquan.desc: A token, given to you by Tangtang.
item_mission_e7m4_wettangtangquan.decoDesc: A "Tangtang Cert" left beside the ancestral spring. There is no way of telling if it's the flowing waters of the ancestral spring or Tangtang's tears that smudged her barely legible handwriting.

item_mission_e9m2_xiranite.name: Custom Heavy Xiranite
item_mission_e9m2_xiranite.desc: Zhuang Fangyi gave this to the Endministrator to help repair the Tianshi Pillar Array.
item_mission_e9m2_xiranite.decoDesc: A special form of "Heavy Xiranite" produced by the Wuling Institute of Materials Science.

item_mission_f1m19d1_pic1.name: Photo: Chubby Lung
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic1.desc: A photo of Chubby Lung taken at Fangxing Avenue. The Feranmut Imager can convert it into environmental parameters tangible to the Feranmut Heart.
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic1.decoDesc: Chubby Lungs symbolize the dynamic and changing rhythms of Wuling, a chic city that is always ready to embrace new things.

item_mission_f1m19d1_pic2.name: Photo: Migrating Fowlbeasts
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic2.desc: A photo of fowlbeasts taken at Citizen Square. The Feranmut Imager can convert it into environmental parameters tangible to the Feranmut Heart.
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic2.decoDesc: The presence of more fowlbeasts in Wuling symbolizes harmony between human civilization and nature. Life is a miracle on its own.

item_mission_f1m19d1_pic3.name: Photo: Academy Banners
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic3.desc: A photo of exam motivation banners taken at the Tianshi Bureau Academy. The Feranmut Imager can convert it into environmental parameters tangible to the Feranmut Heart.
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic3.decoDesc: Generations of Tianshi, one after another in an unbroken legacy, serve as the mainstay of this city.

item_mission_f1m19d1_pic4.name: Photo: The Perplexed Tianshi
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic4.desc: A photo of Tianshi taken at the Institute of Materials Science. The Feranmut Imager can convert it into environmental parameters tangible to the Feranmut Heart.
item_mission_f1m19d1_pic4.decoDesc: For years, the Tianshi of Wuling have upheld the "people-oriented" principle in their actions. But the Tianshi forgot that they are part of the people as well...

item_mission_f1m29d1_tube.name: Empty Sample Test Tube
item_mission_f1m29d1_tube.desc: A utensil for holding samples collected from water bodies in Yinglung Pass.
item_mission_f1m29d1_tube.decoDesc: A test tube with special treatment. It is clean and contains no foreign materials.

item_mission_f1m29d1_water1.name: Outpost Water Sample
item_mission_f1m29d1_water1.desc: A test tube containing a sample collected from water bodies at the outpost.
item_mission_f1m29d1_water1.decoDesc: Submit the sample to Wei Xidong for water quality analysis.

item_mission_f1m29d1_water2.name: Wilderness Water Sample
item_mission_f1m29d1_water2.desc: A test tube holding a sample collected from water bodies in the wilderness.
item_mission_f1m29d1_water2.decoDesc: Submit the sample to Wei Xidong for water quality analysis.

item_mission_f1m29d1_water3.name: Aquifer Water Sample
item_mission_f1m29d1_water3.desc: A test tube holding a sample collected from an aquifer.
item_mission_f1m29d1_water3.decoDesc: Submit the sample to Wei Xidong for water quality analysis.

item_mission_f1m29d2_flower1.name: Deepest Flora of Yinglung Pass
item_mission_f1m29d2_flower1.desc: A plant collected from the bottom-most part of Yinglung Pass.
item_mission_f1m29d2_flower1.decoDesc: A plant collected from the bottom-most part of Yinglung Pass. Submit it to Wei Xidong for analysis.

item_mission_f1m29d2_flower2.name: Highest Flora of Yinglung Pass
item_mission_f1m29d2_flower2.desc: A plant collected from the tallest part of Yinglung Pass.
item_mission_f1m29d2_flower2.decoDesc: A plant collected from the tallest part of Yinglung Pass. Submit it to Wei Xidong for analysis.

item_mission_f1m29d2_flower3.name: Blue Petal
item_mission_f1m29d2_flower3.desc: Petals of a blue plant that grows deep down the path.
item_mission_f1m29d2_flower3.decoDesc: Petals of a blue plant that grows deep down the path. Submit it to Wei Xidong for analysis.

item_mission_gm02m10_key.name: Underground Key of Tianjing Courtyard
item_mission_gm02m10_key.desc: Key picked up somewhere beneath Tianjing Courtyard. It might be able to activate a certain mechanism.
item_mission_gm02m10_key.decoDesc: An ancient artifact that Tianshi Bao described as a "key".

item_mission_gm02m27_bell.name: Mini "Waking Bell" Souvenir
item_mission_gm02m27_bell.desc: After reaching the end of the "Suiming" story, Yu Shigui gives this to the Endministrator as a souvenir.
item_mission_gm02m27_bell.decoDesc: A miniature model of the "Waking Bell" constructed with special materials. At first glance, it looks similar to Wuling's Bell of Three Presences, but closer inspection reveals many tiny differences. According to Yu Shigui, he referenced the first design draft of the Bell of Three Presences when making this model. The Bell in Wuling best represents his ideal of the "Waking Bell".

item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian1.name: Replacement Part "Xun"
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian1.desc: A replacement for an important component of the Waking Bell.
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian1.decoDesc: A finely made replacement constructed using special Blight-resistant materials. It is named "Xun" (Wind) based on its relative position within the entire assembly.

item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian2.name: Replacement Part "Kan"
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian2.desc: A replacement for an important component of the Waking Bell.
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian2.decoDesc: A finely made replacement constructed using special Blight-resistant materials. It is named "Kan" (Water) based on its relative position within the entire assembly.

item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian3.name: Replacement Part "Zhen"
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian3.desc: A replacement for an important component of the Waking Bell.
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian3.decoDesc: A finely made replacement constructed using special Blight-resistant materials. It is named "Zhen" (Thunder) based on its relative position within the entire assembly.

item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian4.name: Replacement Part "Qian"
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian4.desc: A replacement for an important component of the Waking Bell.
item_mission_gm02m27_lingjian4.decoDesc: A finely made replacement constructed using special Blight-resistant materials. It is named "Qian" (Heaven) based on its relative position within the entire assembly.

item_mission_gm02m27_switch.name: Waking Bell Activator
item_mission_gm02m27_switch.desc: A special device for activating the Waking Bell. Use it to access every internal module, including the Mission Log itself.
item_mission_gm02m27_switch.decoDesc: A mechanical device that resembles a cogwheel. It seems to be constructed with special materials similar to those of the Waking Bell itself. It is not difficult to use, but calibration is extremely difficult. Only a bellfounder with exceptional skills can successfully complete this highly intricate task.

item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.name: Distorted Key
item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.desc: Use this to open a Landbreaker underground prison cell.
item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.decoDesc: A common key picked up in a mining tunnel, but it has been so malformed that it can no longer be used.

item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.name: Metal Component
item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.desc: Use this to make the "hot finger" tool described by Arclight. The tool can be used to cut open the cell door.
item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.decoDesc: Old metal components found in the mines.

item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.name: Steel Oath Medical Crate
item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.desc: A medical supplies crate from the Order of Steel Oath.
item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.decoDesc: A medical supplies crate with the designs and markings of the Order of Steel Oath. The Order uses this to store commonly used medical supplies.

item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.name: Quarry Elevator Keycard
item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.desc: A keycard for activating elevators in the Aburrey Quarry Deep Management Post.
item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.decoDesc: A keycard received from a UWST SAR Crew Mate. It is used to activate the elevators in certain areas.

item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.name: Worn Key Card
item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.desc: A key. It might be used to open some abandoned area.
item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.decoDesc: A worn key card. It looks really old.

item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.name: Damaged Meds Box
item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.desc: A box of salvaged medicine. Not much is left but it should help with the emergency.
item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.decoDesc: A box dented by heavy blows. There are some medicines left inside.

item_mission_sm2l10m1_coupon.name: Soaked Lottery Ticket
item_mission_sm2l10m1_coupon.desc: A soggy wet lottery ticket for the Fortune Connect-and-Win event.
item_mission_sm2l10m1_coupon.decoDesc: A Fortune Connect-and-Win lottery ticket soaked in water. All the scratch areas have been scratched away. The serial ID is no longer legible as someone had smudged it with chili oil. No one would redeem this ticket for anything.

item_mission_sm2l10m3_herb.name: Bundle of Herbs
item_mission_sm2l10m3_herb.desc: A mix of three seasoning ingredients for the dish named "Spoon Swimmer".
item_mission_sm2l10m3_herb.decoDesc: Contains these 3 herbs: Flufftail Herb, Amberstalk, and Knotfennel. It provides a thick and wholesome flavor.

item_mission_sm2l2m2_collection.name: Grove Nymphsprout
item_mission_sm2l2m2_collection.desc: Aunt Tian needs the grove nymphsprouts to prepare her special braised meat noodles.
item_mission_sm2l2m2_collection.decoDesc: Aunt Tian needs the grove nymphsprouts to prepare her special, sweet, slippery, savory, and delicious braised meat noodles.

item_mission_sm2l7m1_bagofinstruments.name: Bag of Musical Instruments
item_mission_sm2l7m1_bagofinstruments.desc: A bag of musical instruments, all of which bear inscriptions that read: "South Hongshan Troupe".
item_mission_sm2l7m1_bagofinstruments.decoDesc: These musical instruments seem to have quite a backstory...

item_mission_sm2l7m1_flute.name: Flute
item_mission_sm2l7m1_flute.desc: A flute with inscriptions that read: "South Hongshan Troupe".
item_mission_sm2l7m1_flute.decoDesc: This seems like a flute with quite a backstory...

item_mission_tianshi_talisman.name: Jade Key
item_mission_tianshi_talisman.desc: A special part for activating a Tianshi Shrine.
item_mission_tianshi_talisman.decoDesc: A part acquired by repairing the Tianshi Pillar. Collect 5 to activate the large Tianshi Shrine.

item_monthlycard_1.name: Monthly Pass Exchange Cert
item_monthlycard_1.desc: Use this to get Monthly Pass perks for 30 days.
item_monthlycard_1.decoDesc: Scan this with the Protosync and the Logistics Division will offer you tons of special perks, privileges, and services.

item_muck_feces_1.name: Burdo-Muck
item_muck_feces_1.desc: Burdenbeast dung. Can be used as a fertilizer on a planting plot during the growth phase to shorten its growth phase.
item_muck_feces_1.decoDesc:
Burdo-Muck provides all sorts of nutrients to the soil. 
If you see a burdenbeast in the wilderness, give it a gentle pat to get yourself a huge, mucking pat of hot, steaming surprise.

item_muck_inn_1.name: Bumper-Speed
item_muck_inn_1.desc: A fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to shorten its growth phase.
item_muck_inn_1.decoDesc: A brand new Bumper-Rich formula with rebalanced burdo-muck content. It can significantly accelerate crop growth.

item_muck_inn_2.name: Bumper-Excel
item_muck_inn_2.desc: A fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to boost its yield during harvest.
item_muck_inn_2.decoDesc: A brand new Bumper-Rich formula that reversed the conventional Xiranite fertilization approach. It can significantly boost crop yield.

item_muck_inn_3.name: Bumper-Double
item_muck_inn_3.desc: A fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to shorten crop growth phase and boost crop yield.
item_muck_inn_3.decoDesc: A brand new Bumper-Rich formula with re-balanced burdo-muck content and fertilization approach. Gives both speed and volume!

item_muck_inn_4.name: Bumper-Supreme
item_muck_inn_4.desc: A fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to really shorten crop growth phase and greatly boost crop yield.
item_muck_inn_4.decoDesc: A brand new Bumper-Rich formula. Every drop of bumper gold is the hard work of the Bumper staff. You are just one sack of Bumper-Supreme away from becoming THE Farmer-Supreme.

item_muck_xiranite_1.name: Bumper-Rich
item_muck_xiranite_1.desc: A fertilizer made by mixing burdo-muck with Liquid Xiranite. Can be used to fertilize a planting plot during the growth phase to increase its harvest yield.
item_muck_xiranite_1.decoDesc:
Processed burdo-muck fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize planting plots. 
"Plop a bar of Bumper-Rich to your beautiful fields! Who'd say no to 88 tons per acre yield?"

item_music_exp_tundra_1.name: Soils of Life
item_music_exp_tundra_1.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_tundra_1.decoDesc: It calls our names and desires to hear our voices... The soils are the cradle of life.

item_music_exp_tundra_2.name: Fort in the Acid Fog
item_music_exp_tundra_2.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_tundra_2.decoDesc: The impregnable fortress drowned in a sea of hazefyre, and a great giant lurks above the shadows.

item_music_exp_tundra_3.name: Echoes in the Rock
item_music_exp_tundra_3.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_tundra_3.decoDesc: Polished and cut to dust, the great rock formations echo still.

item_music_exp_tundra_4.name: The Planter's Trace
item_music_exp_tundra_4.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_tundra_4.decoDesc: As the Originium clusters grew into formations, we knew at once that the crystals would be our future.

item_music_exp_tundra_5.name: Surviving Mining
item_music_exp_tundra_5.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_tundra_5.decoDesc: The crew has shed blood and sweat for Valley IV. They now rest here and enjoy the setting sun in peace.

item_music_exp_tundra_6.name: Pulsing Surge
item_music_exp_tundra_6.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_tundra_6.decoDesc: The blaze roared as electrical currents rushed through the cabled veins and arteries of industry.

item_music_exp_wuling_1.name: To Walk, To Cross
item_music_exp_wuling_1.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_1.decoDesc: The light sprinkles through the groves of Jingyu, as rafts ferry travelers across the rivers.

item_music_exp_wuling_2.name: Blossoms Bring an Old Friend
item_music_exp_wuling_2.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_2.decoDesc: A promise has been made, and silently she waits for a returning glance.

item_music_exp_wuling_3.name: Echoes on a Jade Plate
item_music_exp_wuling_3.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_3.decoDesc: The past condenses into a dew drop. Every moment and incident fell into the jade plate.

item_music_exp_wuling_4.name: Drowned in Depth
item_music_exp_wuling_4.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_4.decoDesc: It takes a million tons of water to wash away the scars. And it takes years to ease away the pain that surges within the blood.

item_music_exp_wuling_5.name: Skipping Through Light
item_music_exp_wuling_5.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_5.decoDesc: Gently it invited a drizzle of spring light.

item_music_exp_wuling_6.name: Flow of Eons
item_music_exp_wuling_6.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_6.decoDesc: Listen to the wind that brushes against the dormant earth, where a tale from a century ago quietly sleeps within.

item_music_exp_wuling_7.name: The Day After Tomorrow
item_music_exp_wuling_7.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_7.decoDesc: Finally, the gate is opened ... Ten years of suffering, of endless yearning, of an audience that I deserve.

item_music_exp_wuling_8.name: My Former Home
item_music_exp_wuling_8.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_8.decoDesc: Yet it is filled with dust, noiseless and silent ... my home.

item_music_exp_wuling_9.name: Snowy Forest
item_music_exp_wuling_9.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_exp_wuling_9.decoDesc: From 'neath the snow we picked up a few lines of prophecy. And then with song and dance, they put themselves onto paper.

item_music_fac_dijiang.name: View from the Void Skies
item_music_fac_dijiang.desc: This can be played with Phonograph MKV-I in the Reception Room aboard Dijiang.
item_music_fac_dijiang.decoDesc: Silently we extended our vision beyond the planets.

item_originium_enr_powder.name: Dense Originium Powder
item_originium_enr_powder.desc: Acquired by grinding Originium Powder. This stable material can be used to produce other items.
item_originium_enr_powder.decoDesc: The UWST Originium cultivation project initially attempted "powder seeding" but the resulting crystal clusters would often lose their activity quickly.

item_originium_ore.name: Originium Ore
item_originium_ore.desc: A raw formation of Originium unearthed in its most natural form. This can be processed in the AIC.
item_originium_ore.decoDesc: A basic mineral necessary to support most industrial production.

item_originium_powder.name: Originium Powder
item_originium_powder.desc: A stabilized form of powdered Originium. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_originium_powder.decoDesc: Endfield made use of Techno-Protocol to create a stable form of Originium Powder.

item_originium_recharge.name: Origeometry
item_originium_recharge.desc: An extremely rare crystal habit of Originium with many potential uses.
item_originium_recharge.decoDesc: A derivative of Protocol Originium that can only be made with the most extreme processing environments. Some Endfielders call this the Tear of the Protocol. They believe that Dijiang felt sorrow and shed these Tears when she silently gazed upon the suffering of the Talosians.

item_paper_001_01.name: Torn Safety Warning
item_paper_001_01.decoDesc:
...Collapsing structure... Fall hazards. 
Off limits to non-professionals. 
If you need assistance, please contact... (the rest is torn and illegible) 
—Endfield Industries

item_paper_001_02.name: Letter
item_paper_001_02.decoDesc:
Heard our Landbreaker brute say: "Punching is a skill. Tanking punches is also a skill." 
I think playing dead is a skill, too. 
Acting the fool and kneeling quickly enough should be skills as well. 
Brute is a true boss. His words, though simple, are filled with legit wisdom. 
Definitely gonna use these tricks in the next turf war.

item_paper_002_01.name: Bloodied Note I
item_paper_002_01.decoDesc:
Too many nosy people around, so I wrote it down on paper. Burn it when you're done reading. 
The Landbreakers took our camp, supplies, and cash. I sneaked over there and saw what they did. The LB scum took apart everything. Even mama's kitchen sink! 
I got a plan to deal with these greedy scab eaters.
We'll leave a few obvious and subtle clues, graffiti, and letters about secret loot stashes that don't exist. Some of the LBs are bound to bite the bait and do their own digging in secret. When that happens, we'll show them what we're made of. 
No one is the eternal prey. And no one is the eternal hunter.

item_paper_002_02.name: Bloodied Note II
item_paper_002_02.decoDesc:
Dammit. I got too greedy. It's a trap, and it broke my friggin' legs. I can't get out. 
If you read this, send my moolah to my mom. You can keep some for yourself. I hid them at...

item_paper_002_03.name: Wrinkled Note
item_paper_002_03.decoDesc:
(Handwritten scribbles) 
Don't trust that brat. I say we zero him once we make the creds. 
(Poorly written scribbles) 
Make it clean. Methinks the kid gots some bigshot backing him.

item_plant_bbflower_1.name: Aketine
item_plant_bbflower_1.desc: A plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC Factory. It contains flammable and explosive substances and can be used to make Industrial Explosives.
item_plant_bbflower_1.decoDesc: Aketine is a species of flora native to Talos-II. It usually grows at places with unique soil composition.

item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.name: Aketine Powder
item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.desc: Powdered form of Aketine. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.decoDesc: It is easier to extract target materials and substances from shredded Aketine.

item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.name: Aketine Seed
item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from the Aketine plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to raise Aketine.
item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.decoDesc: Nitrates can be extracted from Aketine. Scientists believe this is caused by the absorption of rainwater with excessively high levels of Blighted materials.

item_plant_crylplant_1_1.name: Kalkodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_1.desc:
A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Extracts of this plant can be used for operator skill upgrades at skill levels 1 to 3.
item_plant_crylplant_1_1.decoDesc: Dendra extracts were once used as emergency medication.

item_plant_crylplant_1_2.name: Chrysodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_2.desc:
A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Extracts of this plant can be used for operator skill upgrades at skill levels 4 to 6.
item_plant_crylplant_1_2.decoDesc: Dendras are plants native to Talos-II. Farming dendras can be quite a challenge.
obtainWays: Main Mission Progress and Unlock Transmute Formulas

item_plant_crylplant_1_3.name: Vitrodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_3.desc:
A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Extracts of this plant can be used for operator skill upgrades at skill levels 7 to 9.
item_plant_crylplant_1_3.decoDesc: Accidental consumption of dendras may lead to high blood pressure, faster heart rates, nauseousness, and vomiting.

item_plant_crylplant_2_1.name: Blighted Jadeleaf
item_plant_crylplant_2_1.desc:
A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Extracts of this plant can be used in operator skill mastery.
item_plant_crylplant_2_1.decoDesc: Some scientists believe that certain Blight conditions can transform any bush or shrub into the Blighted Jadeleaves.

item_plant_crylplant_2_2.name: False Aggela
item_plant_crylplant_2_2.desc:
A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Extracts of this plant can be used in operator skill mastery.
item_plant_crylplant_2_2.decoDesc: An ancient plant that looks and feels like a rock. The False Aggela takes on the appearance of tiny Aggeloi when growing. Life on Talos-II never stopped evolving, even during humanity's silence.

item_plant_crylplant_2_3.name: Crimson Spearleaf
item_plant_crylplant_2_3.desc:
A special plant gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Extracts of this plant can be used in operator skill mastery.
item_plant_crylplant_2_3.decoDesc: A plant of bright crimson hues that resembles a spear point soaked in blood. Some suspect it to be a subject of an environmental remediation research project lost during the Aggeloi War.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.name: Kalkodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.desc:
A Kalkodendra tuber that can be cultivated into a new adult plant. 
Kalkodendra can be used for operator skill upgrades at skill levels 1 to 3.
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Kalkodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.name: Chrysodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.desc:
A Chrysodendra tuber that can be cultivated into a new adult plant. 
Chrysodendra can be used for operator skill upgrades at skill levels 4 to 6.
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.decoDesc: A Chrysodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.name: Vitrodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.desc:
A Vitrodendra tuber that can be cultivated into a new adult plant. 
Vitrodendra can be used for operator skill upgrades at skill levels 7 to 9.
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.decoDesc: A Vitrodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.name: Blighted Jadeleaf Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.desc:
A Blighted Jadeleaf tuber that can be cultivated into a new adult plant. 
Blighted Jadeleaf can be used for operator skill mastery.
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.decoDesc: A Blighted Jadeleaf tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_2.name: False Aggela Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_2.desc:
A False Aggela tuber that can be cultivated into a new adult plant. 
False Aggela can be used for operator skill mastery.
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_2.decoDesc: A False Aggela tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_3.name: Crimson Spearleaf Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_3.desc:
A Crimson Spearleaf tuber that can be cultivated into a new adult plant. 
Crimson Spearleaves can be used for operator skill mastery.
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_3.decoDesc: A Crimson Spearleaf tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_grass_1.name: Jincao
item_plant_grass_1.desc: A plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make food or materials for other products.
item_plant_grass_1.decoDesc: The jincao plant is commonly known as the "silkstar grass", named after the star-like flowers of the plant. The plant usually grows on shaded hillslopes.

item_plant_grass_2.name: Yazhen
item_plant_grass_2.desc: A flowering plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make medication or materials for other products.
item_plant_grass_2.decoDesc: The yazhen plant is an extremely hardy grass native to the Wuling region. The plant produces a rather beautiful bloom during summer.

item_plant_grass_powder_1.name: Jincao Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_grass_powder_1.decoDesc: Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_powder_2.name: Yazhen Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_2.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_grass_powder_2.decoDesc: Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_seed_1.name: Jincao Seed
item_plant_grass_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from the Jincao plant with the Seed-Picking Unit. Cultivate them with Clean Water to raise Jincao.
item_plant_grass_seed_1.decoDesc: Children in the frontier enjoy blowing two jincao leaves placed together to give off a sound that resembles a roaring beast.

item_plant_grass_seed_2.name: Yazhen Seeds
item_plant_grass_seed_2.desc: Seeds picked from the Yazhen plant with the Seed-Picking Unit. Cultivate them with Clean Water to raise Yazhen.
item_plant_grass_seed_2.decoDesc: Yazhen seeds have tiny hooks that aid in their attachment to animal fur for dispersion.

item_plant_grass_spc_1.name: Fluffed Jincao
item_plant_grass_spc_1.desc: A special plant that only grows in the wild. Shred it to acquire materials for making food or other products.
item_plant_grass_spc_1.decoDesc: Some people in Wuling believe that the jincao plant symbolizes hardiness. Many pieces of local literature use the plant as a metaphor for toughness and survival.

item_plant_grass_spc_2.name: Thorny Yazhen
item_plant_grass_spc_2.desc: A special plant that only grows in the wild. Shred it to acquire materials for making food or other products.
item_plant_grass_spc_2.decoDesc: The thorny leaves of the yazhen plant can be used for angling. A few simple steps and bending would create a very effective angling hook.

item_plant_grass_spc_powder_1.name: Fluffed Jincao Powder
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_1.decoDesc: Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.name: Thorny Yazhen Powder
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.decoDesc: Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_moss_1.name: Buckflower
item_plant_moss_1.desc: A plant with brightly colored flowers that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make medication or materials for other products.
item_plant_moss_1.decoDesc: When the War just began, a Hongshan recon team discovered a plant with brightly colored flowers. Extracts of this plant can be used as an anti-hemorrhagic agent.

item_plant_moss_2.name: Citrome
item_plant_moss_2.desc: A fruit  that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make food or materials for other products.
item_plant_moss_2.decoDesc: Citromes are part of the botanical genus of Zitros that usually grows in the central continental region of Talos-II. The species and cultivars grown in the Civilization Band tend to yield large fruits with tough, fibrous flesh.

item_plant_moss_3.name: Sandleaf
item_plant_moss_3.desc: A plant with extremely rough leaves that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC. Shred it to get a powdered preparation usable in industrial grinding.
item_plant_moss_3.decoDesc: The Hannabit Circuit proved themselves as the true masters of wilderness crafting and would use all sorts of natural materials to aid in their crafting.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.name: Ground Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.desc: Acquired by grinding Buckflower Powder. Can be used to produce other items.
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this buckflower preparation with "strangely" improved pharmaceutical activity.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.name: Ground Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.desc: Acquired by grinding Citrome Powder. Can be used to produce other items.
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Citrome preparation with an extremely bitter taste.

item_plant_moss_powder_1.name: Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_moss_powder_1.decoDesc: Shredding would greatly improve the pharmaceutical effectiveness of Buckflower.

item_plant_moss_powder_2.name: Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_2.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_moss_powder_2.decoDesc: Shredding would greatly improve the flavors of Citrome.

item_plant_moss_powder_3.name: Sandleaf Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_3.desc: Powdered Sandleaf. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_moss_powder_3.decoDesc: Shredding releases the abrasive grit from sandleaf tissues for industrial use.

item_plant_moss_seed_1.name: Buckflower Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from the Buckflower plant. Cultivate them to raise Buckflowers.
item_plant_moss_seed_1.decoDesc: The Buckflower earned its name as it was first found under a natural arch that resembled a bucking, jumping beast.

item_plant_moss_seed_2.name: Citrome Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_2.desc: Seeds picked from the Citrome plant. Cultivate them to raise Citromes.
item_plant_moss_seed_2.decoDesc: Hobby botanists and gardeners of the Civilization Band once voted for the Most Common Plants in the Wildlands. Buckflowers and Citromes both made it to the top 10 of the list.

item_plant_moss_seed_3.name: Sandleaf Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_3.desc: Seeds picked from the Sandleaf plant. Cultivate them to raise Sandleaves.
item_plant_moss_seed_3.decoDesc: The history of wilderness crafting can be traced back nearly a century ago. People forced to live in the wildlands had to do everything they could to survive.

item_plant_moss_spc_1.name: Firebuckle
item_plant_moss_spc_1.desc: A plant with extremely brightly colored flowers that grows in the wild. Can be used for treatment and the making of fine food and medicine (Fine F&M). Firebuckles do not provide seeds.
item_plant_moss_spc_1.decoDesc: Buckflowers bloom in mid-April. Plants with the most fiery-red flowers would be called Firebuckles.

item_plant_moss_spc_2.name: Umbraline
item_plant_moss_spc_2.desc: A plant with special fruits that grows in the wild. Can be used for treatment and the making of fine food and medicine (Fine F&M). Umbralines do not provide seeds.
item_plant_moss_spc_2.decoDesc: Around 12 major Citrome cultivars are currently sold in the markets of the Civilization Band. They come in all sorts of names and offer different juiciness and sugar content. However, they are all Citromes.

item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.name: Firebuckle Powder
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.decoDesc: A simple powdered preparation of Firebuckle. You can use it to treat wounds, but its pharmaceutical potential goes way beyond that.

item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.name: Citromix
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.decoDesc: A simple blended preparation that can be consumed by mixing with some water. If you're unlucky, you might get some bitter bits of rind in your pack.

item_plant_mushroom_1_1.name: Pink Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_1.desc:
A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Promotes Lv.20 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_1_1.decoDesc: Toxicity of the ruby bolete would already be extremely high when the sporocarp reaches a certain size and starts acquiring a reddish hue. This is the pink stage.

item_plant_mushroom_1_2.name: Red Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_2.desc:
A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Promotes Lv.40 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_1_2.decoDesc: Ruby boletes with darker hues provide extracts with greater pharmaceutical values. This is the red stage.
obtainWays: Main Mission Progress and Unlock Transmute Formulas

item_plant_mushroom_1_3.name: Ruby Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_3.desc:
A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Promotes Lv.60 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_1_3.decoDesc: Every year, many pioneers suffer multiple organ failure caused by ruby bolete poisoning. This often results from misjudging the edible stage of the fungus. Eating the fungus in ruby stage is extremely dangerous.

item_plant_mushroom_2_1.name: Bloodcap
item_plant_mushroom_2_1.desc:
A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Promotes Lv.80 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_2_1.decoDesc: Bloodcap is likely to be a variant of a carnivorous fungus mutated by ambient Blight. Nutrients consumed by the fungus would course through its mycelia.

item_plant_mushroom_2_2.name: Cosmagaric
item_plant_mushroom_2_2.desc:
A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Promotes Lv.80 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_2_2.decoDesc: A common fungus that proliferated in various regions of Talos-II after the Cosmic Gate broke down. Terran fowlbeasts brought to the new world exhibit a special preference for these surprisingly hard "local mushrooms". Cosmagaric also disperse their spores by attaching them to the long feathers of the fowls.

item_plant_mushroom_2_3.name: Talos Cap
item_plant_mushroom_2_3.desc:
A special fungus gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Promotes Lv.80 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_2_3.decoDesc: A rare fungus found in the wilderness. The Talos Cap is named for its bright colors and patterns that resemble Talos, the ever-present gas giant that dominates the skies.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.name: Pink Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.desc:
A Pink Bolete mycelial mass that can be cultivated into a new adult fungus. 
Pink Boletes can promote Lv.20 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Pink Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.name: Red Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.desc:
A Red Bolete mycelial mass that can be cultivated into a new adult fungus. 
Red Boletes can promote Lv.40 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.decoDesc: A Red Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.name: Ruby Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.desc:
A Ruby Bolete mycelial mass that can be cultivated into a new adult fungus. 
Red Boletes can promote Lv.60 operators.
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.decoDesc: A Ruby Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.name: Bloodcap Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.desc:
A Bloodcap mycelial mass that can be cultivated into a new adult fungus. 
Bloodcaps can promote certain Lv.80 or higher operators.
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.decoDesc: A Bloodcap mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_2.name: Cosmagaric Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_2.desc:
A Cosmagaric mycelial mass that can be cultivated into a new adult fungus. 
Cosmagarics can promote certain Lv.80 or higher operators.
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_2.decoDesc: A Cosmagaric mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_3.name: Talos Cap Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_3.desc:
A Talos Cap mycelial mass that can be cultivated into a new adult fungus. 
Talos Caps can promote certain Lv.80 or higher operators.
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_3.decoDesc: A Talos Cap mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.name: Rare Fungus
item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.desc: A rare fungus that UWST scientist Linnaeus needs for his pharmaceutical preparation.
item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.decoDesc: A rare fungus that grows in Valley IV. It can be used as a catalyst when making medication. UWST scientist Linnaeus was the first to discover this property.

item_plant_sp_1.name: Reed Rye
item_plant_sp_1.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.
item_plant_sp_1.decoDesc: Reed Rye is a hardy cereal with an impressive yield. It is the staple food of most settlers in the frontier.

item_plant_sp_2.name: Tartpepper
item_plant_sp_2.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.
item_plant_sp_2.decoDesc: The leaves of this plant are considered the "most bitter herbs of the frontier".

item_plant_sp_3.name: Redjade Ginseng
item_plant_sp_3.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.
item_plant_sp_3.decoDesc: Redjade Ginseng is a mild herb often consumed by people in Hongshan as a fortifying supplement.

item_plant_sp_4.name: Amber Rice
item_plant_sp_4.desc: This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.
item_plant_sp_4.decoDesc: The rounded, jade-like endosperm of the Amber Rice is also regarded as "amber pearls".

item_plant_sp_seed_1.name: Reed Rye Seeds
item_plant_sp_seed_1.desc: Seeds picked from wild Reed Rye. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to raise Reed Rye.
item_plant_sp_seed_1.decoDesc: Reed Rye seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_seed_2.name: Tartpepper Seeds
item_plant_sp_seed_2.desc: Seeds picked from wild Tartpepper. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to raise Tartpepper.
item_plant_sp_seed_2.decoDesc: Tartpepper seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_seed_3.name: Redjade Ginseng Seeds
item_plant_sp_seed_3.desc: Seeds picked from wild Redjade Ginseng. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to raise Redjade Ginseng.
item_plant_sp_seed_3.decoDesc: Redjade Ginseng seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_sp_seed_4.name: Amber Rice Seeds
item_plant_sp_seed_4.desc: Seeds picked from wild Amber Rice. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to raise Amber Rice.
item_plant_sp_seed_4.decoDesc: Amber Rice seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_plant_spcstone_1_1.name: Kalkonyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_1.desc:
A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Tunes Lv.20 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_1_1.decoDesc: Nyxites are also known as the "ancient mineral" and symbolize an age of destruction of such a scale never witnessed by humanity. They come in various hues.

item_plant_spcstone_1_2.name: Auronyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_2.desc:
A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Tunes Lv.40 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_1_2.decoDesc: Humans have yet to figure out how nyxites form. This secret of Talos-II has yet to unveil itself.
obtainWays: Main Mission Progress and Unlock Transmute Formulas

item_plant_spcstone_1_3.name: Umbronyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_3.desc:
A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Tunes Lv.60 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_1_3.decoDesc: People usually name nyxite crystals based on their color (Kalkonyx, Auronyx, and Umbronyx) but these differences are just caused by the extent of oxidation.

item_plant_spcstone_2_1.name: Igneosite
item_plant_spcstone_2_1.desc:
A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Tunes Lv.80 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_2_1.decoDesc: Scientists postulate that Igneosites are metamorphic forms of nyxite subject to volcanic eruptions followed by Blight exposure.

item_plant_spcstone_2_2.name: Wulingstone
item_plant_spcstone_2_2.desc:
A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Tunes Lv.80 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_2_2.decoDesc: A mineral formation created by extremely complex hydrological changes. Wulingstone was first discovered by Hongshan Tianshi conducting hydrological surveys at the Wuling region. Under the influence of Æther, sediments carried by water would settle at certain depths and eventually form Wulingstone. These rocks are useful in fluviochronology and the study of local hydrological history.

item_plant_spcstone_2_3.name: Protocolith
item_plant_spcstone_2_3.desc:
A special mineral gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the Growth Chamber. 
Tunes Lv.80 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_2_3.decoDesc: A type of mineral created under the influence of unique spatial phenomena. It seems to be associated with the manifestation of Protocol Spaces. The opalescent surface appears to be results of "rubbing" against these dimensional pockets.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.name: Kalkonyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.desc:
A seeding cluster of Kalkonyx that can be used to grow a new crystal. 
Kalkonyxes can tune Lv.20 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Kalkonyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.name: Auronyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.desc:
A seeding cluster of Auronyx that can be used to grow a new crystal. 
Auronyxes can tune Lv.40 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.decoDesc: An Auronyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.name: Umbronyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.desc:
A seeding cluster of Umbronyx that can be used to grow a new crystal. 
Umbronyxes can tune Lv.60 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.decoDesc: An Umbronyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_1.name: Igneosite Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_1.desc:
A seeding cluster of Igneosite that can be used to grow a new crystal. 
Igneosites can tune Lv.80 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_1.decoDesc: An Igneosite seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_2.name: Wulingstone Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_2.desc:
A seeding cluster of Wulingstone that can be used to grow a new crystal. 
Wulingstones can tune Lv.80 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_2.decoDesc: A Wulingstone seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_3.name: Protocolith Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_3.desc:
A seeding cluster of Protocolith that can be used to grow a new crystal. 
Protocoliths can tune Lv.80 weapons.
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_3.decoDesc: A Protocolith seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_tundra_impts.name: Plant Matter
item_plant_tundra_impts.desc: Leftover plant matter from the seed-picking process. Can be refined and turned into Carbon.

item_plant_tundra_insect_1.name: Glowbug
item_plant_tundra_insect_1.desc: A small flying Originium bug. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_tundra_insect_1.decoDesc: A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can give off a gentle glow.

item_plant_tundra_insect_2.name: Scorchbug
item_plant_tundra_insect_2.desc: A small flying Originium bug with high energy content. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_tundra_insect_2.decoDesc: A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can glow and give off a bit of heat.

item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.name: Glowbug Powder
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.desc: Powdered preparation of Glowbugs. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.decoDesc: The powdered exoskeleton of Glowbugs can still give off a gentle glow.

item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.name: Scorchbug Powder
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.desc: Powdered preparation of Scorchbugs. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.decoDesc: The powdered exoskeleton of Scorchbugs can still give off a gentle glow. NOTE: Monitor facility temperature during processing.

item_plant_tundra_wood.name: Wood
item_plant_tundra_wood.desc: Common wood that can be gathered in the Mossfield region. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_plant_tundra_wood.decoDesc: Let's chop down some trees first.

item_port_air_dancer_1.name: Tube Professor
item_port_air_dancer_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_air_dancer_1.decoDesc: Focus! The professor is going to lay down some serious factory know-how!

item_port_barbecue_1.name: Hot Roast Party
item_port_barbecue_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_barbecue_1.decoDesc: Listen to the sizzling crackles! The party is just getting hot!

item_port_battle_cannon_1.name: Grenade Tower
item_port_battle_cannon_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>981 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>3s Mode of Attack: Launches grenades in a ballistic trajectory. The grenades detonate above ground near enemies and deal area of effect <@ba.fire>Heat DMG.
item_port_battle_cannon_1.decoDesc: A launcher of compressed Originium grenades. Designs are based on small field guns used during the Aggeloi War.

item_port_battle_cannon_2.name: HE Grenade Tower
item_port_battle_cannon_2.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>5585 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>3s Mode of Attack: Attacks enemies by launching Mk Ⅱ grenades along a ballistic trajectory that detonate above ground near enemies. The grenade explosion deals area of effect <@ba.fire>Heat DMG and leaves a burning zone that deals DMG to enemies within it.
item_port_battle_cannon_2.decoDesc: A launcher of compressed high explosive (HE) Originium grenades. This facility deals more devastating area damage compared to its standard counterpart.

item_port_battle_debuff_1.name: Acid Soaker Mk I
item_port_battle_debuff_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>12375 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Launches special acid grenades that detonate above ground near enemies to deal <@ba.natur>Nature DMG and apply DEF Reduction to enemies in the area of effect.
item_port_battle_debuff_1.decoDesc: A special upgrade to Marsh Gas Mk I designed to counter units with high defense. The tower fires shells filled with highly corrosive fluids that effectively eat away the enemy's defensive capabilities.

item_port_battle_fog_1.name: Marsh Gas Mk I
item_port_battle_fog_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>5485 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Launches special mist grenades that detonate above ground near enemies. The mist grenade explosion deals <@ba.natur>Nature DMG over time and applies slow to enemies within the area of effect.
item_port_battle_fog_1.decoDesc: A multi-purpose facility furnished with a special Arts Unit that uses poisonous materials to effectively halt an enemy offensive. They say the storage tank is filled with a special adhesive with a faulty formula that made it highly corrosive instead. However, this "failed" adhesive found new purpose as a weapon instead.

item_port_battle_frost_1.name: LN Tower
item_port_battle_frost_1.desc: Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Fires special liquid nitrogen (LN) crystals that shatter upon impact to slow the movement speed of enemies in the area of effect.
item_port_battle_frost_1.decoDesc: An experimental weapon with ammo of special crystal rounds filled with liquid nitrogen (LN). The ammo would shatter upon impact, spilling its freezing contents onto the enemy to apply frostbite that impedes their movements.

item_port_battle_jet_1.name: Deluge Tower
item_port_battle_jet_1.desc: Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Fires a stream of deluge at approaching enemies. The stream pushes back small and medium enemies along the direction of the attack.
item_port_battle_jet_1.decoDesc: A disrupting facility furnished with a fluid pressurization module. If you hope to avoid the "overwhelming momentum" of a Tide Surge, please do not face it directly.

item_port_battle_laser_1.name: Beam Tower
item_port_battle_laser_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>22338 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a beam that deals massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG to enemies.
item_port_battle_laser_1.decoDesc: An experimental weapon armed with an energy converter. Treat this as a miniaturized version of a city-defense giga-cannon. The system is unpopular in the arms market due to its steep energy demands and the fact that it is an unstable and risky weapon platform.

item_port_battle_laser_2.name: Hyper Beam Tower
item_port_battle_laser_2.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>45375 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to emit a powerful beam to deal massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG to enemies. This tower prioritizes its attacks at high threat targets within range.
item_port_battle_laser_2.decoDesc: An upgraded version of the Beam Tower. Endfield Industries improved the stability of this weapon platform with Protocol Originium. Unfortunately, no effective solutions could be found for the massive energy consumption.

item_port_battle_lightning_1.name: Surge Tower
item_port_battle_lightning_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>4886 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>3s Mode of Attack: Releases electrical arcs that attack enemies. The arc also chains to nearby enemies (up to 2) and deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG.
item_port_battle_lightning_1.decoDesc: Years of research on electricity-related Originium Arts gave rise to the Surge Tower. Power output has been greatly increased while minimizing the risk of friendly fire.

item_port_battle_lightning_2.name: Electrocharger Model A-2
