item_port_battle_lightning_2.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>20625 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Releases electrical arcs that attack enemies. The arc chains to nearby enemies (up to 2) and deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG. The arc also leaves an electric orb close to the enemy. The orb continuously deals <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG to nearby enemies.
item_port_battle_lightning_2.decoDesc: An improvement of the original Surge Tower based on an experimental prototype from RAYTHEAN Industries. When the land courses with electricity, nothing will ever block your path.

item_port_battle_medic_1.name: Medical Tower
item_port_battle_medic_1.desc: Minimum HP Treatment Interval: <@ba.key>5s Converts electrical power into healing arts that can treat injured operators nearby.
item_port_battle_medic_1.decoDesc: A healing facility furnished with medical Arts casting units. The designers made the tower spherical because gentle curves are visually more comforting to the injured.

item_port_battle_rocket_1.name: Sledgehammer Mortar
item_port_battle_rocket_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>33000 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>8s Mode of Attack: Consumes vast amounts of energy to fire an extremely powerful shell. The shell deals massive <@ba.phy>Physical DMG to enemies in the area of effect.
item_port_battle_rocket_1.decoDesc: A heavy weapon platform loaded with large Originium shells. This particular mortar offers the most devastating punch possible amongst ordnance of the same class.

item_port_battle_shockwave_1.name: Omnidirectional Sonic Tower
item_port_battle_shockwave_1.desc: Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Fires a shockwave that <@ba.vdown>stuns common and advanced enemies within the area of effect.
item_port_battle_shockwave_1.decoDesc: A crowd control facility furnished with a specialized Arts unit. It can emit targeted sonic waves that overwhelm an entity's nervous systems to stun them. The overwhelming power of the sonic waves seem to allow them to disrupt Aggeloid movements.

item_port_battle_sniper_1.name: Sentry Tower
item_port_battle_sniper_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>11634 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>5s Mode of Attack: Unleashes long-range attacks that target high-threat enemies first and deal massive <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.
item_port_battle_sniper_1.decoDesc: This weapon is inspired by the ranged weaponry of the Aggeloi. The designer has furnished it with high-precision optical recognition modules to accurately target high-threat targets and deal effective damage.

item_port_battle_trap_1.name: AF1 Armor Fragger
item_port_battle_trap_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>17252 Mode of Attack: Fires a flaming jet to attack approaching enemies. The flaming jet deals <@ba.fire>Heat DMG over time to enemies within range.
item_port_battle_trap_1.decoDesc: A combat facility that can project jets of fire. It uses a fuel comprising a mixture of various flammable liquids. The power to set everything aflame reminds people of the merciless infernos often described in Terran history.

item_port_battle_turret_1.name: Gun Tower
item_port_battle_turret_1.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>609 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires energy bolts that deal <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.
item_port_battle_turret_1.decoDesc: Once the complex firing mechanism was simplified, it was combined with the logic of automation designs to create this integrated weapon platform. Many frontier outposts and villages used prototypes of this system to defend themselves against dangerous wildlife.

item_port_battle_turret_2.name: Heavy Gun Tower
item_port_battle_turret_2.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>2136 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires Mk II energy bolts with every 4th shot being an empowered bolt. The bolts deal <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.
item_port_battle_turret_2.decoDesc: An upgraded version of the Gun Tower. People call this the Tomb Digger due to its merciless killing power.

item_port_battle_turret_3.name: Torrent Gun Tower
item_port_battle_turret_3.desc: ATK: <@ba.key>10310 Attack Interval: <@ba.key>2s Mode of Attack: Continuously fires Mk Ⅲ energy bolts and an empowered energy bolt for every 6th attack at enemies within range. The bolts deal <@ba.phy>Physical DMG.
item_port_battle_turret_3.decoDesc: A new gun tower that is strongly recommended by arsenal engineers of Endfield Industries. An engineer ran for miles in a torrential hailstorm. It comes as no surprise that she'd design a weapon platform that unleashes fusillades of extreme devastation.

item_port_burger_1.name: Lord of the Hamburgers
item_port_burger_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_burger_1.decoDesc: A massive hamburger exuding the aura of majesty... Wait. Why are you on a dinner plate?

item_port_carrier_1.name: Easy Stash
item_port_carrier_1.desc: A facility that allows quick access of items in the Depot.
item_port_carrier_1.decoDesc: "Are you sure the things inside belong to the Endmin?"

item_port_cat_tree_1.name: Howlerbeast Playground
item_port_cat_tree_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_cat_tree_1.decoDesc: Arcane likes small critters and easily zones out when she spots them. This critter playground is one of the very few things she has purchased for herself. She once spent three hours watching them play.

item_port_chubby_lung_balloon_1.name: Chubby Lung Balloon
item_port_chubby_lung_balloon_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_chubby_lung_balloon_1.decoDesc: A favorite purchase of almost every traveling merchant. This is the very place where you can get Chubby Lung Balloons for decorating all sorts of places, from shopping malls to private residences.

item_port_chubby_lung_stone_1.name: Chubby Lung Bollard
item_port_chubby_lung_stone_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_chubby_lung_stone_1.decoDesc:
"According to our inventory, these are pieces of public art made to custom specifications..." 
"Are you sure we didn't just nick them from the streets of Wuling?"

item_port_cmpt_mc_1.name: Fitting Unit
item_port_cmpt_mc_1.desc: A facility capable of processing various parts.
item_port_cmpt_mc_1.decoDesc: Comes with grinding wheels, planing wheels, polishing bits, and milling cutters.

item_port_crystal_ball_1.name: Amma's Tender Love
item_port_crystal_ball_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_crystal_ball_1.decoDesc: Slowly She gave Her love in this tiny and serene snowscape.

item_port_dismantler_1.name: Separating Unit
item_port_dismantler_1.desc: A facility that physically disassembles various items.
item_port_dismantler_1.decoDesc: Eighty percent of those who first heard the story of the separating unit simply refused to believe this fact: The design of this facility was inspired by large UWST disassembling stations for sawing and cutting apart Aggeloi carcasses.

item_port_display_stand_1.name: "Idol Pose" Ad Stand
item_port_display_stand_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_display_stand_1.decoDesc: Any fan of Liino who walks past this ad stand cannot help but stop to take a snapshot of their favorite idol. This ad stand is the most frequent icon for any discussion about Liino's concerts. Fans have been using it to embellish their memories of the fan-meets.

item_port_doll_1.name: "Morning Star" Companion-Type Figurine
item_port_doll_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_doll_1.decoDesc: The fan's favorite commemorative merchandise ever released after Liino's debut. This lovely and intricate figurine of dreams is everything that a Liino fan desires. However, it is literally out of reach for ordinary fans because of the vile machinations of hunger marketing and access limitation.

item_port_dream_bubble_1.name: Lucid Dream
item_port_dream_bubble_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_dream_bubble_1.decoDesc: "Alright. Time to give myself into dreamscape. It has been a long, tiring day. Giving the dreams some nonsensical fun seems like a pretty good choice."

item_port_dumper_1.name: Fluid Supply Unit
item_port_dumper_1.decoDesc: "Give me an alternative function. I need sales!"

item_port_filling_pd_mc_1.name: Filling Unit
item_port_filling_pd_mc_1.desc: A facility capable of filling containers with various materials.
item_port_filling_pd_mc_1.decoDesc: The patented sterile packaging technology has greatly reduced the probability of product contamination.

item_port_furnance_1.name: Refining Unit
item_port_furnance_1.desc: A facility that performs high temperature refining of various materials.
item_port_furnance_1.decoDesc: Crystal delamination and thermal moulding... Heat changes, transforms, and even enables reactions in various materials to create something new.

item_port_gas_pump_1.name: Gas Extractor
item_port_gas_pump_1.desc: A facility that can extract Inergen and other gases. It does not require power to work.
item_port_gas_pump_1.decoDesc: Those companies would never realize why Endfield Industries bought up all those vacuum cleaner patents.

item_port_gas_reactor_1.name: Gas Reactor Globe
item_port_gas_reactor_1.desc: A facility for performing gas-phase reactions.
item_port_gas_reactor_1.decoDesc: "The facility must be completely hermetic and include thermostats, humidity controllers, and separator modules... You think I'm complaining about design challenges? No. In fact, I'm planning to fit a self-destruct module into this contraption."

item_port_gas_storager_1.name: Gas Tank
item_port_gas_storager_1.decoDesc: When supplies run low, this gas tank can be modified to create improvised ammunition.

item_port_grinder_1.name: Shredding Unit
item_port_grinder_1.desc: A heavy facility that shreds and pulverizes various materials.
item_port_grinder_1.decoDesc: Can you hear the crunch of the heavy industrial shredders?

item_port_jail_1.name: Tiger Cage
item_port_jail_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_jail_1.decoDesc: A tiger can be securely kept in this thing.

item_port_liquid_cleaner_1.name: Water Treatment Unit
item_port_liquid_cleaner_1.desc: A facility for processing Sewage. It can also process Xircon Effluent and Inert Xircon Effluent, albeit with limited efficiency.
item_port_liquid_cleaner_1.decoDesc: Endfield greatly improved the efficiency of its water treatment process by employing Techno-Protocol in the steps of disinfection and remediation.

item_port_liquid_purifier_1.name: Purification Unit
item_port_liquid_purifier_1.desc: A facility for raising the purity of various solutions or gases.
item_port_liquid_purifier_1.decoDesc:
"My friend, you understand, right? Our alchemical arts have had a splendorous history. Just look at the starry cosmos outside... This place should not be the end of our conquests and achievements! I need a better place! An optimized, stable, and Originium-rich environment!" 
"Is that your excuse for almost breaching the hull of Dijiang with explosives?"

item_port_liquid_storager_1.name: Fluid Tank
item_port_liquid_storager_1.decoDesc: It took the engineers nearly 5 years to come up with a tank that can store corrosive fluids while being resistant against the effects of ambient Blight.

item_port_loader_1.name: Depot Loader
item_port_loader_1.desc: A placeable loading point that delivers goods from the AIC Factory to a local depot. The Depot Loader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.
item_port_loader_1.decoDesc: An upgrade plan was stipulated after the AIC Factory was deployed for a second time in a high-threat area. Blight-resistant steel was used to construct Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders.

item_port_log_hongs_bus.name: Depot Bus Section
item_port_log_hongs_bus.desc: A bus section that can be deployed in the Core AIC Area. The Depot Bus Section must be connected to a Depot Bus Port or other active Depot Bus Sections. Once active, Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be attached to the Depot Bus.
item_port_log_hongs_bus.decoDesc: For facilities that incorporate Xiranite with AIC technology, the Xiranite particles mainly provide "stabilizing" effects against rifting or the Blight. Xiranite particles flowing within these facilities can ensure that the movement of goods in/out of the depot via loaders/unloaders would not be affected by local environmental anomalies.

item_port_log_hongs_bus_source.name: Depot Bus Port
item_port_log_hongs_bus_source.desc: The origin of the Depot Bus. The Depot Bus Port can be placed anywhere in the Core AIC Area.
item_port_log_hongs_bus_source.decoDesc: For some engineers, Xiranite would often inspire crazy ideas that they themselves couldn't even explain. What is the endpoint of industry? Are there other possibilities for Xiranite, the material of unprecedented "freedom"? Will human industrial technology ever reach the "formless" state? The more the engineers think, the more they believe that every step they take is a revolutionary one.

item_port_marker_1.name: Memo Beacon
item_port_marker_1.desc: A facility that can be used to post and leave beacon memos.
item_port_marker_1.decoDesc: Assist or deceive. Observe with your eyes. Validate with your actions... This is the proof of our "links" as we face the challenges of Talos-II together.

item_port_microphone_1.name: "Ribbon Voice" Microphone
item_port_microphone_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_microphone_1.decoDesc: Liino's favorite mike and the one she uses most often. According to Liino, she designed the bow tie and trimmed the ribbon herself to commemorate her first stage performance.

item_port_miner_1.name: Portable Originium Rig
item_port_miner_1.desc: A mining rig for digging up Originium Ore. This rig does not need to be connected to the power grid to work as it powers itself using the Originium it mines.
item_port_miner_1.decoDesc: The best selling product of Endfield Industries.

item_port_miner_2.name: Electric Mining Rig
item_port_miner_2.desc: Requires power. This mining rig can mine Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore.
item_port_miner_2.decoDesc: Market performance for this facility was mediocre due to its equally mediocre stats.

item_port_miner_3.name: Electric Mining Rig Mk II
item_port_miner_3.desc: Must be connected to the power grid with adequate power to work. This mining rig can mine Ferrium Ore and other minerals.
item_port_miner_3.decoDesc: The Mk II upgrade of the electric mining rig features improved drill bit hardness, improved performance in rugged environment, and deeper mining capabilities.

item_port_miner_4.name: Hydro Mining Rig
item_port_miner_4.desc: A mining rig for digging up various types of ore such as Cuprium Ore. This rig does not need power as it can be driven with Clean Water.
item_port_miner_4.decoDesc: The Endfield Hydro Mining Rig features a special coating to minimize the risk of rusting in humid/wet environments.

item_port_mix_pool_1.name: Reactor Crucible
item_port_mix_pool_1.desc: A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions.
item_port_mix_pool_1.decoDesc: After multiple incidents of reactor failures caused by material fatigue and corrosion, Endfield finally decided to approach UWST and purchase a batch of special steel from southern Talos-II.

item_port_mix_pool_2.name: Expanded Crucible
item_port_mix_pool_2.desc: A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions. It also comes with additional input and output ports and the ability to run multiple reactions simultaneously.

item_port_pear_blossom_bonsai_1.name: Miniature Tree on a Hill
item_port_pear_blossom_bonsai_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_pear_blossom_bonsai_1.decoDesc: Verdant spring wakes upon the enduring land, yet friends have gone and times have changed.

item_port_phase_trans_1.name: Fluid-Gas Transmuting Unit
item_port_phase_trans_1.desc: When activated by a steady input of Liquid Xiranite, this facility can transmute fluid materials into gas, and vice versa.
item_port_phase_trans_1.decoDesc: A special facility that can transmute materials into another state. The process may sound simple, but every single component of the facility, down to the most basic thermometer, is the pinnacle of modern Originium Arts and technology.

item_port_phase_trans_2.name: Solid-Gas Transmuting Unit
item_port_phase_trans_2.desc: When activated by a steady input of Xiragen, this facility can transmute solid materials into gas, and vice versa.
item_port_phase_trans_2.decoDesc: A special facility that can transmute materials into another state. During the design phase, the engineers accessed every entry on Originium Arts and technology in the SOW database. Successful recovery of data lost during the Aggeloi War provided crucial inspiration for the scientists today.

item_port_photo_frame_1.name: Sanguine Memories
item_port_photo_frame_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_photo_frame_1.decoDesc: The fire died, but no one is left in the photoframe.

item_port_planter_1.name: Planting Unit
item_port_planter_1.desc: A cultivating silo for growing various common plants and crops.
item_port_planter_1.decoDesc: This facility is designed entirely by Endfield Industries. Its cutting edge technologies include real-time monitoring and modulation of silo lighting, temperature, and plant hormone levels.

item_port_power_diffuser_1.name: Electric Pylon
item_port_power_diffuser_1.desc:
Once connected to the power grid, this pylon can wirelessly power all Endfield facilities within a sizable area of effect.
Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also gives this facility a 30-meter power transmission capability.
item_port_power_diffuser_1.decoDesc: Wireless electrical connection is one of the biggest technological breakthroughs achieved by Endfield Industries. This tech was further improved with Techno-Protocol to provide the very foundation of the AIC Factory.

item_port_power_diffuser_2.name: Xiranite Pylon
item_port_power_diffuser_2.desc: The Xiranite Pylon can auto-connect to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and Xiranite Relays within 80 meters; and to Xiranite Pylons and other power facilities within 30 meters. When placed inside the Core AIC Area, it can auto-connect to the PAC regardless of distance. This pylon can be used to supply power to facilities within range and transmit power across short distances.
item_port_power_diffuser_2.decoDesc: A Techno-Protocol Electric Pylon furnished with a Xiranite receiving module. For electrical currents coursing between the relays, such modules serve as beacons in the darkness that accurately guide them towards their destination pylons with extremely low transmission loss.

item_port_power_pole_2.name: Relay Tower
item_port_power_pole_2.desc:
This relay can be used to transmit power to other facilities within an 80-meter radius.
Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also lets it supply power to other Endfield facilities within a small area.
item_port_power_pole_2.decoDesc: The Relay Tower is one of the most expensive AIC facilities to construct. Its overall design is based on the PAC.

item_port_power_pole_3.name: Xiranite Relay
item_port_power_pole_3.desc: The Xiranite Relay can auto-connect to the Protocol Automation-Core (PAC) and any type of Xiranite power facilities within 80 meters. When placed inside the Core AIC Area, it can auto-connect to the PAC regardless of distance. This relay can be used for power transmission and can supply power to nearby facilities.
item_port_power_pole_3.decoDesc: An electrical relay that combines Xiranite and Techno-Protocol electrical infrastructure technologies. The Xiranite components perform three major functions of identification, positioning, and stabilization. This avoids connection gridlocks between facilities and greatly minimizes the risk of accidental fires.

item_port_power_port_1.name: Electric Nexus
item_port_power_port_1.desc: Electric Nexuses are usually placed at the end of power transmission lines. Connect them to the power grid to supply power to nearby facilities.
item_port_power_port_1.decoDesc: The very first Endfield Industries Electric Nexus was placed in the Northern Barrens. It had stood on that uninhabited permafrost for nearly a century.

item_port_power_sta_1.name: Thermal Bank
item_port_power_sta_1.desc: A facility that converts Originium Ore or batteries into electrical power. It must be connected to the power grid to work.
item_port_power_sta_1.decoDesc: The Thermal Bank received 3 revolutionary tech upgrades in the last decade.

item_port_pump_1.name: Fluid Pump
item_port_pump_1.desc: Requires power. A facility for pumping fluids.
item_port_pump_1.decoDesc: The Endfield manufacturing center constructs this pressure engine by attaching a power module to a basic water pump purchased by the Procurement Division.

item_port_pump_2.name: Acid Resistant Pump Mk II
item_port_pump_2.desc: Requires power. A facility for pumping fluids. It is also capable of pumping corrosive liquids.
item_port_pump_2.decoDesc: Unconfirmed rumors claimed that engineers working on the Acid Resistant Pump Mk II have expressed hushed concerns about their product during meal breaks in the Dijiang canteen. Though Precipitation Acids have been proven to be sufficiently safe, the engineers are worried that the material would react uncontrollably with Aggelos-related items. Hence, they furnished this type of fluid pumps with an emergency lockdown module.

item_port_rainbow_1.name: Rainbow
item_port_rainbow_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_rainbow_1.decoDesc: Every wave is a rainbow, a perfect smile to hide one's title in.

item_port_seedcol_1.name: Seed-Picking Unit
item_port_seedcol_1.desc: A facility that extracts seeds from common crops.
item_port_seedcol_1.decoDesc: Many Talosians enjoy harvesting and gathering.

item_port_shaper_1.name: Moulding Unit
item_port_shaper_1.desc: A facility that produces various containers via stamp moulding.
item_port_shaper_1.decoDesc: After jointly organizing a product discussion conference with UWST, Endfield Industries finally overcame the challenges involved in the replacement of moulding dies.

item_port_signboard_1.name: Shockingly Delish!
item_port_signboard_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_signboard_1.decoDesc: Unquestionably the highest form of approval in Talos-II for both spiritual and material needs.

item_port_soil_bbflower_1.name: Aketine Plot
item_port_soil_bbflower_1.desc: To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Aketine.
item_port_soil_bbflower_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Aketine. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_port_soil_corp_bean_1.name: Ballpea Plot
item_port_soil_corp_bean_1.desc: To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Ballpeas.
item_port_soil_corp_bean_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Ballpeas. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_port_soil_corp_cabbage_1.name: Cabbage Plot
item_port_soil_corp_cabbage_1.desc: To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Cabbage.
item_port_soil_corp_cabbage_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Cabbage. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_port_soil_corp_cabbage_2.name: Cabbage Plot [A]
item_port_soil_corp_cabbage_2.desc: To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Cabbage [A].
item_port_soil_corp_cabbage_2.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Cabbage [A]. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_port_soil_corp_canolaflower_1.name: Oilseed Bloom Plot
item_port_soil_corp_canolaflower_1.desc: To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Oilseed Blooms.
item_port_soil_corp_canolaflower_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Oilseed Blooms. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_port_soil_corp_mushroom_1.name: Relishroom Plot

item_port_sp_hub_1.name: Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)
item_port_sp_hub_1.desc: A massive Endfield core facility that can supply power to various facilities and industrial processes.
item_port_sp_hub_1.decoDesc: The Protocol PAC (PAC) represents the core technology of Endfield Industries. The seed was planted when they stepped through the door, and it is slowly growing to become a massive technological oak.

item_port_sp_sub_hub_1.name: Sub-PAC
item_port_sp_sub_hub_1.desc: A secondary core facility that can supply power to various facilities and industrial processes. It must have an electrical connection to the main PAC to function.
item_port_sp_sub_hub_1.decoDesc: The AIC Factory shall connect one node to the next in order to expand into the uninhabited frontiers.

item_port_squirter_1.name: Sprinkler
item_port_squirter_1.desc: A facility that sprays fluids in a fixed direction.
item_port_squirter_1.decoDesc: Blight pollution of aquifers was a problem that plagued Talosians for years until Hongshan Academy of Sciences provided the definitive water treatment solution.

item_port_stock_board_1.name: Redistribution Made Manifest
item_port_stock_board_1.desc: An ornamental item. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_stock_board_1.decoDesc: "Lucky Carrot has restocked? Time to dump it all."

item_port_storager_1.name: Protocol Stash
item_port_storager_1.desc: A storage facility with several item storage slots. Once connected to the power grid and given enough power, it can teleport items to the Depot. Hence, the stash is often placed at the end of production lines.
item_port_storager_1.decoDesc: It took Endfield engineers nearly a decade to achieve tele-protocol of small items within limited range.

item_port_thickener_1.name: Grinding Unit
item_port_thickener_1.desc: A facility that performs fine grinding of powdered materials.
item_port_thickener_1.decoDesc: This facility was based on a traditional crop processing machinery from Yan.

item_port_tools_asm_mc_1.name: Packaging Unit
item_port_tools_asm_mc_1.desc: A facility for packaging certain power components.
item_port_tools_asm_mc_1.decoDesc: All sorts of batteries had been made in various regions of Talos-II. When the war finally ended, humanity gradually established unified standards and specifications for battery production.

item_port_travel_pole_1.name: Zipline Pylon
item_port_travel_pole_1.desc: A small zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within an 80-meter radius to create a zipline.
item_port_travel_pole_1.decoDesc: The earliest ziplines of Talos-II were constructed to help traverse the precipitous Blighted regions of the uninhabited snowy mountains in the Northern Barrens. Ziplines were the leading technology that helped humanity defeat the Aggeloid Blockade.

item_port_travel_pole_2.name: Zipline Tower
item_port_travel_pole_2.desc: A large zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within a 110-meter radius to create a zipline.
item_port_travel_pole_2.decoDesc: Recently, ziplines became a growing fad in the tourism sector as well as extreme sports athletes. The Endfield marketing team really demonstrated their skills in this case.

item_port_travel_pole_nop_1.name: Zipline Pylon
item_port_travel_pole_nop_1.desc: A small zipline facility that can be connected to another zipline facility within an 80-meter radius to create a zipline.
item_port_travel_pole_nop_1.decoDesc: The earliest ziplines of Talos-II were constructed to help traverse the precipitous Blighted regions of the uninhabited snowy mountains in the Northern Barrens. Ziplines were the leading technology that helped humanity defeat the Aggeloid Blockade.

item_port_udpipe_loader_1.name: Conduit Inlet
item_port_udpipe_loader_1.desc: An inlet for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet to transport fluids and gases through it.
item_port_udpipe_loader_1.decoDesc: The development process of underground pipelines has not been a smooth one. The Tianshi of Wuling once conceptualized Xiranite pipelines. They envisioned Xiranite particles being capable of carrying and encasing fluid molecules to achieve flexible adjustments of flow volume and flow rate. Unfortunately, such amorphous pipelines were never produced due to various safety concerns.

item_port_udpipe_loader_2.name: Conduit Inlet Manifold
item_port_udpipe_loader_2.desc: A large inlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet Manifold to transport fluids and gases through it.
item_port_udpipe_loader_2.decoDesc: Underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. This upgrade of the Conduit Inlet is furnished with a manifold of connection openings. Plumbers often call these by their nicknames: pan flute inlets.

item_port_udpipe_unloader_1.name: Conduit Outlet
item_port_udpipe_unloader_1.desc: An outlet for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Inlet to transport fluids and gases through it.
item_port_udpipe_unloader_1.decoDesc: Conduits are underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. Although the Wuling Tianshi did not successfully realize their "amorphous pipeline" design, their partnership with Endfield inspired engineers from the latter. The end product is capable of greatly improving fluid transport efficiency of underground pipeline facilities.

item_port_udpipe_unloader_2.name: Conduit Outlet Manifold
item_port_udpipe_unloader_2.desc: A large outlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Inlet Manifold to transport fluids and gases through it.
item_port_udpipe_unloader_2.decoDesc: Underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. This upgrade of the Conduit Outlet is furnished with a manifold of connection openings to greatly improve fluid transport efficiency.

item_port_ugly_paint_1.name: Lung by the Lantern
item_port_ugly_paint_1.desc: An ornamental that can be placed. It is stored in the Ornamental panel of the Facility List.
item_port_ugly_paint_1.decoDesc:
Si's masterpiece. This is the boss of the three elegantly outlined "lungs". 
"Dear patron, which of us is better looking? Me or the two by my side?"

item_port_unloader_1.name: Depot Unloader
item_port_unloader_1.desc: A placeable unloading point that transfers goods from a local depot into the AIC Factory. The Depot Unloader must be placed right next to the Depot Bus.
item_port_unloader_1.decoDesc: In extreme environments, the Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be directly connected to the facilities to ensure germ-free and low Blight transportation.

item_port_vaporizer_1.name: Gas Dispersing Unit
item_port_vaporizer_1.desc: A facility that can disperse a steady input of gas into the surroundings and change the gaseous environment around itself. It only alters the surroundings while active and is absolutely harmless to the environment.
item_port_vaporizer_1.decoDesc: "This is not an air humidifier or purifier. STOP pouring perfume into it."

item_port_winder_1.name: Gearing Unit
item_port_winder_1.desc: A facility that laminates different materials together to create gear components.
item_port_winder_1.decoDesc: A top-tier piece of equipment must undergo multiple processing steps that include textile weaving and compression lamination of various fabric and lining.

item_port_xiranite_oven_1.name: Forge of the Sky
item_port_xiranite_oven_1.desc: A facility for making Xiranite-based products.
item_port_xiranite_oven_1.decoDesc: The land is a cradle of wealth.

item_proc_battery_1.name: LC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_1.desc: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_1.decoDesc: Use and handle with care. Contents are hazardous to health. Compromising casing integrity may cause the said contents to leak.

item_proc_battery_2.name: SC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_2.desc: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_2.decoDesc: A skilled artisan can easily convert a standard capacity (SC) battery into an improvised explosive weapon.

item_proc_battery_3.name: HC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_3.desc: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_3.decoDesc: Many wildlands settlers make a living by stripping waste batteries of recyclable materials.

item_proc_battery_4.name: LC Wuling Battery
item_proc_battery_4.desc: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_4.decoDesc: Xiranite Power is a key project jointly pursued by Wuling and Endfield Industries.

item_proc_battery_5.name: SC Wuling Battery
item_proc_battery_5.desc: A battery packaged by AIC Factory facilities. It can be used to supply power, charge up facilities, or traded at various outposts.
item_proc_battery_5.decoDesc: The biggest advantage offered by this battery is zero risks of spontaneous combustion.

item_proc_bomb_1.name: Industrial Explosive
item_proc_bomb_1.desc:
A packaged explosive. 
Can be used to directly attack targets. The resulting explosion deals damage to all nearby enemies.
item_proc_bomb_1.decoDesc: This is a dangerous explosive. Carry and use with care.

item_quartz_enr.name: Cryston Fiber
item_quartz_enr.desc: A high quality material prepared by refining Cryston Powder. Can be used to produce other items.
item_quartz_enr.decoDesc: Cryston Fibers can undergo various processing steps to create a material for transmitting data and communication signals.

item_quartz_enr_powder.name: Cryston Powder
item_quartz_enr_powder.desc: Acquired by grinding Amethyst Powder. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_quartz_enr_powder.decoDesc: After fine grinding, improperly stored Cryston Powder will start to "flow" in non-hermetic containers due to Techno-Protocol influences.

item_quartz_glass.name: Amethyst Fiber
item_quartz_glass.desc: Fibers made by refining Amethyst Ore. Can be used to produce other items.
item_quartz_glass.decoDesc: Factory-drawn Amethyst fibers exhibit vastly increased strength.

item_quartz_powder.name: Amethyst Powder
item_quartz_powder.desc: Shredded and powdered Amethyst Fibers. Can be used to produce other items.
item_quartz_powder.decoDesc: Amethyst can be shredded to yield a processed product with improved homogeneity.

item_quartz_sand.name: Amethyst Ore
item_quartz_sand.desc: An ore containing a purple colored crystalline material. It can be processed with the AIC.
item_quartz_sand.decoDesc: Amethyst has a wide range of uses in precision manufacturing. The crystal is one of the essential basic materials in the electronic industry of Talos-II.

item_quest_building_materials.name: Stolen EF Building Materials

item_quest_common_battery.name: Battery
item_quest_common_battery.decoDesc: A power storage device commonly seen in Talos-II. Provides emergency electrical power to various types of machinery.

item_quest_e1m2_bfix.name: Insulation Repair Kit
item_quest_e1m2_bfix.desc: A part for repairing large backup power supplies.
item_quest_e1m2_bfix.decoDesc:
A part for large backup power supplies. 
This is an auto-module kit for repairing power facilities. Designed specifically in this fashion to cater to users who are often negligent about electrical safety.

item_quest_e1m3_fixtool.name: Prototype Parts
item_quest_e1m3_fixtool.decoDesc: Special parts found in the Originium Byproduct Processing Center. Give them to Andre to repair the prototype damaged during the Ankhorfall.

item_quest_e1m4_endfieldbox.name: Encrypted Endfield Crate
item_quest_e1m4_endfieldbox.decoDesc: A stolen Endfield supply crate. The container is encrypted. Even Perlica's authority level failed to open it.

item_quest_e1m4_ring.name: Suspicious Ring
item_quest_e1m4_ring.decoDesc: A suspicious ring acquired from a nomad. The Landbreakers seem to be wearing the same rings as well.

item_quest_e1m5_inhibit.name: Oripathy Suppressant
item_quest_e1m5_inhibit.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of suppressing Oripathy symptoms for a short time.

item_quest_e1m6_battery.name: Special Energy Battery
item_quest_e1m6_battery.decoDesc: An energy battery for special Endfield facilities.

item_quest_e1m6_drug.name: Injection Kit
item_quest_e1m6_drug.decoDesc: A medical kit capable of administering antibiotic solutions. Easy to use and effective.

item_quest_e1m6_needle.name: Emergency Invasive Medical Kit
item_quest_e1m6_needle.decoDesc: A medical kit for emergency treatment. Special contact point designs allow it to make germ-free incisions into human tissue.

item_quest_e1m6_tool.name: Small Auto-Tools
item_quest_e1m6_tool.decoDesc: An auto-tool capable of repairing lightly damaged facilities or machines. This technological product is only produced by Endfield Industries.

item_quest_e1m8_fixbox.name: Emergency Repair Kit
item_quest_e1m8_fixbox.decoDesc: An emergency repair kit of the UWST. It contains a set of commonly used machinery repair tools.

item_quest_e2m5_headdress.name: Site Director's Helmet
item_quest_e2m5_headdress.desc: Helmet belonging to the old site director.
item_quest_e2m5_headdress.decoDesc: The site director's helmet. The old man hardly parted with this. But here it lies, in the middle of a construction site and not on the man himself. This hints strongly at a certain possibility.

item_quest_e2m6_battery.name: Square Battery
item_quest_e2m6_battery.decoDesc: An uncommon power unit with an older design. Only a few would use batteries of such specifications nowadays.

item_quest_gpl_e2m5_trophy.name: Proof for the Mighty
item_quest_gpl_e2m5_trophy.decoDesc: A proof of accomplishment given to the heroes who completed the final challenge of this test!

item_quest_sid_e1m1_goods.name: Fast-acting Medication
item_quest_sid_e1m1_goods.decoDesc: A special pharmaceutical agent designed to counter certain rare diseases. This is expensive as annual production is extremely low.

item_quest_sid_e1m4_powerstation.name: Electrical Supply Part
item_quest_sid_e1m4_powerstation.decoDesc:
A special part for electrical supplies designed for convenience. 
Its easy-to-dismantle and miniaturized designs pose certain risks. People can just carry off the part without permission.

item_racingdungeon_exp.name: Journey Points
item_racingdungeon_exp.desc: Acquired by gathering Aurylene Fragments or completing Realm Quests in The Rooted Realm event activities. They are exchangeable for rewards.
item_racingdungeon_exp.decoDesc: Your journey, once written down, will become an inspiring legend that the youths of posterity will never forget.

item_ranch_egg_1.name: Egg
item_ranch_egg_1.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_egg_1.decoDesc: An egg of a Sable-chested Fowlbeast. The eggshell is pretty fragile, so carry it carefully.

item_ranch_egg_2.name: Egg [A]
item_ranch_egg_2.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_egg_2.decoDesc: An egg of a Sable-chested Fowlbeast but this one seems bigger and heavier. It might carry two or three yolks within it. Such eggs are the symbol of fortune.

item_ranch_fishmeat_1.name: Fin Fillet
item_ranch_fishmeat_1.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_fishmeat_1.decoDesc: Fillet from farmed fins. We advise against eating it raw due to the species of the fins and the way they were raised.

item_ranch_fishmeat_2.name: Fin Fillet [A]
item_ranch_fishmeat_2.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_fishmeat_2.decoDesc: Savory and sweet-tasting fin fillet. Fins that swim a lot tend to produce the best fillet. Oho! Time to exercise!

item_ranch_fodder_1.name: Yummy Feed
item_ranch_fodder_1.desc: A product of AIC processing. Feed can be used to feed beasts raised at Yuanyuan Manor Backyard to improve their Satiety. Beasts will continuously yield products when their Satiety is higher than ZERO.
item_ranch_fodder_1.decoDesc:
"Gets them fully stuffed in two chomps?! We should call it Stuffy Feed. It makes them stuffed."
"I got a feeling that it's not Yummy at all."

item_ranch_fodder_2.name: Double-Yummy Feed
item_ranch_fodder_2.desc: A product of AIC processing. Beasts raised at Yuanyuan Manor Backyard can be fed with beast feed to improve both their Satiety and Happiness. Beasts will continuously yield quality products when both their Satiety and Happiness are higher than ZERO.
item_ranch_fodder_2.decoDesc:
"There. Brand new formula. The beasts should no longer complain about the taste."
"Interesting. I'll have two bites as well."

item_ranch_meat_1.name: Meat
item_ranch_meat_1.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_meat_1.decoDesc: A lean and solid chunk of meat. Cooking it gives off the aroma of beast and fowl. Source cannot be disclosed.

item_ranch_meat_2.name: Meat [A]
item_ranch_meat_2.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_meat_2.decoDesc: A perfectly marbled chunk of meat. Please cook it well and don't waste this work of natural beauty.

item_ranch_milk_1.name: Milk
item_ranch_milk_1.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_milk_1.decoDesc: Beast milk. It has a slightly gamey taste. Both calves and kids need it to grow up.

item_ranch_milk_2.name: Milk [A]
item_ranch_milk_2.desc: A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.
item_ranch_milk_2.decoDesc: Thick, quality beast milk. Putting it in front of calves and kids might trigger a fight.

item_record_002_01.name: Recording Device
item_record_002_01.decoDesc:
"Madness! This is definitely madness! We can expect some Blight, but having a massive pit appearing at this place IS NOT NORMAL. All the figures are in the datasheet. Just one glance and you'll see! 
"My personal view is to EVAC NOW. ASAP! Then send in the professionals to handle the problem! 
"Of all the Blight phenomena out there, spatial anomalies are the most dangerous! I don't care about the results of whatever field of research you quote. Spatial blightery is the worst and most THREATENING! 
"Did none of you read about the worst Blight events we had in history? 
"I know our experimental data is stable and we shouldn't be getting Blight manifestations in this region, but if we don't take care of this Blight problem, our blighted names will be remembered in history as the blightbrained criminals who let it blight the hell of everything!"

item_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_1.name: Mini Honey Slugpudding
item_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.
item_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: Citrome-flavored pudding with balanced sour and sweet flavors. Bits of aggagrit were added during boiling. Originium Slug extracts were then used to solidify the entire thing. This cloyingly sweet aroma is simply ... magnificent.

item_slimeml_1_erhound_1_agfly_1_1.name: Pulled Slug Meat
item_slimeml_1_erhound_1_agfly_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_slimeml_1_erhound_1_agfly_1_1.decoDesc: Slug meat that has been completely dehydrated. The pulled jerky is incredibly chewy. This is one of the best pet foods in Valley IV.

item_slwood_1_hshog_1_1.name: Sear-Toasted Liver
item_slwood_1_hshog_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_slwood_1_hshog_1_1.decoDesc: An easy-to-make dish that is popular amongst many frontiersmates. Simply sear liver with some salt, hang them over a wooden rack, and smoke them with tender sprigs. The result is most delicious and exquisite.

item_sm1l1m5_Alexander_docbag.name: Aleksandr's Document Holder
item_sm1l1m5_Alexander_docbag.decoDesc: A document holder furnished with the old logo of Clavis TGCC Trading.

item_sm1l1m5_Eriksson_workphone.name: Erikssohn Employee Roster HT
item_sm1l1m5_Eriksson_workphone.desc: Evidence proving that Aleksandr is not an employee of Erikssohn Trading House.
item_sm1l1m5_Eriksson_workphone.decoDesc: A handyterm with the Erikssohn Trading House employee roster. Just as Hartmann said, Aleksandr's name is missing from the roster.

item_sm1l5m1_reporter.name: Broken Handyterm
item_sm1l5m1_reporter.desc: A broken handyterm belonging to Raquel the journalist.
item_sm1l5m1_reporter.decoDesc: The latest handyterm but its screen is broken. Raquel the missing journalist left it at the place where she disappeared.

item_sm1l5m3_karlnote.name: "Karl's" Notes
item_sm1l5m3_karlnote.desc: "Karl's" work notes forged by Da Pan.
item_sm1l5m3_karlnote.decoDesc: Professional notes written in a messy hand. Obviously written by an experienced engineer.

item_sm1l5m4_repair.name: Backup Parts
item_sm1l5m4_repair.desc: Backup parts that Da Pan needs to repair the controller.
item_sm1l5m4_repair.decoDesc: Most facilities tend to have a stash of backup parts nearby, just in case something breaks down.

item_sm1l5m4_snack.name: Osmanthus Cake
item_sm1l5m4_snack.desc: Da Pan's special snack for Karl.
item_sm1l5m4_snack.decoDesc: Beautiful looking desserts giving off a faint, flowery fragrance.

item_sm2l1m1_bamboo.name: Bundle of Bamboo
item_sm2l1m1_bamboo.desc: A bundle of bamboo. Can be used to repair the stockade resident's bamboo raft.
item_sm2l1m1_bamboo.decoDesc: Bamboo for helping stockade residents repair their bamboo rafts. Someone has been kind enough to tie it up into a neat bundle.

item_sm2l1m5_grass.name: Fresh Jincao
item_sm2l1m5_grass.desc: Jincao herbs with some dew on them. The beasts of Wuling love the herb.
item_sm2l1m5_grass.decoDesc: Very few actually know how this plant tastes like. In truth, special cooking methods will bring about magical tastes.

item_sm2l6m1_key.name: Piece of a Mini Stone Statue
item_sm2l6m1_key.desc: It's far smaller than usual statues. Maybe it's a key?
item_sm2l6m1_key.decoDesc: It's far smaller than usual statues. Maybe it's a key?

item_sp_1_moss_1_agmelee_1_1.name: Hub Emergency Ration
item_sp_1_moss_1_agmelee_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_sp_1_moss_1_agmelee_1_1.decoDesc: An extremely hard and salty tack. After the decision to construct the Hub Base was made, the first Endfield operators arriving at Valley IV considered the possibility of supply shortage. Hence, they specifically added these emergency rations known for their extremely long shelf lives to the supply list.

item_sp_2_moss_2_agrange_1_1.name: Superhot Fruit Preserves
item_sp_2_moss_2_agrange_1_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_sp_2_moss_2_agrange_1_1.decoDesc: Fruit preserves with a sour and spicy flavor. Unripened citromes can be extremely sour, but cut them to pieces (along with the rind) and marinate them in a blend of tartpeppers and aggagrit condiments. The result is a refreshing riot of sour and spicy.

item_spaceship_cmpt_1.name: Aerospace Material I
item_spaceship_cmpt_1.desc: A basic construction material. Can be used to upgrade Dijiang.
item_spaceship_cmpt_1.decoDesc: Only use these materials within the effective range of Protocol facilities.

item_spaceship_cmpt_2.name: Aerospace Material II
item_spaceship_cmpt_2.desc: An advanced industrial construction material. Can be used to upgrade Dijiang.
item_spaceship_cmpt_2.decoDesc: If this material exhibits any sign of warping or discoloration, IMMEDIATELY CONTACT the Endministrator or Supervisor Perlica.

item_spaceship_credit.name: Credits
item_spaceship_credit.desc: Exchangeable for progression materials and other important resources at the Acquisition Center - Credit Store.

item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_2.name: Tianshi Pillar Model
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_2.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_2.decoDesc: A standard Tianshi Pillar model. Switch it on and adjust to maximum brightness to use it as a large table lamp.

item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_3.name: Deluxe Chubby Lung
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_3.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_3.decoDesc: An extra-large collector's edition Chubby Lung. Although it looks similar to the first batch of secret Chubby Lungs officially released by Wuling, this one is way bigger.

item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_4.name: Mark and Fulfill
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_4.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_4.decoDesc: A commemorative model of the Wuling Marker Stone. Such stones are often used to expedite traveling to a certain place. Some residents of Wuling believe that placing a Marker Stone at home would give them a blessing of "freedom".

item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_5.name: Dichromo-Light
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_5.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_5.decoDesc: An intricate work whose designs have been inspired by the dichromolite. The contraption is actually a large puzzle. Successfully solving it will change its lights to green. If the puzzle remains unsolved, the lights stay red.

item_spaceship_exhibits_shanshantu.name: Companions Figurine
item_spaceship_exhibits_shanshantu.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_shanshantu.decoDesc: Two lovely visitors who traveled long and far together. They decided to leave their trails at this very place.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_1.name: Mr. Rammu
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_1.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_1.decoDesc: A model of a cute critter. UWST crew mates treat long-ears as a bringer of courage as they are capable of surviving the dangerous environments of Talos-II.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_2.name: Arc 2000 Model
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_2.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_2.decoDesc: A scale model of a motorcycle. Arc 2000 is a classic and popular vehicle manufactured by Endfield Industries due to its light weight, reliability, and all-terrain performance. Even its scale models are widely sought after.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_3.name: Champion Drill Crawler
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_3.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_3.decoDesc: A scale model of the multi-purpose drill. During the sudden Aggeloid attack when construction work first began at the Valley, this drill crawler carried out the crucial task of smashing the Ankhor to bits.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_4.name: Bonsai of Life
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_4.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_4.decoDesc: A scale model of the Originium sapling. This is a gift, a blessing of growth, rebirth, and hope. It is usually placed at the side of a patient's bed.

item_spaceship_exhibits_universe.name: Qiming Station Model
item_spaceship_exhibits_universe.desc: This can be showcased at the Tower of Trails at the Central Ring of Dijiang.
item_spaceship_exhibits_universe.decoDesc: Fathomed in poems and dreams, fashioned with steel and labor... This pair of wings was sculpted to sail across the cosmos and pluck the stars from the very heavens.

item_spaceship_intelligence.name: Clue Dossier
item_spaceship_intelligence.desc: A clue dossier generated by a complete set of clues and findings. Can be used for initiating operations in various areas.
item_spaceship_intelligence.decoDesc: This dossier will self-combust in three seconds if opened the wrong way.

item_spaceship_jinlong_gold.name: Wuling Convention Certificate
item_spaceship_jinlong_gold.desc: Supply chain specialist Ladonn aboard Dijiang will accept this currency and give you Wuling goods in return.
item_spaceship_jinlong_gold.decoDesc:
Endfield Industries and its partners have signed an agreement to trade supplies and commodities with this currency. 
This currency can only be used in the Wuling region.

item_spaceship_key_1.name: Algorithm Expansion Chip
item_spaceship_key_1.desc: Use this at the Control Nexus aboard Dijiang to unlock the next expansion phase of the entire vessel.
item_spaceship_key_1.decoDesc: This data chip should contain plans for expanding Dijiang but its memory array only contains vast amounts of incredibly encrypted code... Someone might know how to decipher this, but who might that be?

item_spaceship_tundra_gold.name: Valley Convention Certificate
item_spaceship_tundra_gold.desc: Supply chain specialist Ladonn aboard Dijiang will accept these certs and offer you goods from Valley IV in return.
item_spaceship_tundra_gold.decoDesc:
Colloquially abbreviated as Vallico. Endfield Industries and all Convention signatories agree to use this fiat currency for trading supplies and commodities. 
This certificate is legal tender only in the Valley IV region.

item_springbox_01.name: Connect-and-Win: Auspice
item_springbox_01.desc:
Use this to randomly get 1 of these rewards:
- Oroberyl×260
- Oroberyl×280
- Oroberyl×300
item_springbox_01.decoDesc: An intricate connect-and-win voucher that represents Fortune. Scratch it and see. It doesn't matter what the numbers are, because Fortune is always smiling on you.

item_springbox_02.name: Connect-and-Win: Luck
item_springbox_02.decoDesc: An intricate connect-and-win voucher that represents Luck. Scratch it and see. The beautiful strings of numbers are symbols of Luck, and may you have plenty of it.

item_ticketgacha_beginner_ten.name: New Horizons HH-10×Permit
item_ticketgacha_beginner_ten.desc: An internal certificate of Endfield Industries. Use this to perform 10×headhunting in [New Horizons Headhunting].
item_ticketgacha_beginner_ten.decoDesc: To familiarize the freshly awakened Endministrator with the many ongoing projects of Endfield, the HR Division planned a special recruitment event.

item_ticketgacha_joint_single_lt_1_2_2.name: Shimmering Moment HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_joint_single_lt_1_2_2.desc: A limited-time Endfield Industries certificate. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting. This certificate will expire when [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting ends.
item_ticketgacha_joint_single_lt_1_2_2.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

item_ticketgacha_joint_ten_lt_1_2_2.name: Shimmering Moment 10×Permit
item_ticketgacha_joint_ten_lt_1_2_2.desc: A limited-time Endfield Industries certificate. Use this to perform 10× headhunting in [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting. This certificate will expire when [Fest of Brilliance] Special Headhunting ends.
item_ticketgacha_joint_ten_lt_1_2_2.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

item_ticketgacha_special_single.name: Chartered HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single.desc: An internal certificate of Endfield Industries. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Chartered Headhunting] or [RE-Factor Headhunting].
item_ticketgacha_special_single.decoDesc: Talos-II is home to plenty of talented individuals. To satisfy the ever-increasing demand for skilled operators of Endfield Industries, the HR Division has prepared a special and temporary contingent measure for headhunting.

item_ticketgacha_special_single_1_lt.name: Chartered HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_1_lt.desc: A limited-time Endfield Industries certificate. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Chartered Headhunting].
item_ticketgacha_special_single_1_lt.decoDesc: Talos-II is home to plenty of talented individuals. To satisfy the ever-increasing demand for skilled operators of Endfield Industries, the HR Division has prepared a special and temporary contingent measure for headhunting.

item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.name: Firewalker's Trail HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.desc: A limited-time Endfield Industries certificate. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Scars of the Forge] Chartered Headhunting. This certificate will expire when [Scars of the Forge] Chartered Headhunting ends.
item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_2.name: Spectral Splendor HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_2.desc: A limited-time Endfield Industries certificate. Use this to perform 1 headhunting in [Hues of Passion] Chartered Headhunting. This certificate will expire when [Hues of Passion] Chartered Headhunting ends.

item_tundra_detector_coin_3.name: Keen Valley Compass
item_tundra_detector_coin_3.desc: Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered Aurylene within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map have been charted. This item only works in Valley IV.
item_tundra_detector_coin_3.decoDesc:
An Arts Unit for detecting Aurylene. This device looks like a compass, and contains a tiny Aurylene in its center to locate other Aurylene in the environment. 
This "compass" seems to be operating at an overclocked state. The needle would spin wildly upon simple activation.

item_tundra_detector_trchest_3.name: Keen Valley Detector
item_tundra_detector_trchest_3.desc: Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered storage crate within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map have been charted. This item only works in Valley IV.
item_tundra_detector_trchest_3.decoDesc:
A special detector once created by prospectors looking for metal resources in Valley IV. It is made of the same metals used in storage crates. Using this points you to storage crates scattered throughout the area. 
Several words have been engraved along the edge of the device: "To those who persevere in hopelessness."

item_weekraid_tech_5_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Nodule Refining" technology. "These precipitation nodules are... well... kinda like fowlbeast eggs at different stages of development. Analyzing them is like opening a gacha egg."

item_weekraid_tech_6_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Fragmented Treatment" technology. Though subject to interference exerted by ambient Derangement, it will do its best to keep you alive and safeguard your health.

item_weekraid_tech_6_2.name: Tactical Tempo Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_2.desc: Recover SP by defeating enemies in the Valley's Aberrants.
item_weekraid_tech_6_2.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Tactical Tempo" technology. "Use their energy against themselves to avoid exhausting yourself!" Lil' Dodge certainly knows how to translate Mr. Krad's lessons into short, simple phrases.

item_weekraid_tech_6_3.name: Armor Gilding Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_3.desc: Operators enjoy higher Max HP in the Valley's Aberrants.
item_weekraid_tech_6_3.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Armor Gilding" technology. Applying a precipitation nodule coating on the armor can effectively defend against the threat posed by the Protocol Space.

item_weekraid_tech_6_4.name: Charge Burst Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_4.desc: The first skill cast after start of every battle deals more DMG in Valley's Aberrants.
item_weekraid_tech_6_4.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Charge Burst" technology. "This is quite a dangerous test. We're trying to use your weapon to 'activate' the Aberrant and annihilate the enemies."

item_weekraid_tech_6_5.name: Energy Capture Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_5.desc: Grants Ultimate Energy by defeating enemies in the Valley's Aberrants.
item_weekraid_tech_6_5.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Energy Capture" technology. Enemies in the Aberrants are valuable resources as well.

item_weekraid_tech_6_6.name: Stress Feedback Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_6.desc: Grants faster SP Recovery in the Valley's Aberrants.
item_weekraid_tech_6_6.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Stress Feedback" technology. Perhaps one day will come when we finally make enough progress in Aberrant-interference technologies, giving us better "feedback" from these twisted Protocol Spaces.

item_wgshoal_1_grass_1_grass_2_1.name: Mini Sugar Painting
item_wgshoal_1_grass_1_grass_2_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_wgshoal_1_grass_1_grass_2_1.decoDesc: An extremely simple snack. For expatriates who cannot return home ... a quick fix of nostalgia can be acquired in the most simple of sweets.

item_wgslime_1_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.name: Chubby Lung Jellied Greens
item_wgslime_1_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.desc: Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.
item_wgslime_1_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.decoDesc: These jellied greens are bouncy and jiggly to the touch. Special molds were used by the manufacturers to create jellied greens shaped like Chubby Lung. It is the only option since everyone likes Chubby Lungs so much. Kyaaa! Chubby Lung! They're so cute!

item_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.name: Mystery Soda
item_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.decoDesc: Pop it open and start chugging. Feel the fizz dance on your tongue, then give a satisfied burp. It's that simple.

item_wgthorns_1_hshog_1_hsmob_1_1.name: Pan-Fried Double Crisp
item_wgthorns_1_hshog_1_hsmob_1_1.desc: Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.
item_wgthorns_1_hshog_1_hsmob_1_1.decoDesc: A dish that poses a serious challenge to the chef. Quillbeast livers can quickly overcook and assume a texture similar to rubbery leather. A skilled cook must first come up with a way to give it the same tender crisp of young bamboo sprouts.

item_wpngem_enhance_dust.name: Coolant Gel
item_wpngem_enhance_dust.desc: A rare material that upgrades essence Stats.
item_wpngem_enhance_dust.decoDesc: A special coolant gel used in the essence etching process. Results of etching are extremely sensitive to temperature changes. This process thus requires the use of coolant gels, which can be extremely expensive to make.

item_wpnpotentialup_bp.name: Protocolized Weapon Pattern
item_wpnpotentialup_bp.desc:
This can raise the potential of any weapon provided by Protocol Pass weapon supplies, including weapon supplies from future pass seasons.
Go to the Database for details on applicable weapons.
item_wpnpotentialup_bp.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers are always recording operator weapon preferences and other expectations they have... The Protocol Pass is an attempt used by the Arsenal to boost weapon R&D efficiency in Endfield.

item_wuling_detector_coin_3.name: Keen Wuling Compass
item_wuling_detector_coin_3.desc: Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered Aurylene within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map have been charted. This item only works in Wuling.
item_wuling_detector_coin_3.decoDesc:
A positioning tool "handcrafted" by the residents of Qingbo Stockade. A few simple tweaks gave it the ability to detect Aurylene. 
Use with caution. The water within the device will start boiling violently as one approaches the item being detected.

item_wuling_detector_star.name: Wuling Talosite Probe
item_wuling_detector_star.desc: Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered Talosite within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map have been charted. This item only works in Wuling.
item_wuling_detector_star.decoDesc: The sundial is used as an inspiration for designing this probe. It is capable of pinpointing energy fluctuations generated by moving Talosite.

item_wuling_detector_trchest_3.name: Keen Wuling Detector
item_wuling_detector_trchest_3.desc: Consumable. Usage reveals an undiscovered storage crate within the current area. Usable only after all fogged places of the map have been charted. This item only works in Wuling.
item_wuling_detector_trchest_3.decoDesc:
A small detector furnished with Xiranite technology, giving it the ability to accurately locate metallic objects. The detector can thus be used to locate storage crates. 
Fresh off the production line! Look how it shimmers!

item_wuling_oven_amount_4_unlock.name: Forge of the Sky Research Log
item_wuling_oven_amount_4_unlock.desc: A new technology, Forge Expansion IV, has been added to the Wuling AIC Plan. Research it to raise the limit of Forges of the Sky in Wuling.

item_wuling_xiranite_enr_unlock.name: Heavy Xiranite Research Log
item_wuling_xiranite_enr_unlock.desc: Heavy Xiranite production technology has been added to the Wuling AIC Factory Plan. Research this to unlock the production formula for Heavy Xiranite.

item_xiranite_enr_powder.name: Heavy Xiranite
item_xiranite_enr_powder.desc: A material produced by a specialized facility. Can be used for repairing special facilities or for trading with various outposts.
item_xiranite_enr_powder.decoDesc: Heavy Xiranite was first discovered in an attempt to improve Xiranite yield. During the test, the Tianshi experimented with various Xiranite polymorphic mixtures and achieved a type of dynamic-static co-equilibrium. Though the test failed to achieve its aim, it yielded a form of Xiranite with a small yet significant improvement to durability.

item_xiranite_lowpoly.name: Light Xircon
item_xiranite_lowpoly.desc: Acquired via crystal precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_xiranite_lowpoly.decoDesc: Light Xircon has a lower density than Xircon. Currently, Wuling Tianshi are trying to use this material for constructing personal body armor for members of the Yinglung Special Task Force.

item_xiranite_poly.name: Xircon
item_xiranite_poly.desc: Acquired via crystal precipitation. Can be used to produce other materials.
item_xiranite_poly.decoDesc: Introducing metallic elements has completely disrupted the balance between Originium and Feranmut power as well as the physical properties of the material itself. The Xircon crystals precipitated from the resulting effluent exhibit gemstone-like textures.

item_xiranite_powder.name: Xiranite
item_xiranite_powder.desc: A material produced by a specialized facility. Can be used for repairing special facilities or for trading with various outposts.
item_xiranite_powder.decoDesc: A novel Originium-based material acquired by fusing the mineral with Feranmut power. This material fuels life and prosperity in Wuling.

monthlycard_lt_1.name: Monthly Pass Exchange Cert
monthlycard_lt_1.desc: Use this to get Monthly Pass perks for 30 days.
monthlycard_lt_1.decoDesc: Scan this with the Protosync and the Logistics Division will offer you tons of special perks, privileges, and services.

monthlycard_reward_r_1.name: Monthly Pass Exchange Cert

preset_cbp_voucher_originium_1.name: Pass Application: Originium
preset_cbp_voucher_originium_1.desc: Use this to activate the Protocol Pass tier: Originium Supply.
preset_cbp_voucher_originium_1.decoDesc: Some Endfield operators enjoy referring to the Protocol Pass as their "wishlist". According to rumors, those who make a wish and place some Origeometry by their pillows during the eve of their birthdays will receive a satisfying reward from the kind little robots of the Arsenal.

preset_cbp_voucher_pay_1.name: Pass Application: Customized
preset_cbp_voucher_pay_1.desc: Use this to activate the Protocol Pass tier: Protocol Customized.
preset_cbp_voucher_pay_1.decoDesc: "Good. Just sign your name here and you'll get your very own customized Protocol Pass... Oh? Efficiency? Don't worry. We'll airdrop the supplies to your place if necessary."

resetid_card_1.name: ID Info Update Card
resetid_card_1.desc: Use this item to change the Endministrator's name.
resetid_card_1.decoDesc: To ensure Protocol security while improving user experiences, Dijiang has reserved a personal data update channel for you.

sysbp_common_icon_1.desc: System blueprints can be placed in the Core AIC Area to quickly set up various production lines and support your efforts in <@tips.key>automated production</>.

sysbp_wuling_proc_battery_5_1.name: SC Wuling Battery
sysbp_wuling_proc_battery_5_1.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Xircon</> and <@gd.key>Dense Originium Powder</> to auto-produce <@gd.key>SC Wuling Batteries</>.

sysbp_wuling_prod_fbottle_1.name: General Fluid Filling
sysbp_wuling_prod_fbottle_1.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Ferrium Bottle</> and <@gd.key>any fluid</> to auto-produce <@gd.key>Ferrium Bottles filled with that fluid</>.

sysbp_wuling_prod_plant_1.name: General Hydroponics
sysbp_wuling_prod_plant_1.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Clean Water</> and 1 unit of <@gd.key>any plant that can be processed at the Seed-Picking Unit and Planting Unit</> to auto-produce an endless amount of <@gd.key>that plant</>.

sysbp_wuling_solid2gas_01.name: General Solid-to-Gas
sysbp_wuling_solid2gas_01.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input a <@gd.key>solid material</> and <@gd.key>Xiragen</> to auto-transmute the solid into its <@gd.key>gaseous state</>.

sysbp_wuling_xiranite_easy_01.name: Efficient Xiranite
sysbp_wuling_xiranite_easy_01.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Inergen</>, <@gd.key>Clean Water</>, and <@gd.key>Carbon</> to auto-produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.

sysbp_wuling_xiranite_enr_powder_1.name: Heavy Xiranite
sysbp_wuling_xiranite_enr_powder_1.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Xiranite</>, <@gd.key>Clean Water</>, and <@gd.key>Sewage</> to auto-produce <@gd.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

sysbp_wuling_xiranite_poly_1.name: Xircon
sysbp_wuling_xiranite_poly_1.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Sewage</>, <@gd.key>Xiranite</>, and <@gd.key>Ferrium Ore</> to auto-produce <@gd.key>Xircon</>.

sysbp_wuling_xiranite_powder_1.name: Xiranite
sysbp_wuling_xiranite_powder_1.desc: Place this blueprint in the Core AIC Area, then input <@gd.key>Clean Water</>, <@gd.key>Carbon</>, and <@gd.key>Sandleaves</> to auto-produce <@gd.key>Xiranite</>.
